senses.en: starting at a place, time, or source

ex.en: This postcard is from my cousin in Nanjing.
ex.zh: 这张明信片是南京的表哥寄来的。

ex.en: Ideas from different subjects can be combined when students explain a real problem in their town.
ex.zh: 学生解释家乡的真实问题时，可以结合不同学科的想法。

tip: from...to... 表示从……到……，时间和地点都可以用。

senses.en: used for a point in time or place

ex.en: We meet at the school gate at seven.
ex.zh: 我们七点在校门口见面。

ex.en: Looking at screens late at night can make it harder for teenagers to fall asleep.
ex.zh: 深夜看屏幕会让青少年更难入睡。

tip: 钟点和较小地点用 at；街道、城市一般用 in。

senses.en: used to introduce a clause
the one already mentioned

ex.en: I think that the answer is right.
ex.zh: 我认为这个答案是对的。

ex.en: Researchers argue that regular sleep is as important as extra lessons for students under exam pressure.
ex.zh: 研究者认为，对备考压力大的学生来说，规律睡眠和额外补课一样重要。

tip: 引导宾语从句的 that 可以省略，但写作里保留更清楚。

senses.en: used for the future, or for willingness
a desire, or a legal document about one's property

ex.en: I will call you after the meeting.
ex.zh: 散会后我会给你打电话。

ex.en: A city that will face water shortages needs to teach children why saving water matters.
ex.zh: 一座将面临缺水的城市，需要让孩子明白为什么节水重要。

tip: will 表示将来或意愿；遗嘱这一名词读音相同，写作里要靠词性区分。

senses.en: used for an agent, a deadline, or a means

ex.en: The poster was drawn by our art group.
ex.zh: 这张海报是我们美术小组画的。

ex.en: Please hand in the form by Friday so that the school can arrange seats before the test.
ex.zh: 请在周五前交表，以便学校在考试前排好座位。

tip: by 加交通工具时不用冠词：by bus。截止时间也用 by。

senses.en: intended for someone, or lasting a length of time

ex.en: This seat is for our class monitor.
ex.zh: 这个座位是给我们班长的。

ex.en: Schools that set aside time for reading often see students become more willing to discuss difficult texts.
ex.zh: 留出阅读时间的学校，常常发现学生更愿意讨论难懂的文章。

col: for a long time｜很长时间
tip: for 接一段时间；since 接时间点。

senses.en: not the same
used to describe several separate people, things, or types

ex.en: Each student has a different style.
ex.zh: 每个学生都有不同风格。

ex.en: Students from different cultural backgrounds can contribute valuable perspectives to classroom discussions about global issues.
ex.zh: 来自不同文化背景的学生能为课堂上的全球议题讨论提供宝贵的视角。

tip: 与……不同常用different from，适合正式写作。

senses.en: used to make a verb or phrase negative

ex.en: I am not ready for the oral test.
ex.zh: 我还没准备好口语考试。

ex.en: A short plan is not a waste of time if it stops you from revising the same page twice.
ex.zh: 如果一份简短计划能避免你把同一页复习两遍，它就不是浪费时间。

tip: 否定动词用 not；直接否定名词用 no，如 no time。

senses.en: on the subject of, or roughly

ex.en: We talked about the class trip.
ex.zh: 我们谈了班级出游的事。

ex.en: Reports about teenage sleep suggest that earlier school starts can harm attention in morning lessons.
ex.zh: 关于青少年睡眠的报告表明，过早上学可能影响上午课堂的注意力。

tip: be about to do 表示马上要做，通常不再加具体将来时间。

senses.en: an informal talk

ex.en: They had a long conversation about books.
ex.zh: 他们就书籍进行了长时间交谈。

ex.en: Regular conversation with fluent speakers helps language learners develop confidence and improve their listening skills.
ex.zh: 经常与语言流利的人交谈有助于语言学习者建立信心并提高听力。

tip: 与某人谈某事：have a conversation with某人about某事。

senses.en: to be able to, or to be allowed to
a metal container for food

ex.en: I can finish this exercise before lunch.
ex.zh: 我能在午饭前做完这道练习。

ex.en: Public libraries can give students a quiet place to work when their homes are too crowded.
ex.zh: 当家里太挤时，公共图书馆可以为学生提供安静的学习场所。

tip: 能力用 can；过去的能力常用 could 或 was able to。

senses.en: together with, or having

ex.en: I walk home with my classmate.
ex.zh: 我和同学一起走回家。

ex.en: Teams that plan a project with a clear timetable are less likely to leave the hard work until the last night.
ex.zh: 用清晰时间表规划项目的小组，不太会把难的部分留到最后一夜。

col: with the help of｜在……的帮助下
tip: with 后面接名词或代词，不接动词原形。

senses.en: on the condition that, or whether

ex.en: If it rains, we will stay in the classroom.
ex.zh: 如果下雨，我们就留在教室。

ex.en: If schools teach students how to check a source, they are less likely to trust a false story online.
ex.zh: 如果学校教学生如何核对来源，他们就不太会轻信网上的假消息。

tip: 主将从现：if 从句常用一般现在时，主句用 will。

senses.en: inside a place, or during a period

ex.en: The keys are in my schoolbag.
ex.zh: 钥匙在我的书包里。

ex.en: Students who read in short daily sessions often remember new words longer than those who study only before an exam.
ex.zh: 每天分段阅读的学生，往往比只在考前突击的人记得更久。

tip: 地点或一段时间前常用 in；具体某一天用 on，钟点用 at。

senses.en: the one near the speaker

ex.en: This question is easier than the last one.
ex.zh: 这道题比上一道容易。

ex.en: This result suggests that short breaks can improve attention during long study hours.
ex.zh: 这一结果说明，长时间学习中的短休息有助于保持注意力。

tip: this 指近处或即将说到的事；those 是 that 的复数。

senses.en: something that shows a rule
A person or action that others can learn from or copy

ex.en: Give an example to support your idea.
ex.zh: 举一个例子支持你的观点。

ex.en: Public buildings can set an example by using renewable energy and reducing unnecessary water consumption.
ex.zh: 公共建筑可以通过使用可再生能源和减少不必要的用水来树立榜样。

tip: for example用于举例；set an example意为树立榜样。

senses.en: to enjoy or want
similar to

ex.en: I like reading by the window.
ex.zh: 我喜欢靠窗读书。

ex.en: Teenagers like being trusted with real tasks, not only praised for high marks.
ex.zh: 青少年喜欢被托付真正的任务，而不只是因为高分受到夸奖。

tip: like 后接 doing 表示习惯喜好；would like to do 表示此刻想要。

senses.en: to have the same opinion
Decide something together or promise to do something

ex.en: I agree with your suggestion.
ex.zh: 我同意你的建议。

ex.en: Most researchers agree that regular physical activity can improve both mental health and academic performance.
ex.zh: 大多数研究人员认为，经常运动可以改善心理健康和学业表现。

col: agree with someone｜同意某人的观点
agree on a plan｜就计划达成一致
agree to do something｜答应做某事
agree to a proposal｜同意一项提议
tip: 同意某人用with；商定某事用on；答应做用to do。

senses.en: to such a degree, or therefore
and for that reason

ex.en: The hallway was so noisy that we could not hear.
ex.zh: 走廊吵得我们听不见。

ex.en: The town has few buses, so many students cycle to school even on cold mornings.
ex.zh: 镇上公交很少，所以许多学生即使在寒冷的早晨也骑车上学。

tip: so...that... 表示“如此……以至于”；such 后面接名词。

senses.en: hard to do
Not easy to please, manage, or deal with.

ex.en: The question is difficult.
ex.zh: 这道题很难。

ex.en: Many graduates find it difficult to secure stable employment without previous experience in their chosen field.
ex.zh: 许多毕业生发现，如果没有所选领域的工作经验，就很难找到稳定的工作。

col: a difficult customer｜难应付的顾客
tip: 常用find it difficult to do，勿把difficulty当形容词。

senses.en: the whole number or amount

ex.en: All the lights in the lab are off.
ex.zh: 实验室里的灯都关了。

ex.en: Not all famous people are suitable role models for teenagers who are still forming their own values.
ex.zh: 对仍在形成价值观的青少年来说，并非所有名人都是合适的榜样。

tip: all 与 not 连用常表示部分否定：Not all students agree.

senses.en: a very short time ago, or only

ex.en: I have just seen the notice on the board.
ex.zh: 我刚看到布告栏上的通知。

ex.en: A slogan that just sounds exciting may still fail if it does not tell people what to do.
ex.zh: 一句只是听着振奋的口号，如果没有告诉人们该做什么，仍然可能没有用。

tip: just 常放在助动词后、实义动词前。

senses.en: touching a surface, or on a particular day

ex.en: The notice is on the classroom door.
ex.zh: 通知贴在教室门上。

ex.en: Many cities now limit cars on weekdays in order to cut air pollution around schools.
ex.zh: 许多城市现在工作日限行，以减少学校周边的空气污染。

tip: 星期、具体日期用 on；钟点用 at，上午/年/月用 in。

senses.en: to say what something is like

ex.en: Can you describe the scene in detail?
ex.zh: 你能详细描述那个场景吗？

ex.en: The report describes how access to public parks influences physical activity among residents of crowded cities.
ex.zh: 该报告描述了公共公园的可达性如何影响人口密集城市居民的体育活动。

col: describe something in detail｜详细描述某事物
describe something as｜把某事物形容为
describe a process｜描述一个过程
tip: 说describe something to someone，不说describe someone something。

senses.en: in the role of, or while something happens
while, or because

ex.en: She works as a library assistant after school.
ex.zh: 她放学后在图书馆当助理。

ex.en: As cities grow, schools have to find new ways to give every child a safe route to class.
ex.zh: 随着城市扩大，学校必须找到新办法，让每个孩子都有安全的上学路线。

tip: as 可表示“作为”或“当……时”；like 更常用于口语中的“像”。

senses.en: the number 1, or a single person or thing
a single person or thing

ex.en: I need one more pencil for the test.
ex.zh: 我考试还需要一支铅笔。

ex.en: One reason cities plant trees along roads is that shade can lower the temperature in summer.
ex.zh: 城市沿路种树的一个原因是，树荫能降低夏天的气温。

tip: one of 后面接复数名词，谓语常用单数。

senses.en: to own, or to experience something
used with a past participle

ex.en: We have a maths test tomorrow.
ex.zh: 我们明天有一场数学测验。

ex.en: Students who have a regular place to study at home usually find it easier to start homework on time.
ex.zh: 家里有固定学习角落的学生，通常更容易按时开始写作业。

tip: have to do 表示客观上不得不；must 更强调主观认为必须。

senses.en: in this place

ex.en: Please wait here until your name is called.
ex.zh: 请在这里等到叫你的名字。

ex.en: Communities that plant trees here, along the hottest streets, can make walking to school safer.
ex.zh: 在最热的街道旁种树的社区，可以让步行上学更安全。

tip: Here is / Here are 后面的主语决定动词单复数。

senses.en: used to stress something surprising

ex.en: Even a short walk can clear your head.
ex.zh: 即使是短短的散步也能让头脑清醒。

ex.en: Even a rich city can have neighbourhoods where children have no safe park nearby.
ex.zh: 即使是富裕的城市，也可能有孩子附近没有安全公园的社区。

tip: even 放在所强调的词前；even if 后面接让步从句。

senses.en: to plan how something looks or works
the planning of something's appearance or function, or its plan
a decorative pattern on an object or surface

ex.en: They will design a new school logo.
ex.zh: 他们将设计一个新的校徽。

ex.en: Cities should design public spaces that encourage social interaction while remaining accessible to people with disabilities.
ex.zh: 城市应设计既能促进社交互动、又方便残障人士使用的公共空间。

col: be designed to do something｜旨在做某事
tip: be designed to do表示“旨在做……”。

senses.en: skill or power to do something

ex.en: Language ability grows with practice.
ex.zh: 语言能力随练习而增长。

ex.en: Regular reading can strengthen children's ability to understand complex ideas and express their own views clearly.
ex.zh: 经常阅读可以增强儿童理解复杂概念和清晰表达自身观点的能力。

col: the ability to learn｜学习能力
develop an ability｜培养一种能力
tip: 表示“做某事的能力”用ability to do。

senses.en: in fact, or very

ex.en: I really want to understand this poem.
ex.zh: 我真的想读懂这首诗。

ex.en: A programme is not really successful if only the students who already read a lot take part.
ex.zh: 如果只有本来就读得很多的学生参加，一个项目并不能算真正成功。

tip: really 修饰形容词或动词，强调程度或真实性。

senses.en: used for polite requests, habits, or imagined results

ex.en: Would you help me carry these books?
ex.zh: 你愿意帮我搬这些书吗？

ex.en: Many students would revise more calmly if tests were spread across the term instead of piled into one week.
ex.zh: 如果考试分散在整个学期，而不是堆在一周里，许多学生会复习得更从容。

tip: would like to do 是礼貌的“想要”；would rather do 表示宁愿。

senses.en: in addition

ex.en: She plays the piano and also sings in the choir.
ex.zh: 她弹钢琴，还在合唱团唱歌。

ex.en: Parks also reduce noise, which matters for schools built beside busy roads.
ex.zh: 公园还能降低噪音，这对建在繁忙道路旁的学校很重要。

tip: also 多放在句中；too 和 as well 多放在句末。

senses.en: in what way, or to what degree

ex.en: How do you spell your family name?
ex.zh: 你的姓怎么拼？

ex.en: How a city treats its rivers often shows how seriously it takes public health.
ex.zh: 一座城市如何对待河流，常常说明它有多重视公共健康。

tip: How 加形容词或副词构成感叹句；What 加名词。

senses.en: space between two points
A lack of emotional closeness between people
To separate yourself from someone, something, or their views

ex.en: Keep a safe distance from the fire.
ex.zh: 与火保持安全距离。

ex.en: Reducing the distance between residential areas and workplaces could lower transport emissions and improve urban quality of life.
ex.zh: 缩短住宅区与工作地点之间的距离，可以减少交通排放并改善城市生活质量。

tip: in the distance指在远处；at a distance指隔一段距离。

senses.en: for what reason

ex.en: Why is the lab closed this afternoon?
ex.zh: 实验室今天下午为什么关门？

ex.en: Understanding why a species disappears is the first step toward protecting the habitat it needs.
ex.zh: 弄清一个物种为何消失，是保护它所需栖息地的第一步。

col: that is why｜那就是为什么
tip: Why not do...? 用来提出建议，后面接动词原形。

senses.en: also, or more than enough

ex.en: This box is too heavy for one person.
ex.zh: 这个箱子一个人搬太重了。

ex.en: If tickets are too expensive, a museum built with public money will not serve the public.
ex.zh: 如果门票太贵，用公共资金建造的博物馆就服务不了公众。

tip: too...to do 表示太……而不能；also 不能放在这个结构里。

senses.en: power to work; power source
Power used to produce heat, movement, light, or electricity

ex.en: Young people have lots of energy.
ex.zh: 年轻人有很多精力。

ex.en: Investing in renewable energy can reduce dependence on fossil fuels while creating new employment opportunities.
ex.zh: 投资可再生能源可以减少对化石燃料的依赖，同时创造新的就业机会。

tip: 表示精力或能源时通常不可数，不说 an energy。

senses.en: a contest
An organised event in which people try to win.

ex.en: She won first prize in the competition.
ex.zh: 她在比赛中获得一等奖。

ex.en: Competition between businesses can lower prices, but effective regulation is needed to protect consumers from unfair practices.
ex.zh: 企业间的竞争可以降低价格，但仍需有效监管来保护消费者免受不公平商业行为的侵害。

tip: 表示竞争通常不可数；表示一场比赛时可数。

senses.en: to talk about
to examine a subject in speech or writing

ex.en: Let's discuss the plan after lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭后我们讨论一下计划。

ex.en: Students should discuss different solutions before deciding how to reduce waste on their campus.
ex.zh: 学生应先讨论不同的解决办法，再决定如何减少校园垃圾。

col: discuss something with someone｜与某人讨论某事
tip: 直接接讨论内容：discuss sth，不加about。

senses.en: to find for the first time

ex.en: Scientists discover new planets every year.
ex.zh: 科学家每年都发现新行星。

ex.en: Scientists may discover new ways to treat diseases by studying plants in tropical forests.
ex.zh: 科学家可能通过研究热带森林中的植物，发现治疗疾病的新方法。

col: discover a new species｜发现新物种
tip: discover发现原本存在的事物；invent创造新事物。

senses.en: to move or travel to a place

ex.en: We go to the stadium on Friday afternoons.
ex.zh: 我们周五下午去体育馆。

ex.en: If food prices go up too quickly, families may buy less fresh fruit for their children.
ex.zh: 如果食品价格涨得太快，家庭可能会给孩子少买新鲜水果。

tip: go 的过去式是 went，过去分词是 gone。

senses.en: using electricity
Full of excitement and energy.

ex.en: electric cars produce less smoke.
ex.zh: 电动汽车产生更少烟雾。

ex.en: Electric buses can reduce urban air pollution, especially when their power comes from renewable sources.
ex.zh: 电动公交车可以减少城市空气污染，尤其是在使用可再生能源供电时。

tip: 电动设备多用electric；电气系统多用electrical。

senses.en: easy to use or reach
Situated close to somewhere you need to reach.

ex.en: Online payment is convenient.
ex.zh: 在线支付很方便。

ex.en: Online learning offers a convenient way for working adults to develop skills without travelling to a campus.
ex.zh: 在线学习为在职成年人提供了无需前往校园就能提升技能的便捷途径。

col: a convenient way to｜做……的便捷方式
tip: 说 It is convenient for me，不说 I am convenient。

senses.en: busy doing things
currently working or producing an effect
describing a verb whose subject performs the action

ex.en: Stay active after school.
ex.zh: 放学后保持活跃。

ex.en: Schools should encourage an active lifestyle to improve students' physical health and overall wellbeing.
ex.zh: 学校应鼓励积极运动的生活方式，以改善学生的身体健康和整体身心状态。

col: an active lifestyle｜积极运动的生活方式
play an active role｜发挥积极作用
tip: active指积极活动或参与；不等于表示乐观的positive。

senses.en: at what time, or at the time that

ex.en: When does the library close tonight?
ex.zh: 图书馆今晚什么时候关门？

ex.en: When young people only meet friends online, they may lose practice in reading faces and tones.
ex.zh: 当年轻人只在网上见朋友时，他们可能缺少辨认表情和语气的练习。

tip: when 引导时间状语从句时，从句常用一般现在时表将来。

senses.en: to need support; to be decided by
to need or trust someone or something for support

ex.en: Success may depend on hard work.
ex.zh: 成功可能取决于努力。

ex.en: Many rural communities depend on reliable public transport to access healthcare, education, and employment opportunities.
ex.zh: 许多农村社区依靠可靠的公共交通来获得医疗、教育和就业机会。

col: depend on someone to do something｜指望某人做某事
tip: 常接on或upon；It depends意为“看情况”。

senses.en: to notice with the eyes, or to understand

ex.en: I can see the playground from this window.
ex.zh: 我从这扇窗户能看见操场。

ex.en: When people see the cost of wasted food, they are more willing to change what they buy.
ex.zh: 当人们看到浪费食物的代价时，他们更愿意改变购买习惯。

tip: see 强调看见的结果；look 强调看的动作；watch 强调持续观看。

senses.en: later than a time or event
at a later time than

ex.en: We clean the lab after each experiment.
ex.zh: 每次实验后我们都打扫实验室。

ex.en: After a major flood, schools may have to share buildings until their own classrooms are safe again.
ex.zh: 大洪水之后，学校可能不得不共用校舍，直到自己的教室再次安全。

tip: after 是介词或连词；副词“后来”常用 afterwards 或 later。

senses.en: to grow or improve
to create a new product, method, or idea
to begin to have a condition, problem, or feeling

ex.en: Reading helps develop your vocabulary.
ex.zh: 阅读有助于培养词汇量。

ex.en: Governments should fund research to develop affordable technologies that address water shortages in rural communities.
ex.zh: 政府应资助研究，开发价格可负担的技术，以解决农村社区的缺水问题。

tip: 可及物也可不及物：develop skills；skills develop。

senses.en: in or to what place

ex.en: Where did you leave your sports shoes?
ex.zh: 你把运动鞋放在哪儿了？

ex.en: Cities need places where teenagers can meet without having to spend money.
ex.zh: 城市需要一些地方，让青少年不必花钱也能见面。

tip: where 引导地点状语或定语从句，先行词是地点。

senses.en: the way things are not the same
A disagreement between people or groups
The amount by which one quantity exceeds another

ex.en: Age makes little difference in friendship.
ex.zh: 年龄在友谊中几乎没有差异。

ex.en: Understanding cultural differences can help international students adapt more successfully to life in a new country.
ex.zh: 了解文化差异有助于留学生更顺利地适应新国家的生活。

tip: 比较两者用the difference between A and B。

senses.en: in that place

ex.en: There is a new poster on the back wall.
ex.zh: 后墙上有一张新海报。

ex.en: There are still towns where the nearest hospital is more than an hour away by bus.
ex.zh: 仍有一些城镇，乘公交到最近的医院要一个多小时。

tip: There be 句中，be 的单复数跟后面真正的主语走。

senses.en: useful
Willing to help other people.

ex.en: Your notes were very helpful.
ex.zh: 你的笔记很有帮助。

ex.en: Clear feedback is particularly helpful for students who are learning to organise their ideas in academic essays.
ex.zh: 对于正在学习如何组织学术论文思路的学生来说，清晰的反馈尤其有帮助。

col: find something helpful｜觉得某物有帮助
tip: helpful可形容事物有用，也可形容人乐于助人。

senses.en: an illness

ex.en: Clean water helps prevent disease.
ex.zh: 干净的水有助于预防疾病。

ex.en: Access to clean drinking water can significantly reduce the spread of infectious diseases in vulnerable communities.
ex.zh: 获得清洁饮用水可以显著减少传染病在脆弱社区中的传播。

col: the spread of disease｜疾病传播
tip: 重音在第二音节；泛指疾病可不加冠词。

senses.en: to stop a planned event
To balance an opposing effect so neither changes the result.

ex.en: They had to cancel the trip because of rain.
ex.zh: 因为下雨他们不得不取消旅行。

ex.en: Improved energy efficiency may cancel out some environmental benefits if it encourages people to consume more.
ex.zh: 如果能源效率提高促使人们增加消费，就可能抵消部分环境效益。

tip: 英式过去式cancelled，美式常用canceled；抵消用out。

senses.en: a period of twelve months

ex.en: This is my second year at this school.
ex.zh: 这是我在这所学校的第二年。

ex.en: A dry year can raise food prices, which hits families who already spend most of their income on meals.
ex.zh: 干旱的一年会推高食品价格，打击那些收入大部分已用于吃饭的家庭。

col: all the year round｜一年到头
tip: 在哪一年用 in：in 2024。

senses.en: between countries
A match between countries, or a player representing a country.

ex.en: English is an international language.
ex.zh: 英语是一门国际语言。

ex.en: International cooperation is essential for tackling environmental problems that extend beyond the borders of individual countries.
ex.zh: 国际合作对于解决超越单个国家边界的环境问题至关重要。

tip: international涉及多国；domestic指国内的。

senses.en: earlier than
earlier than the time when

ex.en: Please wash your hands before lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭前请洗手。

ex.en: Cities should test their flood plans before the rainy season, not after the first street is under water.
ex.zh: 城市应该在雨季之前检验防汛方案，而不是等第一条街被淹之后。

tip: before 可作介词、连词或副词。

senses.en: to carry, to need time, or to do an exam or trip

ex.en: It takes me twenty minutes to walk to school.
ex.zh: 我步行上学要二十分钟。

ex.en: It can take a generation to repair a forest that was cut down in a single decade.
ex.zh: 修复一片十年内被砍光的森林，可能需要一代人的时间。

tip: It takes sb time to do 表示花时间；spend 的主语是人。

senses.en: the way to go; guidance
instructions explaining how to reach somewhere or do something
the control or guidance of an activity or group

ex.en: Ask for direction if you get lost.
ex.zh: 迷路了就问路。

ex.en: Government investment can influence the direction of technological development by supporting research into cleaner energy sources.
ex.zh: 政府投资可以通过支持清洁能源研究来影响技术发展的方向。

col: in the opposite direction｜朝相反方向
under the direction of｜在……的指导下
tip: 表示路线指引或操作说明时，通常用复数directions。

senses.en: very surprising

ex.en: What an amazing view from the hill!
ex.zh: 山顶的景色多么令人惊奇！

ex.en: Recent medical research has produced amazing results, offering new hope to patients with previously untreatable conditions.
ex.zh: 近期医学研究取得了惊人的成果，为患有过去无法治疗的疾病的患者带来了新希望。

col: an amazing experience｜一次奇妙的经历
tip: amazing形容令人惊叹的事物；amazed形容人的感受。

senses.en: to create, or to cause something to happen

ex.en: We make posters for the book fair.
ex.zh: 我们为书展制作海报。

ex.en: Noise from a busy road can make it difficult for children to concentrate in class.
ex.zh: 繁忙道路的噪音会让孩子很难在课堂上集中注意力。

tip: make sb do 不带 to；被动式则是 be made to do。

senses.en: to take or agree to something offered
Recognize that something is true or valid
Take responsibility or stop resisting an unpleasant situation

ex.en: She decided to accept the job offer.
ex.zh: 她决定接受这份工作邀约。

ex.en: Governments must accept responsibility for ensuring that all children have access to basic education.
ex.zh: 政府必须承担责任，确保所有儿童都能接受基础教育。

tip: 接受建议用accept；接受某物不等于仅仅收到receive。

senses.en: simple and most important
Having only necessary features, without anything extra.

ex.en: Learn the basic rules first.
ex.zh: 先学基本规则。

ex.en: Governments should ensure that all citizens have access to basic healthcare, regardless of their income.
ex.zh: 政府应确保所有公民都能获得基本医疗服务，不论其收入如何。

tip: 名词“基础知识”用复数 the basics。

senses.en: to the place where someone or something was before
the rear part of the body or of an object

ex.en: I will be back before the bell rings.
ex.zh: 我会在铃响前回来。

ex.en: Bringing back local markets can give neighbourhoods a place to meet as well as a place to shop.
ex.zh: 恢复本地集市不仅提供购物的地方，也给社区一个见面的地方。

tip: back 作副词不需要介词：go back home，不要说 go back to home。

senses.en: to let someone do something
to make something possible
to provide enough time or resources for something

ex.en: Parents should allow kids to make choices.
ex.zh: 父母应允许孩子做选择。

ex.en: Flexible working arrangements allow employees to balance their professional responsibilities with family commitments more effectively.
ex.zh: 灵活的工作安排使员工能够更有效地兼顾工作职责与家庭义务。

col: allow someone to do something｜允许某人做某事
allow enough time｜留出足够时间
allow for delays｜考虑到可能的延误
tip: 用allow sb to do；无宾语时可用allow doing。

senses.en: continuing until now

ex.en: She is still in the library.
ex.zh: 她还在图书馆。

ex.en: Many rural schools still share one science teacher among several classes.
ex.zh: 许多乡村学校仍然是几个班共用一位科学老师。

tip: still 多用于肯定句表示还在继续；yet 多用于否定和疑问，表示尚未。

senses.en: to ruin completely
To completely end something valuable, such as trust or hope.

ex.en: Fire can destroy a whole forest.
ex.zh: 大火能摧毁整片森林。

ex.en: Uncontrolled urban expansion can destroy natural habitats and threaten the survival of species that depend on them.
ex.zh: 不受控制的城市扩张会摧毁自然栖息地，威胁依赖这些栖息地的物种生存。

tip: destroy比damage程度重，通常指彻底毁坏。

senses.en: the ones farther away or already mentioned

ex.en: Those bags by the door are for the trip.
ex.zh: 门边的那些包是出行用的。

ex.en: Those who grow up near parks are more likely to spend time outside as adults.
ex.zh: 在公园附近长大的人，成年后更可能把时间花在户外。

tip: those 是 that 的复数。those who 后接复数含义的谓语。

senses.en: after that, or at that time

ex.en: We finished the quiz and then checked the answers.
ex.zh: 我们做完小测，然后核对了答案。

ex.en: If a river is polluted, the fish leave, and then the birds that feed on them leave too.
ex.zh: 如果一条河被污染，鱼会离开，接着以鱼为食的鸟也会离开。

tip: then 是“然后、那时”；比较级后面的“比”是 than。

senses.en: minutes and hours, or an occasion

ex.en: We do not have much time before class.
ex.zh: 上课前我们没有多少时间了。

ex.en: Screen time late at night can reduce the hours of deep sleep that teenagers need.
ex.zh: 深夜的屏幕时间会减少青少年所需的深度睡眠。

tip: time 表示时间通常不可数；表示次数或时代时可数，如 three times、modern times。

senses.en: to obtain, become, or arrive

ex.en: I get home at about six.
ex.zh: 我大约六点到家。

ex.en: Students who get enough daylight during the day often find it easier to fall asleep at night.
ex.zh: 白天接受足够日光的学生，往往更容易在夜里入睡。

tip: get 加形容词表示变化：get tired。上车用 get on，小汽车也可用 get into。

senses.en: level; a university title
the amount or level of something
a unit used to measure temperature or angles

ex.en: To some degree, luck plays a role.
ex.zh: 在某种程度上，运气起作用。

ex.en: Although a university degree can improve employment prospects, practical experience remains highly valuable in many industries.
ex.zh: 虽然大学学位能改善就业前景，但实践经验在许多行业仍然十分重要。

col: a degree in economics｜经济学学位
to some degree｜在某种程度上
tip: 某专业的学位用a degree in；程度义常见to some degree。

senses.en: the way someone acts
the way a substance or system acts under particular conditions

ex.en: Good behavior is expected in class.
ex.zh: 课堂上期望有良好行为。

ex.en: Schools can encourage responsible behavior by giving students meaningful opportunities to participate in decisions affecting their community.
ex.zh: 学校可以让学生有实质性机会参与影响其社区的决策，以此鼓励负责任的行为。

tip: 美式拼写；英式为behaviour。通常不可数。

senses.en: able to be used or free
Not busy and able to meet or help someone.

ex.en: Is the book available in the library?
ex.zh: 图书馆有这本书吗？

ex.en: Affordable housing should be available to all residents, regardless of their income or employment status.
ex.zh: 所有居民都应能获得负担得起的住房，不论其收入或就业状况如何。

col: available to everyone｜人人都可获得的
make something available｜使某物可供使用
tip: available to接使用者；available for接用途。

senses.en: towards a higher place, or completely

ex.en: Please pick up the paper on the floor.
ex.zh: 请把地上的纸捡起来。

ex.en: Cleaning up a river takes years, but students can still start by sorting waste at school.
ex.zh: 清理一条河要花很多年，但学生仍可以从学校垃圾分类做起。

tip: 许多动词加 up 表示完成或向上，如 eat up、stand up。

senses.en: taking care to avoid mistakes
giving close attention to details

ex.en: Be careful when you cross the road.
ex.zh: 过马路要小心。

ex.en: Careful planning can help cities expand public transport while keeping construction costs under control.
ex.zh: 周密的规划可以帮助城市扩展公共交通，同时控制建设成本。

tip: be careful with后接物；be careful to后接动词。

senses.en: a large amount, used with uncountable nouns

ex.en: There is not much time left.
ex.zh: 剩下的时间不多了。

ex.en: Too much packaging makes recycling harder, even when the food inside is necessary.
ex.zh: 过多的包装会让回收更难，即使里面的食物是必需的。

tip: much 修饰不可数名词；可数名词用 many。

senses.en: an opinion about what to do

ex.en: Thank you for your useful advice.
ex.zh: 谢谢你有用的建议。

ex.en: Schools should provide practical career advice so that students can make informed decisions about their future.
ex.zh: 学校应提供实用的职业建议，让学生能够对自己的未来作出明智决定。

col: a piece of advice｜一条建议
tip: 不可数，不用an advice；动词advise末尾读/z/。

senses.en: very good

ex.en: She did an excellent job.
ex.zh: 她做得非常出色。

ex.en: Excellent public transport can reduce car dependence and make cities more accessible to all residents.
ex.zh: 优质的公共交通可以减少人们对汽车的依赖，让所有居民出行更便利。

tip: 已含“极好”之意，通常不用very修饰。

senses.en: the ones near the speaker

ex.en: These chairs belong to the music room.
ex.zh: 这些椅子是音乐教室的。

ex.en: These figures do not include students who study at home, so the total may be higher.
ex.zh: 这些数字不包括在家学习的学生，所以总数可能更高。

tip: these 是 this 的复数，指较近的人或物。

senses.en: a choice made

ex.en: Making a decision can take time.
ex.zh: 做决定可能需要时间。

ex.en: Governments should base every major transport decision on reliable evidence and consultation with the communities affected.
ex.zh: 政府的每项重大交通决策都应以可靠证据及与受影响社区的协商为基础。

col: informed decision｜基于充分了解的决定
tip: 作决定用make a decision，不用do。

senses.en: not at any time

ex.en: I have never been to the science museum.
ex.zh: 我从没去过科学博物馆。

ex.en: A city should never treat clean water as something only wealthy neighbourhoods can expect.
ex.zh: 一座城市绝不该把干净的水看成只有富裕社区才能指望的东西。

tip: never 放在助动词后、实义动词前；位于句首时句子要倒装。

senses.en: to become visible; to seem
To seem to be a certain way.
To take part in a performance or attend court formally.

ex.en: A rainbow may appear after the rain.
ex.zh: 雨后可能会出现彩虹。

ex.en: Online courses appear to offer greater flexibility, although some learners still prefer traditional classroom interaction.
ex.zh: 网络课程似乎提供了更大的灵活性，但一些学习者仍更喜欢传统课堂互动。

tip: 表“似乎”可接形容词或to do；不能直接接宾语。

senses.en: of a particular area
a person who lives in a particular area
affecting only a limited part of something

ex.en: Buy local food when you can.
ex.zh: 尽可能买当地食物。

ex.en: Supporting local businesses can strengthen community ties and keep more money circulating within the regional economy.
ex.zh: 支持本地企业可以加强社区联系，并让更多资金在区域经济内部流通。

tip: 名词复数locals指当地人；locally是副词。

senses.en: to have information, or to be familiar with someone

ex.en: I know the answer, but I cannot explain it yet.
ex.zh: 我知道答案，但还解释不清。

ex.en: Students who know how to question a chart are less likely to be misled by a dramatic headline.
ex.zh: 知道如何质疑一张图表的学生，不太会被夸张的标题误导。

col: as far as I know｜据我所知
tip: know 后面不接不定式表示“知道去做”，要用 know how to do。

senses.en: to plan or put in order
Put things in a particular order or position.

ex.en: Please arrange the books on the shelf.
ex.zh: 请把书架上的书整理好。

ex.en: Schools can arrange visits to local businesses to help students understand the practical demands of different careers.
ex.zh: 学校可以安排学生参观当地企业，帮助他们了解不同职业的实际要求。

col: arrange for someone to do something｜安排某人做某事
tip: 安排某人做某事用arrange for sb to do。

senses.en: to make something new
to cause a situation, feeling, or problem to develop

ex.en: Artists create works that move people.
ex.zh: 艺术家创作打动人心的作品。

ex.en: Investment in renewable energy can create jobs while reducing dependence on imported fossil fuels.
ex.zh: 投资可再生能源能创造就业机会，同时减少对进口化石燃料的依赖。

col: create a work of art｜创作艺术作品
tip: create强调创造新事物，也可接problem表示造成问题。

senses.en: very old
having existed for a very long time

ex.en: We visited an ancient temple.
ex.zh: 我们参观了一座古庙。

ex.en: Studying ancient civilisations helps researchers understand how early societies managed water, trade, and public health.
ex.zh: 研究古代文明有助于研究人员了解早期社会如何管理用水、贸易和公共卫生。

tip: ancient强调年代久远，不宜代替一般的old。

senses.en: a quantity
To total something or be equivalent to it.

ex.en: A large amount of rain fell last night.
ex.zh: 昨晚下了大量的雨。

ex.en: Reducing the amount of food wasted by households could significantly lower the environmental impact of food production.
ex.zh: 减少家庭食物浪费量可以显著降低食品生产对环境的影响。

tip: amount of接不可数名词；动词常用amount to。

senses.en: used to ask for information

ex.en: What did the teacher say about the quiz?
ex.zh: 老师关于小测说了什么？

ex.en: What a community chooses to protect, whether a park or a dialect, shows what it values.
ex.zh: 一个社区选择保护什么，无论是公园还是方言，都显示它看重什么。

tip: 感叹句 What a/an + 名词；How 后面接形容词或副词。

senses.en: a period of 24 hours, or the time when it is light

ex.en: We have a fire drill on the first day of term.
ex.zh: 学期第一天我们有消防演习。

ex.en: A heatwave can turn an ordinary school day into a health risk for students in rooms without fans.
ex.zh: 热浪会把普通的上学日变成健康风险，尤其是没有风扇的教室。

tip: on 加具体的某一天；in the day 表示在白天。

senses.en: to the inside of, or so as to become

ex.en: She walked into the hall with the register.
ex.zh: 她拿着点名册走进大厅。

ex.en: Old factories can be turned into museums, which keeps the story of a town visible.
ex.zh: 旧工厂可以改成博物馆，让一座城镇的故事仍然看得见。

tip: into 强调进入的过程；in 强调在里面的状态。

senses.en: human beings in general

ex.en: Many people wait for the bus in the rain.
ex.zh: 许多人在雨里等公交。

ex.en: Older people in a neighbourhood can help children feel safe on the walk home from school.
ex.zh: 社区里的老人可以帮助孩子在放学路上感到安全。

tip: people 本身是复数；一个人用 a person 或 one person。

senses.en: of present times
Using the latest ideas, methods, or styles.

ex.en: modern technology changes life.
ex.zh: 现代科技改变生活。

ex.en: Modern technology allows students in remote areas to access educational resources previously available only in cities.
ex.zh: 现代技术让偏远地区的学生能够获取过去只有城市才有的教育资源。

tip: modern强调现代或新式；不一定表示刚刚制造。

senses.en: completely correct
Demand and obtain something, often through authority or force.

ex.en: What is the exact time?
ex.zh: 确切时间是几点？

ex.en: Researchers need exact measurements to determine whether changes in air quality are linked to new transport policies.
ex.zh: 研究人员需要精确的测量数据，以判断空气质量变化是否与新的交通政策有关。

col: exact copy｜完全相同的复制品
exact a heavy toll｜造成惨重损失
tip: exact强调分毫不差；副词形式为exactly。

senses.en: to wish for something

ex.en: I want to join the school choir.
ex.zh: 我想参加学校合唱团。

ex.en: Not every teenager wants a career that looks impressive; many want work that feels useful.
ex.zh: 并非每个青少年都想要一份看起来光鲜的职业；许多人想要感觉有用的工作。

col: want sb to do｜想让某人做
tip: want 后面接 to do，不接 doing 表示想要做某事。

senses.en: to look at differences and similarities
To describe something as similar to another thing.
To be as good as, or similar to, something else.

ex.en: Please compare these two essays carefully.
ex.zh: 请仔细比较这两篇文章。

ex.en: Researchers should compare the long-term costs of renewable energy with those of traditional power sources.
ex.zh: 研究人员应比较可再生能源与传统能源的长期成本。

col: compare A with B｜将A与B比较
compare A to B｜将A比作B；比较A和B
compare favourably with｜比起来不逊于
tip: 比较可用with或to；表示比喻时通常用to。

senses.en: used to ask which person, or to refer to a person

ex.en: Who is the boy standing by the window?
ex.zh: 站在窗边的男孩是谁？

ex.en: Students who sleep less than seven hours are more likely to feel sleepy in the first lesson.
ex.zh: 睡眠少于七小时的学生更可能在第一节课犯困。

tip: 先行词是人时用 who；物用 which 或 that。

senses.en: to have an opinion, or to use one's mind

ex.en: I think the second answer is better.
ex.zh: 我认为第二个答案更好。

ex.en: People tend to think a problem is simple until they have to explain it to someone else.
ex.zh: 人们往往觉得一个问题很简单，直到必须把它讲给别人听。

tip: think of 常表示想起；think about 表示正在考虑。

senses.en: in a good or thorough way
in good health

ex.en: She explains grammar well.
ex.zh: 她语法讲得很好。

ex.en: A team that listens well can solve a problem faster than a team of people who all talk at once.
ex.zh: 善于倾听的团队，能比所有人同时说话的团队更快解决问题。

tip: well 修饰动词；good 修饰名词。身体好也用 well。

senses.en: tools needed for a task

ex.en: The lab has modern equipment.
ex.zh: 实验室有现代化设备。

ex.en: Schools need suitable laboratory equipment to give students practical experience and encourage an interest in science.
ex.zh: 学校需要合适的实验室设备，让学生获得实践经验并培养科学兴趣。

col: a piece of equipment｜一件设备
tip: 不可数；一件设备说a piece of equipment。

senses.en: to disagree in words; to claim
To give reasons supporting an opinion or position.

ex.en: They often argue about small things.
ex.zh: 他们经常为小事争论。

ex.en: Some researchers argue that affordable public transport is essential for reducing inequality in large cities.
ex.zh: 一些研究者认为，价格可负担的公共交通对于减少大城市中的不平等至关重要。

tip: argue that常用于议论文，表示提出有理由的主张。

senses.en: not existing before, or recently arrived

ex.en: There is a new clock in the reading room.
ex.zh: 阅览室里有一座新钟。

ex.en: A new bus line can change which school a family is able to choose.
ex.zh: 一条新公交线路会改变一个家庭能够选择的学校。

tip: news 是不可数名词，不是 new 的复数。

senses.en: one, some, or every, often in questions and negatives

ex.en: Do you have any questions about the homework?
ex.zh: 作业方面你有什么问题吗？

ex.en: Any plan to cut traffic must also consider how students travel when buses are full.
ex.zh: 任何减少交通的计划，都必须考虑公交拥挤时学生怎么上学。

tip: 肯定句里的“一些”常用 some；any 多用于疑问句、否定句或“任何”。

senses.en: used to say what is right or sensible

ex.en: You should check the name on the paper.
ex.zh: 你应该核对试卷上的姓名。

ex.en: Governments should publish clear data if they ask citizens to change the way they travel.
ex.zh: 如果政府要求公民改变出行方式，就应该公布清晰的数据。

tip: should 表示建议或责任，后面接动词原形。

senses.en: the natural world around us
The conditions and surroundings in which someone lives or works.

ex.en: We must protect the environment.
ex.zh: 我们必须保护环境。

ex.en: A supportive learning environment can improve students' confidence and encourage them to participate more actively.
ex.zh: 支持性的学习环境能够增强学生的信心，鼓励他们更加积极地参与。

tip: 泛指自然环境常用the environment。

senses.en: at the present time

ex.en: The shop is closed now.
ex.zh: 商店现在关门了。

ex.en: Cities that act now on rubbish sorting will spend less later on cleaning land and water.
ex.zh: 现在就开始垃圾分类的城市，以后在清理土地和水体上的花费会更少。

tip: just now 常与过去时连用，表示刚才。

senses.en: words that tell what something is like

ex.en: Write a short description of your hometown.
ex.zh: 写一段对家乡的简短描述。

ex.en: A clear description of research methods allows other scientists to evaluate the reliability of a study.
ex.zh: 清楚描述研究方法，有助于其他科学家评估研究的可靠性。

col: a job description｜岗位职责说明
tip: 表示对某物的描述，用a description of，不用about。

senses.en: a reason; a movement to support
make something happen, especially something unpleasant
an aim or principle that people support and work towards

ex.en: Pollution is a major cause of illness.
ex.zh: 污染是疾病的一个主要原因。

ex.en: Heavy traffic is a major cause of air pollution in many rapidly growing urban areas.
ex.zh: 在许多快速发展的城市地区，繁忙的交通是空气污染的主要原因。

tip: 名词常接of；动词可用cause sb to do sth。

senses.en: nearly all, or to the greatest degree

ex.en: Most students walk or cycle to school.
ex.zh: 大多数学生步行或骑车上学。

ex.en: The most effective rules are the ones people understand, not the ones that are only posted on a wall.
ex.zh: 最有效的规则是人们理解的那些，而不只是贴在墙上的那些。

tip: most 直接加名词表示大多数；the most 用于最高级。

senses.en: different from the one already mentioned

ex.en: The other books are still on the shelf.
ex.zh: 其余的书还在书架上。

ex.en: Other factors, such as noise and light, can affect sleep as much as the hour a student goes to bed.
ex.zh: 其他因素，比如噪音和光线，对睡眠的影响可以和上床时间一样大。

tip: the other 指两者中的另一个；another 指再一个、不确定的另一个。

senses.en: to make a choice
To determine the result of something.

ex.en: We must decide where to go.
ex.zh: 我们必须决定去哪里。

ex.en: Governments must decide how to distribute limited resources between healthcare, education and public transport.
ex.zh: 政府必须决定如何在医疗、教育和公共交通之间分配有限资源。

col: decide to do something｜决定做某事
tip: 用decide to do，不用decide doing。

senses.en: for the reason that

ex.en: I stayed behind because I had a club meeting.
ex.zh: 我留下了，因为我有社团会议。

ex.en: Some streets flood because the drains were built for a smaller town than the one that exists today.
ex.zh: 有些街道会积水，是因为排水系统是按比今天更小的城镇修建的。

tip: because 后接句子；because of 后接名词或短语。

senses.en: correct, or on the right side
the right side, or something one is allowed to have
exactly, or immediately

ex.en: You got the right answer on the first try.
ex.zh: 你第一次就选对了。

ex.en: The right to a quiet night's sleep is hard to protect when a city never turns its lights down.
ex.zh: 当一座城市从不调暗灯光时，安静睡眠的权利就很难保障。

tip: right 还可作名词，表示权利：the right to do。

senses.en: used when comparing

ex.en: This bag is heavier than mine.
ex.zh: 这个包比我的重。

ex.en: Cycling to school can be faster than taking a crowded bus in the morning rush.
ex.zh: 上学骑车有时比早高峰挤公交更快。

tip: 比较级后面用 than，不要用 then。then 是“然后”。

senses.en: away from a place, or not operating

ex.en: Please turn off the lights when you leave.
ex.zh: 离开时请把灯关掉。

ex.en: Taking a day off can prevent a small illness from becoming a week away from school.
ex.zh: 休息一天可以避免小病变成离校一周。

tip: off 常与动词组成短语，含义要整词记忆，如 put off 是推迟。

senses.en: to keep away from
to stay away from someone or something

ex.en: Try to avoid eating too much sugar.
ex.zh: 尽量避免吃太多糖。

ex.en: Cities should improve public transport to avoid further increases in traffic congestion and air pollution.
ex.zh: 城市应改善公共交通，以避免交通拥堵和空气污染进一步加剧。

tip: 后接名词或动名词：avoid doing，不用to do。

senses.en: to do a job, or to function
a job, or something produced

ex.en: The printer does not work this morning.
ex.zh: 打印机今天早上不工作。

ex.en: Long hours of paid work can leave older students too tired to review what they learned.
ex.zh: 长时间的有偿工作会让高年级学生累得无法复习所学内容。

tip: work 表示工作不可数；a job 才是一份工作。

senses.en: used for ability, possibility, or a polite request

ex.en: Could you pass me the dictionary?
ex.zh: 你能把词典递给我吗？

ex.en: Cities could cut morning traffic if more students were able to walk to a nearby school.
ex.zh: 如果更多学生能步行去附近的学校，城市就能减少早高峰的车流。

tip: 委婉请求用 Could you...?；过去有能力做成某件具体的事常用 was able to。

senses.en: to a high degree

ex.en: The reading room is very quiet after four.
ex.zh: 四点以后阅览室非常安静。

ex.en: A very small change in a timetable can affect thousands of students who share the same buses.
ex.zh: 时刻表上一个很小的改动，也会影响共用同一批公交的数千名学生。

tip: very 修饰形容词和副词原级，不修饰比较级；比较级用 much 或 far。

senses.en: a greater amount or degree

ex.en: I need more time to check the answers.
ex.zh: 我需要更多时间检查答案。

ex.en: Cities that build more bike lanes often find that short car trips become less necessary.
ex.zh: 修建更多自行车道的城市常常发现，短途开车变得不那么必要。

tip: 多音节形容词的比较级用 more，不要再加 -er。

senses.en: to perform an action, or to support a verb

ex.en: I do my homework at the kitchen table.
ex.zh: 我在厨房桌上做作业。

ex.en: People who do voluntary work at weekends often report a stronger sense of belonging.
ex.zh: 周末做志愿工作的人常常说自己更有归属感。

tip: do 常接具体活动；make 多接制作或产生的结果，如 make a mistake。

senses.en: sure; particular
definitely going to happen
particular but not named or fully described

ex.en: I am certain that she will come.
ex.zh: 我确定她会来。

ex.en: Certain types of public transport are more suitable for densely populated cities than rural areas.
ex.zh: 某些类型的公共交通更适合人口密集的城市，而非农村地区。

tip: 人作主语时，certain of表确信；certain to表必然。

senses.en: an amount or number that is not exact

ex.en: There is some hot water in the thermos.
ex.zh: 暖瓶里有一些热水。

ex.en: Some schools now start later so that teenagers can sleep through the early morning.
ex.zh: 一些学校现在推迟上课，以便青少年能睡过清晨。

tip: 肯定句和礼貌请求常用 some；疑问和否定常用 any。

senses.en: used to choose, or to add information about a thing

ex.en: Which bus goes to the museum?
ex.zh: 哪路公交车去博物馆？

ex.en: Plastic bags, which are used for only a few minutes, can remain in the soil for decades.
ex.zh: 只用几分钟的塑料袋，却可能在土壤里留几十年。

tip: 非限制性定语从句说明事物时用 which，不用 that。

senses.en: a method, or a route

ex.en: This is a simple way to remember the word.
ex.zh: 这是记住这个词的简单方法。

ex.en: One way to reduce waste is to repair clothes and phones instead of replacing them at once.
ex.zh: 减少浪费的一个办法是修理衣服和手机，而不是立刻更换。

tip: way to do 和 way of doing 都可以表示做某事的方式。

senses.en: to require something
something that is necessary

ex.en: I need a quiet hour before the exam.
ex.zh: 考试前我需要一小时安静的时间。

ex.en: Growing cities need more than new buildings; they need schools, clinics, and clean air.
ex.zh: 成长中的城市需要的不只是新楼，还需要学校、诊所和干净的空气。

col: there is no need｜没有必要
tip: need doing 表示某物需要被做，如 The clock needs repairing。

senses.en: above, across, or more than
finished, or across

ex.en: A bridge goes over the river behind the school.
ex.zh: 学校后面有一座桥跨过河。

ex.en: Over the past decade, more families have moved to cities in search of better schools and hospitals.
ex.zh: 过去十年里，更多家庭搬到城市，以寻找更好的学校和医院。

tip: over 可以表示正上方或越过；above 多表示位置更高，不一定垂直。

senses.en: to join or link
to recognize or establish a relationship between things
to develop a good relationship with someone

ex.en: Roads connect the village to the city.
ex.zh: 公路把村庄与城市连接起来。

ex.en: New rail services can connect rural communities with cities, improving access to education and employment.
ex.zh: 新的铁路服务可以连接农村社区与城市，让人们更容易获得教育和就业机会。

col: connect to the internet｜连接互联网
connect A with B｜把A与B联系起来
connect with people｜与人建立联系
tip: 连接设备常用connect A to B。

senses.en: very big

ex.en: They made a huge effort.
ex.zh: 他们付出了巨大努力。

ex.en: Investing in public transport could bring huge benefits to cities struggling with congestion and air pollution.
ex.zh: 对于饱受交通拥堵和空气污染困扰的城市，投资公共交通可以带来巨大益处。

tip: 本身表示极大，常用absolutely huge加强语气。

senses.en: a large number, used with countable nouns

ex.en: Many students bring their own water bottles.
ex.zh: 许多学生自带水瓶。

ex.en: Many of the jobs that will exist in twenty years do not have names yet.
ex.zh: 二十年后将存在的许多工作，现在还没有名称。

tip: many 修饰可数名词复数；不可数用 much。

senses.en: an unexpected harmful event
Something that happens without being planned or intended.

ex.en: A car accident blocked the road.
ex.zh: 一起车祸堵住了道路。

ex.en: Better street lighting can reduce the risk of accidents involving cyclists and pedestrians at night.
ex.zh: 改善街道照明可以降低夜间涉及骑车人和行人的事故风险。

col: a road accident｜道路交通事故
tip: by accident表示无意中，反义短语是on purpose。

senses.en: used for possibility or permission

ex.en: It may rain before the match ends.
ex.zh: 比赛结束前可能会下雨。

ex.en: A new rule may look fair on paper but still hurt families who live far from the school.
ex.zh: 一条新规则在纸面上可能显得公平，却仍会伤害住得离学校很远的家庭。

tip: may be 是“可能是”；maybe 是一个副词，不能分开写。

senses.en: away from the inside

ex.en: The cat ran out of the classroom.
ex.zh: 猫从教室里跑了出去。

ex.en: Finding out who wrote a post is harder online, where names can be changed in a minute.
ex.zh: 在网上查明一篇帖子是谁写的更难，因为名字可以随时更换。

tip: out of 表示从里面到外面，或“缺乏”。

senses.en: an opportunity
The likelihood that something will happen.
Events happening without planning or a predictable cause.

ex.en: This is your chance to speak up.
ex.zh: 这是你发言的机会。

ex.en: Affordable training gives unemployed adults a chance to gain new skills and return to the workforce.
ex.zh: 费用可负担的培训让失业的成年人有机会掌握新技能，重返职场。

col: a chance to learn｜学习的机会
a good chance of｜很有可能
tip: 机会用chance to do；可能性常用chance of doing。

senses.en: and nobody or nothing else

ex.en: I only need five minutes to check the list.
ex.zh: 我只需要五分钟核对名单。

ex.en: If a city only builds roads for cars, children have fewer safe places to walk or cycle.
ex.zh: 如果一座城市只为汽车修路，孩子就更少有安全的地方走路或骑车。

tip: only 的位置会改变句子强调的部分，写作时尽量靠近被限定的词。

senses.en: knowledge from doing; an event lived through
something that happens to you or that you do
to have something happen to you or feel something

ex.en: Travel is a valuable experience.
ex.zh: 旅行是宝贵的经历。

ex.en: Work experience can help graduates develop practical skills that employers value alongside academic qualifications.
ex.zh: 工作经验能帮助毕业生培养实践技能，而雇主不仅重视学历，也看重这些技能。

col: a rewarding experience｜有收获的经历
tip: 表“经验”不可数；表具体“经历”可数。

senses.en: to mark a happy event
To praise someone or something publicly.

ex.en: We will celebrate her birthday this weekend.
ex.zh: 我们这个周末会庆祝她的生日。

ex.en: Community festivals celebrate local traditions while giving residents opportunities to strengthen relationships with their neighbours.
ex.zh: 社区节庆活动在弘扬当地传统的同时，也让居民有机会增进邻里关系。

col: celebrate an achievement｜庆祝一项成就
tip: 庆祝某事用celebrate；祝贺某人用congratulate。

senses.en: of high quality, or able to do something well

ex.en: This is a good place to revise quietly.
ex.zh: 这是一个适合安静复习的地方。

ex.en: A good public library does more than lend books; it gives people a place to learn together.
ex.zh: 一座好的公共图书馆不只是借书，它还给人们一个一起学习的地方。

tip: good 修饰名词；修饰动词用 well，如 speak English well。

senses.en: not any, or not allowed

ex.en: There is no milk left in the fridge.
ex.zh: 冰箱里没有牛奶了。

ex.en: There is no single method that helps every student, so teachers need more than one kind of practice.
ex.zh: 没有一种方法适合所有学生，所以老师需要不止一种练习方式。

tip: no 直接放在名词前；not 用来否定动词。

senses.en: to surprise greatly

ex.en: The magic trick will amaze the children.
ex.zh: 这个魔术会让孩子们惊奇。

ex.en: Advances in medical technology continue to amaze researchers and offer new hope to patients with complex conditions.
ex.zh: 医疗技术的进步不断令研究人员惊叹，也为病情复杂的患者带来新的希望。

col: never cease to amaze｜始终令人惊叹
tip: 人感到惊奇用amazed；事物令人惊奇用amazing。

senses.en: having power, or intense

ex.en: A strong wind shook the young trees.
ex.zh: 大风摇动了小树。

ex.en: Strong public support can keep a village clinic open when the budget is thin.
ex.zh: 当预算紧张时，强烈的公众支持能让乡村诊所继续开着。

tip: strong 的名词是 strength，不是 strongness。

senses.en: the physical form of a person, or a group

ex.en: Exercise helps the body and the mind.
ex.zh: 锻炼对身体和头脑都有帮助。

ex.en: A student body that is never asked for advice will not feel the school rules are theirs.
ex.zh: 从未被征求意见的学生群体，不会觉得校规是自己的。

tip: body 表示身体；anybody 才是“任何人”。

senses.en: one of the twelve parts of a year

ex.en: We will visit the museum next month.
ex.zh: 我们下个月去参观博物馆。

ex.en: One dry month can empty a village tank if nobody measured how fast the water was used.
ex.zh: 如果没人测量用水有多快，一个干旱的月份就能抽干村里的水箱。

tip: in 加月份：in March。next month 前不加 the。

senses.en: to allow someone to do something

ex.en: Let me check the answer before we go on.
ex.zh: 继续之前让我核对一下答案。

ex.en: Cities that let cars park on pavements force pedestrians, including children, into the road.
ex.zh: 允许汽车停在人行道上的城市，会把包括孩子在内的行人逼到马路上去。

tip: let sb do 不带 to；allow sb to do 要带 to。

senses.en: a small amount

ex.en: I am a bit tired after the match.
ex.zh: 比赛后我有点累。

ex.en: A bit of shade at a bus stop can matter on a day when the temperature is already high.
ex.zh: 在气温已经很高的日子，车站上一点荫凉也会有用。

tip: a bit 修饰形容词；a bit of 后接不可数名词。

senses.en: brought into life

ex.en: She was born in this town.
ex.zh: 她出生在这个城镇。

ex.en: A child born beside a busy road breathes dirtier air than one born beside a park.
ex.zh: 出生在繁忙道路旁的孩子，比出生在公园旁的孩子呼吸更脏的空气。

tip: be born 只用被动，过去式仍用 was/were born，不说 borned。

senses.en: what is inside
Happy with what you have or with your situation
To make someone satisfied with what is available

ex.en: Check the content of the box carefully.
ex.zh: 仔细检查盒子的内容。

ex.en: Schools should teach students to evaluate online content critically rather than accepting every claim as reliable information.
ex.zh: 学校应教学生批判性地评估网络内容，而不是把每一种说法都当作可靠信息。

col: content yourself with｜使自己满足于
tip: 名词重音在前，形容词和动词在后；目录用contents。

senses.en: to do something with a tool or method
the act of using something

ex.en: Please use a pencil for the answer sheet.
ex.zh: 答题卡请用铅笔。

ex.en: Farmers who use less water per kilo of rice help cities downstream keep their rivers flowing.
ex.zh: 每公斤稻谷用水更少的农民，能帮助下游城市维持河流不断流。

tip: use 是动词；名词“用途”同形，名词常读 /juːs/，动词读 /juːz/。

senses.en: growth, or a new event

ex.en: The development of the town has been fast.
ex.zh: 这个城镇发展得很快。

ex.en: Rapid development along a river can bring jobs and also destroy the wetland that holds flood water.
ex.zh: 河边的快速发展能带来工作，也会毁掉蓄洪水的湿地。

col: with the development of｜随着……的发展
tip: development 作“发展”时常不可数；一项新进展可数。

senses.en: relating to government or public affairs

ex.en: We read a political cartoon in class.
ex.zh: 我们在课上读了一幅政治漫画。

ex.en: Political promises about housing mean little until rents actually fall for ordinary workers.
ex.zh: 关于住房的政治承诺，在普通工人的房租真正下降之前没什么意义。

tip: politics 表示政治，谓语常用单数。

senses.en: a title for a doctor

ex.en: Dr. Wang will talk about sleep on Friday.
ex.zh: 王医生周五将谈睡眠。

ex.en: Dr. is a short title, but a village still needs the person behind it to be within reach.
ex.zh: Dr. 是一个简短的称谓，但村子仍需要这个称谓背后的人在能够到达的范围内。

tip: Dr. 后接姓。表示医生或博士都可能用这个缩写，要看语境。

senses.en: to divide with a knife, or to reduce
an opening, or a reduction

ex.en: Please cut the paper along the line.
ex.zh: 请沿这条线裁纸。

ex.en: Cities that cut bus routes to save money often increase the number of cars the next year.
ex.zh: 为省钱削减公交线路的城市，往往在下一年增加汽车数量。

tip: cut 的过去式和过去分词都是 cut。

senses.en: having all its parts
to finish

ex.en: Please hand in a complete form.
ex.zh: 请交一份填完整的表格。

ex.en: A complete picture of school travel includes the walk, not only the bus.
ex.zh: 对上学出行的完整描述包括步行，而不只是公交。

tip: complete 作动词是“完成”。

senses.en: to keep something in the mind, or to bring it back

ex.en: Remember to lock the lab door.
ex.zh: 记得锁实验室的门。

ex.en: Communities remember a flood longer than planners do if their homes were under water.
ex.zh: 如果自家被水淹过，社区对洪水的记忆会比规划者更久。

tip: remember to do 是记得要做；remember doing 是记得做过。

senses.en: an empty area, or the area beyond Earth

ex.en: There is no space left on the notice board.
ex.zh: 布告栏上没有空位了。

ex.en: Cities that leave no space for trees make summer streets hotter for people who walk.
ex.zh: 不给树留空间的城市，会让步行的人觉得夏天的街道更热。

tip: space 表示空间时常不可数；一个空位用 a space。

senses.en: used to show surprise or understanding

ex.en: Oh, I left my pen in the lab.
ex.zh: 哦，我把笔落在实验室了。

ex.en: Oh is a small word, but in a dialogue it can show surprise, pain, or a sudden idea.
ex.zh: Oh 是个小词，但在对话里可以表示惊讶、疼痛或忽然想到。

tip: oh 是感叹词，后面常用逗号。

senses.en: from one end towards the other
forward, or with someone

ex.en: We walked along the river after school.
ex.zh: 放学后我们沿着河走。

ex.en: Shops along the road to school decide what students can buy on the way home.
ex.zh: 通往学校的路上的商店，决定了学生回家时能买到什么。

tip: along 强调沿着一条线走；across 是从一边到另一边。

senses.en: a valuable yellow metal
made of gold

ex.en: The medal looks like gold.
ex.zh: 这块奖牌看起来像金子。

ex.en: A gold mine can bring wages and also leave a river too dirty to drink.
ex.zh: 金矿能带来工资，也会把河弄脏到不能喝。

tip: gold 作定语常表示材料：a gold ring。golden 多表示金色或珍贵。

senses.en: practice to learn a skill

ex.en: The team has training on Wednesday.
ex.zh: 球队周三训练。

ex.en: Training for village teachers fails if it takes them away from class for a whole month.
ex.zh: 如果乡村教师培训让他们离开课堂整整一个月，培训就会失败。

tip: training 通常不可数。

senses.en: to focus attention
To bring things together in one place or direct efforts there.
A substance made stronger by removing water or other material.

ex.en: It is hard to concentrate in a noisy room.
ex.zh: 在嘈杂的房间里很难集中注意力。

ex.en: Governments should concentrate resources on preventive healthcare to reduce pressure on hospitals in the long term.
ex.zh: 政府应将资源集中于预防性医疗，以长期减轻医院的压力。

col: concentrate on a task｜专注于任务
concentrate resources on｜将资源集中于
tip: concentrate on后接名词或动名词，表示专注于。

senses.en: moving or happening quickly
quickly

ex.en: The early bus is fast, but it is often full.
ex.zh: 早班车很快，但常常满员。

ex.en: A fast road into the city helps drivers and can make the walk to school more dangerous.
ex.zh: 进城的快速路方便司机，也可能让走路上学更危险。

tip: fast 既可作形容词也可作副词，不加 -ly。fast 作副词不是 fastly。

senses.en: a large organised group of soldiers

ex.en: The history book describes the army's long march.
ex.zh: 历史书写到军队的长途行军。

ex.en: An army can build a bridge quickly, but a town still needs people to maintain it.
ex.zh: 军队可以很快建起一座桥，但城镇仍需要人来维护它。

tip: army 作整体时谓语可用单数。

senses.en: a place larger than a village and smaller than a city

ex.en: Our town has one public library.
ex.zh: 我们镇上有一座公共图书馆。

ex.en: A small town loses young people when the college, the jobs, and the buses are all in the city.
ex.zh: 当大学、工作和公交都在城里时，小镇会失去年轻人。

tip: town 比 city 小。in town 常不加 the。

senses.en: not having, or not doing

ex.en: He finished the paper without a single mistake.
ex.zh: 他交卷时一个错误都没有。

ex.en: A city cannot cut car use without giving people buses and pavements they can trust.
ex.zh: 如果没有可靠的公交和人行道，一座城市就无法减少私家车使用。

tip: without 后接名词或 doing，不接 to do。

senses.en: related to society or to meeting people

ex.en: We did a social study on how neighbours share tools.
ex.zh: 我们做了一项关于邻居如何共用工具的社会调查。

ex.en: Social media can connect a class, but it can also spread a rumour in minutes.
ex.zh: 社交媒体能把一个班联系起来，也能在几分钟内传播谣言。

tip: social 是形容词；社会用 society。

senses.en: a drawing or photograph

ex.en: Draw a picture of your street.
ex.zh: 画一张你的街道。

ex.en: A picture of a clean river can hide the factory that still pours waste at night.
ex.zh: 一张干净河流的照片，可以藏起仍在夜里排污的工厂。

tip: picture 作动词是“想象”。

senses.en: a young person

ex.en: Every child in the class has a reading book.
ex.zh: 班上每个孩子都有一本读物。

ex.en: A child who walks to school needs a pavement, not only a parent with a car.
ex.zh: 走路上学的孩子需要人行道，而不只是一位有车的家长。

tip: child 的复数是 children，不是 childs。

senses.en: a type or sort
friendly and helpful

ex.en: What kind of book do you like?
ex.zh: 你喜欢哪一类书？

ex.en: The kind of food sold at a school gate shapes what students eat between lessons.
ex.zh: 校门口卖的食物种类，影响着学生课间吃什么。

tip: kind 作形容词是“善良的”：be kind to sb。

senses.en: a way of entering or using
A way of reaching or entering a place.
Reach, enter, or obtain something, especially information on a computer.

ex.en: Students need access to the library.
ex.zh: 学生需要使用图书馆的权限。

ex.en: Affordable internet access enables rural students to benefit from a wider range of educational resources.
ex.zh: 价格可负担的互联网接入能让农村学生受益于更丰富的教育资源。

col: access to education｜受教育的机会
gain access to｜获得使用或进入的机会
tip: 名词后接to；动词直接接宾语，不加to。

senses.en: a disagreement; a reason
A reason or set of reasons supporting an opinion.

ex.en: Their argument lasted for hours.
ex.zh: 他们的争论持续了几个小时。

ex.en: The strongest argument for public transport investment is its potential to reduce urban air pollution.
ex.zh: 支持投资公共交通最有力的论据是，它有望减少城市空气污染。

col: a convincing argument｜有说服力的论据
tip: 争吵常接with或about；支持某观点用argument for。

senses.en: easy to understand or do

ex.en: Please use simple words in the notice.
ex.zh: 通知里请用简单的词。

ex.en: The simple act of sorting rubbish fails if the bins are too far from the canteen.
ex.zh: 如果垃圾桶离食堂太远，垃圾分类这个简单的行为也会失败。

tip: simple 的副词是 simply。

senses.en: not anything

ex.en: There is nothing in the lost-and-found box.
ex.zh: 失物招领箱里什么都没有。

ex.en: Nothing improves a river if factories upstream are allowed to pour waste into it at night.
ex.zh: 如果允许上游工厂在夜里排污，什么办法也改善不了这条河。

tip: nothing 作主语时谓语用单数。形容词后置：nothing new。

senses.en: until now, often in questions and negatives
but at the same time

ex.en: She has not finished the poster yet.
ex.zh: 她还没有完成海报。

ex.en: The town has not yet decided where the new clinic will stand, though the old one is already unsafe.
ex.zh: 尽管旧诊所已经不安全，镇上还没有决定新诊所建在哪里。

tip: yet 多用于否定和疑问；already 多用于肯定。yet 也可作连词“然而”。

senses.en: to become smaller in amount
A reduction in the size, number, or amount of something.

ex.en: Pollution may decrease if we use less plastic.
ex.zh: 如果我们少用塑料，污染可能会减少。

ex.en: Improved public transport could decrease traffic congestion and reduce air pollution in densely populated cities.
ex.zh: 改善公共交通可以缓解人口密集城市的交通拥堵，并减少空气污染。

col: a decrease in demand｜需求下降
tip: 动词重音在后，名词/ˈdiːkriːs/重音在前。

senses.en: existing in nature, or normal

ex.en: It is natural to feel nervous before a test.
ex.zh: 考试前感到紧张是自然的。

ex.en: Natural shade from trees costs less over time than machines that cool one classroom.
ex.zh: 树木的天然荫凉，长期来看比只冷却一间教室的机器更省。

tip: natural 是形容词；nature 是名词。

senses.en: a mistake
the difference between a measured value and the true value

ex.en: Check your work for any error.
ex.zh: 检查作业有没有错误。

ex.en: Researchers should check their calculations carefully, as a minor error can significantly affect the final conclusions.
ex.zh: 研究人员应仔细核查计算过程，因为一个小错误就可能显著影响最终结论。

col: a margin of error｜误差范围
tip: error比mistake正式，常用于技术、计算或判断。

senses.en: to stay in a state, or to continue to have

ex.en: Please keep the door closed.
ex.zh: 请让门保持关着。

ex.en: Cities that keep old trees during construction save shade that new saplings cannot provide for years.
ex.zh: 施工时保留老树的城市，留住了新树苗多年内无法提供的荫凉。

tip: keep doing 表示持续做；keep sb from doing 表示阻止某人做。

senses.en: on the side opposite the right

senses.zh: 离开；留下（leave 的过去式）
senses.en: past form of leave

ex.en: Turn left after the school gate.
ex.zh: 出校门后向左转。

ex.en: The shops on the left bank of the river closed when the new road drew customers away.
ex.zh: 河左岸的商店在新路把顾客引走之后关门了。

tip: left 也是 leave 的过去式和过去分词。看上下文才能区分“左边”和“离开”。

senses.en: to move something into a place

ex.en: Put the bottles in the recycling box.
ex.zh: 把瓶子放进回收箱。

ex.en: If a city puts all new housing on the edge, workers spend hours travelling to jobs in the centre.
ex.zh: 如果一座城市把新住房都放在边缘，工人就要花数小时去市中心上班。

tip: put 的过去式和过去分词都是 put，不是 putted。

senses.en: to rescue, to avoid spending, or to keep

ex.en: Save your work before you close the computer.
ex.zh: 关电脑前先保存作业。

ex.en: Towns that save old trees save shade that new saplings cannot give for years.
ex.zh: 保住老树的城镇，也保住了新树苗多年内给不了的荫凉。

tip: save 表示拯救或节省，后面直接接宾语。

senses.en: to fasten or join
Consider something to have a particular value or importance

ex.en: Please attach your photo to the form.
ex.zh: 请把照片附在表格上。

ex.en: Many employers attach greater importance to practical experience than to academic qualifications when recruiting new staff.
ex.zh: 许多雇主招聘新员工时，更看重实际经验而非学历。

col: attach something to something｜把某物固定到某物上
tip: 常用attach A to B；邮件附件用attachment。

senses.en: used for a possibility that is not certain

ex.en: It might snow tonight, so take a coat.
ex.zh: 今晚可能会下雪，带件外套。

ex.en: A new subway line might help the centre while making outer villages feel even farther away.
ex.zh: 一条新地铁线可能方便市中心，同时让外围村庄感觉更远。

tip: might 比 may 语气更不确定，两者后面都接动词原形。

senses.en: the bottom support, or a main place
to use something as the starting point

ex.en: Trust is the base of the club.
ex.zh: 信任是这个社团的基础。

ex.en: A flood plan with no local base of volunteers will be slow on the first wet night.
ex.zh: 没有本地志愿者基础的防汛计划，会在第一个雨夜行动迟缓。

tip: be based on 表示以……为基础。base 作动词是“以……为根据”。

senses.en: in the direction of, or in relation to

ex.en: We walked towards the gate.
ex.zh: 我们朝校门走去。

ex.en: Attitudes towards night buses change when people have to use them themselves.
ex.zh: 当人们不得不自己去坐夜班公交时，他们对它的态度会改变。

tip: 英式常用 towards，美式常用 toward，意思相同。

senses.en: to have enough money or time for
to provide something useful or desirable

ex.en: We cannot afford to waste water.
ex.zh: 我们浪费不起水。

ex.en: Without financial assistance, many students cannot afford to attend university despite having strong academic potential.
ex.zh: 如果没有经济援助，许多学生即使有很强的学术潜力，也无力负担大学费用。

col: can afford to do｜有能力负担做某事
cannot afford to lose｜承受不起失去
tip: 常用can afford sth或can afford to do，不接doing。

senses.en: an edge, a face, or one of two groups

ex.en: Please write notes on the side of the page.
ex.zh: 请把笔记写在页边。

ex.en: Both sides of a noisy road need a safe crossing if children walk to school there.
ex.zh: 如果孩子从那里走路上学，嘈杂马路的两边都需要安全的过街处。

col: on the other side｜在另一边
tip: side 是名词；旁边用 beside 或 by the side of。

senses.en: pleasant to look at
fairly

ex.en: The pretty garden is behind the hall.
ex.zh: 漂亮的花园在大厅后面。

ex.en: A pretty river view does not mean the water is clean enough for children to play in.
ex.zh: 河景漂亮并不意味着水干净到可以让孩子玩。

tip: pretty 作副词表示“相当”，语气比 very 弱。

senses.en: easy to understand or see
to remove, or to become bright

ex.en: Please write a clear title.
ex.zh: 请写一个清楚的标题。

ex.en: Clear signs at a junction matter more at night, when drivers and children share a narrow road.
ex.zh: 路口清楚的标志在夜里更重要，那时司机和孩子共用一条窄路。

tip: clear 作动词是“清除”或“放晴”。It is clear that...

senses.en: the group of people who govern a country or city

ex.en: The government plans to repair the old bridge.
ex.zh: 政府计划修缮那座旧桥。

ex.en: A local government that publishes its spending makes it easier for citizens to ask useful questions.
ex.zh: 公开支出的地方政府，让公民更容易提出有用的问题。

tip: government 作整体时谓语常用单数。

senses.en: one time, or at some time in the past
as soon as

ex.en: I have been to the museum only once.
ex.zh: 我只去过一次博物馆。

ex.en: Once a wetland is filled in for housing, the birds do not return just because a sign says they are welcome.
ex.zh: 一旦湿地被填平用来建房，鸟儿不会因为一块欢迎的牌子就回来。

tip: once 引导条件从句时表示“一旦”，主句常用将来或情态。

senses.en: important; large
a main university subject, or a student studying that subject
to study a particular subject as your main university subject

ex.en: Traffic is a major problem.
ex.zh: 交通是一个重大问题。

ex.en: Access to affordable childcare remains a major concern for parents who wish to return to work.
ex.zh: 对于希望重返职场的父母而言，能否获得负担得起的托育服务仍是一个主要顾虑。

tip: 动词主修用major in；主要用于美式英语。

senses.en: unpleasant, poor, or serious

ex.en: The weather was bad, so the match was delayed.
ex.zh: 天气不好，比赛推迟了。

ex.en: Bad air on the walk to school can harm children even when their classrooms are clean.
ex.zh: 即使教室很干净，上学路上的糟糕空气仍可能伤害孩子。

tip: bad 的比较级是 worse，最高级是 worst，不是 more bad。

senses.en: familiar with something, or not new

ex.en: I am used to getting up early on school days.
ex.zh: 上学日我习惯早起。

ex.en: A used textbook can be as useful as a new one if the notes in the margin are clear.
ex.zh: 如果页边的笔记清楚，旧课本可以和新的一样有用。

col: be used to do｜被用来做
tip: used to do 是过去常常；be used to doing 是习惯于。不要混用。

senses.en: the making of goods, or a branch of business

ex.en: The town grew around the steel industry.
ex.zh: 这个城镇是围绕钢铁工业发展起来的。

ex.en: An industry beside a river should pay for the water it dirties, not only for the jobs it creates.
ex.zh: 河边的工业应该为它弄脏的水付费，而不只为它创造的工作。

tip: industry 的复数是 industries。

senses.en: the top of the body, or the person in charge
to go towards, or to lead

ex.en: She nodded her head to show she understood.
ex.zh: 她点头表示听懂了。

ex.en: A club needs a head who listens, or the loudest member will decide everything.
ex.zh: 社团需要一个肯听意见的负责人，否则声音最大的人会决定一切。

col: from head to foot｜从头到脚
tip: head for 表示朝某地去。head 作动词是“前往”或“率领”。

senses.en: a thing that is not named

ex.en: There is something wrong with the clock.
ex.zh: 这只钟有点问题。

ex.en: Something as small as a leaked battery can pollute the soil around a school for years.
ex.zh: 一块泄漏的电池这样小的东西，也可能污染学校周围的土壤很多年。

tip: 形容词放在 something 后面：something important。

senses.en: without other people

ex.en: She walked home alone.
ex.zh: 她独自走回了家。

ex.en: A child should not wait alone for a late bus on a road without lights.
ex.zh: 孩子不该独自在没有灯的路上等晚点的公交。

tip: alone 强调独自；lonely 强调孤独的感觉。alone 不作定语放在名词前。

senses.en: to end an activity or prevent something
a halt, or a place where a bus stops

ex.en: Please stop talking when the bell rings.
ex.zh: 铃响时请停止讲话。

ex.en: Cities that stop cars from idling outside schools cut the fumes children breathe at the gate.
ex.zh: 禁止汽车在校门外怠速的城市，减少了孩子在门口吸入的废气。

col: stop sb from doing｜阻止某人做
tip: stop doing 是停下正在做的事；stop to do 是停下来去做另一件事。

senses.en: the side that faces forward
at the front

ex.en: Please come to the front if you cannot see.
ex.zh: 如果看不见，请到前面来。

ex.en: Shops in front of a school affect what students buy more than a poster inside the classroom does.
ex.zh: 学校前面的商店对学生买什么的影响，大于教室里的一张海报。

tip: in front of 在外部前面；in the front of 在内部的前部。

senses.en: well known
having knowledge or experience of something

ex.en: This song sounds familiar.
ex.zh: 这首歌听起来很熟悉。

ex.en: Students who are familiar with digital tools may adapt more easily to online learning environments.
ex.zh: 熟悉数字工具的学生可能更容易适应在线学习环境。

tip: 人熟悉事物用with；事物为人熟悉用to。

senses.en: the dark part of the day

ex.en: I review new words at night.
ex.zh: 我在晚上复习生词。

ex.en: Bright signs at night may help shops, but they can also keep nearby residents awake.
ex.zh: 夜间明亮的招牌也许有助于商店，但也会让附近居民睡不着。

tip: at night 不加 the；on 加具体的某个夜晚，如 on Sunday night。

senses.en: to put a question, or to request

ex.en: Ask the teacher if you do not understand.
ex.zh: 不懂就问老师。

ex.en: Cities should ask residents where floods actually reach, not only where the map predicts them.
ex.zh: 城市应该询问居民洪水实际淹到哪里，而不只是看地图的预测。

col: ask sb to do｜请某人做
tip: ask sb sth 或 ask sb to do。ask 后不接 sb doing。

senses.en: a copy, a good example, or a design

ex.en: We built a model of the bridge.
ex.zh: 我们做了一个桥的模型。

ex.en: A role model in a textbook helps less than a neighbour who does the job the student hopes to learn.
ex.zh: 课本里的榜样，不如一个正在做学生想学的工作的邻居有用。

tip: model 作动词是“做模特”或“以……为榜样”。

senses.en: burning, or a destructive burning
to shoot, or to dismiss from a job

ex.en: We had a fire drill on Monday.
ex.zh: 周一我们进行了消防演习。

ex.en: A hillside fire can reach a village faster than a warning if the road out is narrow.
ex.zh: 如果出去的路很窄，山火到达村庄的速度可以快过警报。

tip: fire 作“火”时常不可数；一场火灾用 a fire。

senses.en: a speed, a proportion, or a price

ex.en: The heart rate rises when you run.
ex.zh: 跑步时心率会上升。

ex.en: A high absence rate may show a bus problem, not only a lack of interest.
ex.zh: 高缺勤率可能说明公交有问题，而不只是缺乏兴趣。

col: at a rate of｜以……的速度
tip: rate 作动词是“评价”。

senses.en: to be worthy of

ex.en: You deserve a rest after such hard work.
ex.zh: 这么辛苦之后你应得休息。

ex.en: Healthcare workers deserve greater recognition because their dedication contributes directly to the wellbeing of society.
ex.zh: 医护人员值得获得更多认可，因为他们的奉献直接促进了社会福祉。

tip: 接名词或to do；不用deserve doing表示主动。

senses.en: of the mind

senses.zh: 脑力的；在头脑中进行的
senses.en: Using thought rather than physical action or written calculation.

ex.en: mental health matters as much as body health.
ex.zh: 心理健康与身体健康同样重要。

ex.en: Employers should give mental wellbeing the same priority as physical safety when designing workplace policies.
ex.zh: 雇主制定职场政策时，应将心理健康与人身安全放在同等重要的位置。

tip: mental侧重心理或脑力；口语中形容人疯狂可能冒犯。

senses.en: the reflexive form of you

ex.en: Please help yourself to the fruit.
ex.zh: 请随便吃水果。

ex.en: You should ask yourself who benefits before you share a story that sounds too perfect.
ex.zh: 在转发一个听起来过于完美的故事之前，你应该问问自己谁从中获益。

tip: 对多人用 yourselves。

senses.en: the amount of money something costs

ex.en: The price of the ticket is twenty yuan.
ex.zh: 票价是二十元。

ex.en: A low ticket price means little if the bus never reaches the villages that need it.
ex.zh: 如果公交根本到不了需要它的村子，低票价也没什么意义。

col: at a price of｜以……的价格
tip: price 是卖方标出的价格；cost 常指买方付出的代价。

senses.en: to be good for
to help someone or receive help or an advantage
money provided by the government to people needing support

ex.en: Exercise can benefit both body and mind.
ex.zh: 锻炼有益于身心。

ex.en: Rural communities can benefit from improved internet access through greater opportunities for education and employment.
ex.zh: 更好的互联网接入能增加教育和就业机会，让农村社区受益。

tip: benefit sb指使某人受益；benefit from指得益于。

senses.en: a being believed to control nature or life

ex.en: In the story, the villagers thanked the god of the river.
ex.zh: 故事里，村民感谢河神。

ex.en: Ancient myths about a god of rain show how closely people once tied weather to survival.
ex.zh: 古代关于雨神的神话表明，人们曾经把天气和生存联系得多么紧密。

tip: god 指神灵；God 大写时常特指基督教等宗教中的上帝。

senses.en: a place where legal cases are heard, or a sports ground

ex.en: The tennis court is behind the gym.
ex.zh: 网球场在体育馆后面。

ex.en: A court that takes years to hear a simple case leaves families waiting for a decision.
ex.zh: 审理一件简单案件要花数年的法院，会让家庭一直等一个决定。

tip: court 既可指法庭也可指球场，要看搭配。

senses.en: done for only part of the usual working time

ex.en: She has a part-time job at the library.
ex.zh: 她在图书馆有一份兼职。

ex.en: Part-time jobs can teach responsibility, but they should not replace the sleep teenagers still need.
ex.zh: 兼职可以培养责任感，但不该取代青少年仍然需要的睡眠。

tip: part-time 作定语时通常加连字符；作状语有时写成 part time。

senses.en: coming after all others, or most recent
to continue for a period of time

ex.en: I sat in the last row during the talk.
ex.zh: 讲座时我坐在最后一排。

ex.en: Last year's flood still shapes where the town is willing to build new houses.
ex.zh: 去年的洪水仍然影响着这座城镇愿意在哪里建新房。

col: the last but not least｜最后但同样重要
tip: last 作动词是“持续”。过去式和过去分词仍是 last。

senses.en: to pay attention to sound

ex.en: Listen to the recording twice.
ex.zh: 把录音听两遍。

ex.en: Planners who listen to night-shift workers hear problems a daytime meeting never raises.
ex.zh: 倾听夜班工人的规划者，会听到白天的会议从不提出的问题。

tip: listen 是不及物动词，必须加 to 再接宾语。

senses.en: having little money, or not good

ex.en: The recording quality is poor.
ex.zh: 录音质量很差。

ex.en: Poor families spend a larger share of their income on food when prices rise.
ex.zh: 物价上涨时，贫穷家庭把收入中更大的一份花在食物上。

tip: the poor 表示穷人这一类，谓语用复数。

senses.en: the activity of reading

ex.en: Quiet reading starts at eight.
ex.zh: 安静阅读八点开始。

ex.en: Reading with an adult at home helps a child more than an extra worksheet.
ex.zh: 在家有成年人陪着阅读，比多一张练习纸更有帮助。

tip: reading 作“阅读”时常不可数。

senses.en: in the middle, or most important

ex.en: The central library is near the station.
ex.zh: 中心图书馆在车站附近。

ex.en: Central heating in a school matters in a town where winter lasts five months.
ex.zh: 在冬天长达五个月的城镇，学校的集中供暖很重要。

tip: central 是形容词；centre / center 是名词。

senses.en: a person who directs a film or an organisation

ex.en: The director of the club explained the plan.
ex.zh: 社团负责人解释了计划。

ex.en: A hospital director who never walks the night ward may miss what the staff already know.
ex.zh: 从不走夜班病房的医院主任，可能会错过员工已经知道的事。

tip: director 是人；direction 是方向或指导。

senses.en: past experience or setting
Information or events needed to understand a situation
The part of a scene behind the main subject

ex.en: Her family background shaped her views.
ex.zh: 她的家庭背景塑造了她的观点。

ex.en: Universities should provide equal opportunities for applicants from different social backgrounds, regardless of their family income.
ex.zh: 大学应为来自不同社会背景的申请者提供平等机会，不论其家庭收入如何。

col: a disadvantaged background｜弱势家庭背景
tip: 经历领域用background in；背景中用in the background。

senses.en: straight; clear
To guide or control an activity, performance, or group.
To show the way or aim something towards a place.

ex.en: Take the direct route home.
ex.zh: 走直接回家的路。

ex.en: Improved public transport can have a direct impact on employment by connecting residents with more job opportunities.
ex.zh: 改善公共交通能让居民获得更多就业机会，从而对就业产生直接影响。

col: direct attention to｜将注意力转向
tip: direct可作形容词或动词；常见读音也有/daɪˈrekt/。

senses.en: fighting between countries or groups

ex.en: The history class discussed the cost of war.
ex.zh: 历史课讨论了战争的代价。

ex.en: After a war, schools are often rebuilt later than roads, though children need them first.
ex.zh: 战争之后，学校的重建常常晚于道路，尽管孩子最先需要的是学校。

tip: war 前常用 in：in the war。

senses.en: teaching and learning

ex.en: Public education should not depend on a family's income.
ex.zh: 公共教育不该取决于一个家庭的收入。

ex.en: Education about floods is useful only when it includes the streets children actually use.
ex.zh: 关于洪水的教育，只有包含孩子真正走的那些街时才有用。

tip: education 不可数。

senses.en: the direction where the sun rises
in or towards the east

ex.en: The sun rises in the east.
ex.zh: 太阳从东方升起。

ex.en: Towns in the east of the region share one hospital, so the road between them matters.
ex.zh: 该地区东部的城镇共用一家医院，所以它们之间的路很重要。

tip: eastern 是形容词。

senses.en: a female child

ex.en: The girl by the window is our monitor.
ex.zh: 窗边的女孩是我们的班长。

ex.en: A girl who wants to study engineering should see women doing that work, not only hear that it is possible.
ex.zh: 想学工程的女孩，应该看到有女性在做这份工作，而不只是听说这是可能的。

tip: girl 的复数是 girls。

senses.en: a reply, or a solution
to reply

ex.en: Write the answer on the line.
ex.zh: 把答案写在横线上。

ex.en: An easy answer to traffic is another lane, but that often brings more cars.
ex.zh: 交通的简单答案是再加一条车道，但这常常带来更多汽车。

col: in answer to｜作为对……的回答
tip: the answer to a question，介词用 to，不用 of。

senses.en: a row, a long mark, or a queue

ex.en: Please stand in line for the tickets.
ex.zh: 请排队买票。

ex.en: A new metro line helps the centre, but outer towns still need buses to reach the first station.
ex.zh: 新地铁线方便市中心，但外围城镇仍需要公交才能到第一站。

tip: 排队英式常用 queue，美式常用 line。online 是一个词，表示“在线”。

senses.en: the entrance to a room or building

ex.en: Please close the door quietly.
ex.zh: 请轻轻关门。

ex.en: A shop door that opens onto a pavement full of cars is hard for a child to use.
ex.zh: 开向停满汽车的人行道的店门，孩子很难使用。

tip: answer the door 表示去开门。

senses.en: a way of doing or making something

ex.en: Each student has a different writing style.
ex.zh: 每个学生的写作风格不同。

ex.en: A building style that ignores local rain will leak in the first storm.
ex.zh: 忽视本地雨水的建筑风格，会在第一场暴风雨里漏水。

tip: lifestyle 常写作一个词。

senses.en: past tense of find
to start an organisation

ex.en: We found a quiet corner in the library.
ex.zh: 我们在图书馆找到一个安静的角落。

ex.en: Archaeologists found tools that show people cooked together long before cities existed.
ex.zh: 考古学家发现的工具表明，早在城市出现之前，人们就一起做饭了。

tip: find 的过去式是 found。表示“建立”时 founded 才是过去式，不要混用。

senses.en: stored information, or the best result so far
to write down or store sound

ex.en: Keep a record of the books you borrow.
ex.zh: 把你借的书记下来。

ex.en: A temperature record means little if the sensor sits in the sun beside a car park.
ex.zh: 如果传感器放在停车场旁边的太阳下，气温记录就没什么意义。

tip: record 作名词重音常在前；作动词“记录”时重音常在后。

senses.en: a part of a building, or space for something

ex.en: The music room is on the second floor.
ex.zh: 音乐教室在二楼。

ex.en: There is little room for a safe pavement if cars are allowed to park on both sides.
ex.zh: 如果允许汽车停在两边，就几乎没有空间做安全的人行道。

tip: room 表示空间时不可数：no room for。表示房间时可数。

senses.en: a break, or what remains
to stop activity for a while

ex.en: We had a short rest after the run.
ex.zh: 跑完后我们休息了一小会儿。

ex.en: The rest of the class waited outside while two students helped the teacher carry the maps.
ex.zh: 其余同学在外面等，两名学生帮老师搬地图。

tip: the rest of 加复数名词时谓语常用复数。

senses.en: to make unclear or mixed up
To wrongly think one person or thing is another.

ex.en: Too many choices may confuse buyers.
ex.zh: 选择太多可能让买家困惑。

ex.en: Public health messages can confuse audiences when experts use technical language without explaining its meaning.
ex.zh: 专家使用术语却不解释其含义时，公共卫生信息可能会让受众感到困惑。

col: confuse A with B｜把A与B混淆
confuse the issue｜把问题弄复杂
tip: confused形容人感到困惑；confusing形容事物令人困惑。

senses.en: a person

ex.en: Every human being needs clean water.
ex.zh: 每个人都需要干净的水。

ex.en: A human being waiting for a bus in the dark is not a traffic statistic; the street should be lit.
ex.zh: 在黑暗中等公交的人不是一个交通统计数字；街道应该有灯。

tip: human being 比 human 更强调“人”这一完整说法，可数。

senses.en: to look at something for a time
a small clock worn on the wrist

ex.en: We watched the match in the hall.
ex.zh: 我们在大厅看了比赛。

ex.en: Residents watch a river rise long before an official warning reaches their phones.
ex.zh: 居民在官方警报到达手机之前很久，就看着河水上涨。

tip: watch 强调持续看；see 强调看见的结果。

senses.en: wanting to know more
Unusual or strange in a way that attracts attention.

ex.en: Children are curious about nature.
ex.zh: 孩子对自然充满好奇。

ex.en: Teachers can encourage curious students to explore scientific questions through practical experiments rather than memorisation alone.
ex.zh: 教师可以鼓励求知欲强的学生通过动手实验探索科学问题，而不只是死记硬背。

col: a curious mixture｜奇特的混合物
tip: be curious about表示“对……好奇”。

senses.en: on some occasions but not always

ex.en: I sometimes study in the library.
ex.zh: 我有时在图书馆学习。

ex.en: Buses that sometimes skip a stop leave students guessing whether to wait or walk.
ex.zh: 有时甩站的公交，让学生猜测该等还是该走。

tip: sometimes 位置较灵活，可放句首、句中或句末。

senses.en: good, thin, or bright and dry
money paid as a punishment

ex.en: The weather is fine, so we can have class outside.
ex.zh: 天气很好，我们可以在外面上课。

ex.en: A fine for dropping litter works only when bins are near and the rule is explained clearly.
ex.zh: 乱扔垃圾的罚款只有在附近有垃圾桶、而且规则讲清楚时才有效。

tip: fine 作名词是“罚款”，作动词是“处以前款”。

senses.en: a school period, a word, or a length of time

ex.en: This term we have a new science teacher.
ex.zh: 这学期我们有一位新的科学老师。

ex.en: A short term of office can stop a mayor from finishing a flood plan that needs several years.
ex.zh: 很短的任期会让市长完不成一个需要数年的防汛计划。

col: in the long term｜从长远看
tip: in terms of 表示“就……而言”。

senses.en: to have power over something
the power to decide

ex.en: We cannot control the weather, but we can plan for rain.
ex.zh: 我们控制不了天气，但可以为下雨做准备。

ex.en: Cities that control building near rivers reduce the damage when the water rises.
ex.zh: 控制河边建设的城市，能在水位上涨时减少损失。

tip: control 的过去式仍是 control，过去分词加 -led：controlled。

senses.en: to begin
the beginning of something

ex.en: We start the meeting at two.
ex.zh: 我们两点开始开会。

ex.en: Cities that start rubbish sorting early avoid the higher cost of fixing mixed waste later.
ex.zh: 早点开始垃圾分类的城市，可以避免以后处理混合垃圾的更高成本。

tip: start 和 begin 后接 to do 或 doing 通常都可以。

senses.en: a place where sick people are treated

ex.en: The hospital is an hour away by bus.
ex.zh: 医院坐公交要一小时。

ex.en: A hospital on the far side of a flooded road cannot help the street that needs it most.
ex.zh: 洪水那边的医院，帮不了最需要它的那条街。

tip: 英式 in hospital 表示住院，不加 the；美式常用 in the hospital。

senses.en: bad and important, or sincere

ex.en: This is a serious problem.
ex.zh: 这是一个严重的问题。

ex.en: A serious heatwave is a health event, not only a few hot days on the news.
ex.zh: 一场严重的热浪是健康事件，而不只是新闻里的几天高温。

tip: take sth seriously 表示认真对待。

senses.en: the state of being alive, or a way of living

ex.en: School life is busy but full of friends.
ex.zh: 学校生活忙碌，但有很多朋友。

ex.en: City life can be exciting, yet the noise and cost push some families back to smaller towns.
ex.zh: 城市生活可以很精彩，但噪音和花费也会把一些家庭推回小城镇。

tip: life 的复数是 lives。泛指生活时通常不可数。

senses.en: a large town

ex.en: Our city has a new metro line.
ex.zh: 我们这座城市有一条新地铁线。

ex.en: A city that grows upward needs parks on the ground, or children will have nowhere to play.
ex.zh: 向上生长的城市需要地面上的公园，否则孩子将无处玩耍。

tip: city 的复数是 cities。in the city 表示在城里。

senses.en: careful study to find facts
to study something carefully

ex.en: Her research is about teenage sleep.
ex.zh: 她的研究是关于青少年睡眠的。

ex.en: Research that never leaves the lab may miss what families actually do at home.
ex.zh: 从不离开实验室的研究，可能会错过家庭在家里真正做的事。

tip: research 作研究时通常不可数。作动词直接接宾语：research a topic。

senses.en: a game played by two teams with a ball

ex.en: We play football after school.
ex.zh: 我们放学后踢足球。

ex.en: A football field that floods every spring shows that the drains, not the players, need attention.
ex.zh: 每年春天都积水的足球场说明需要关注的是排水，不是球员。

tip: 球类运动前不加 the：play football。美式 football 常指橄榄球。

senses.en: in the middle of three or more

ex.en: She is the tallest among the three.
ex.zh: 她是三人中最高的。

ex.en: Trust is low among residents when a new road is planned without a public meeting.
ex.zh: 如果新路的规划没有公开会议，居民之间的信任就会很低。

col: among other things｜除了别的以外
tip: among 用于三者或更多；between 多用于两者。

senses.en: land for crops, an area of study, or a sports ground

ex.en: The football field is behind the gym.
