ex.zh: 足球场在体育馆后面。

ex.en: Experts in one field may miss a river problem that farmers in the next field see every week.
ex.zh: 一个领域的专家可能会错过隔壁田里的农民每周都看见的河流问题。

tip: field 既可指田野、运动场，也可指学术领域。

senses.en: on this day
this day

ex.en: Today we will practise the listening section.
ex.zh: 今天我们练习听力部分。

ex.en: Decisions made today about housing will decide who can live near good schools in ten years.
ex.zh: 今天做出的住房决定，将决定十年后谁能住在好学校附近。

tip: today 可作副词或名词，前面不加介词 on。

senses.en: a group of teams or organisations

ex.en: Our team is top of the school league.
ex.zh: 我们队在校联赛中排名第一。

ex.en: A league of small towns can share one hospital when none of them can pay for it alone.
ex.zh: 小城镇组成的联盟可以共用一家医院，当它们谁也单独负担不起时。

tip: League 大写时常指特定组织，如 the League。

senses.en: from a time in the past until now
from the time when, or because

ex.en: I have lived here since 2019.
ex.zh: 我从 2019 年起住在这里。

ex.en: Since the new bridge opened, fewer students have had to take two buses to reach school.
ex.zh: 自从新桥通车，需要换乘两趟公交才能到校的学生少了。

tip: since 接时间点，for 接时间段，常与现在完成时连用。

senses.en: paid work, or a task

ex.en: She found a weekend job at a bookshop.
ex.zh: 她在书店找到一份周末工作。

ex.en: A first job teaches timekeeping, but it should not take the hours a student needs for sleep.
ex.zh: 第一份工作能培养守时，但不该占掉学生需要的睡眠时间。

tip: job 是可数名词，一份工作用 a job；work 表示工作通常不可数。

senses.en: a building for Christian worship

ex.en: The old church stands at the end of the street.
ex.zh: 老教堂在街的尽头。

ex.en: A church hall can become a shelter on the night a flood reaches the lower street.
ex.zh: 当洪水到达低处的街道时，教堂大厅可以变成避难所。

tip: go to church 泛指去做礼拜，常不加 the。

senses.en: very clever or bright
Exceptionally intelligent or skilled.
Shining brightly or having a strong, vivid colour.

ex.en: She had a brilliant idea.
ex.zh: 她有一个杰出的想法。

ex.en: Brilliant teachers can inspire students to explore difficult subjects with confidence and genuine curiosity.
ex.zh: 出色的教师能激励学生带着信心和真正的好奇心探索难学的科目。

tip: 英式口语中常用 brilliant 表示“太棒了”。

senses.en: happening every day

ex.en: Exercise is part of her daily routine.
ex.zh: 锻炼是她每日例行的一部分。

meta.pipelineNote: IPA/topic pending; not in Word Atlas overlap

senses.en: the middle, or a place for an activity

ex.en: The sports center is near the station.
ex.zh: 体育中心在车站附近。

ex.en: A health center in the middle of a town is useless if buses stop before it opens.
ex.zh: 如果公交在开门前就停运，镇中心的卫生中心也没用。

tip: 英式拼写是 centre，美式是 center。意思相同。

senses.en: the direction opposite south
in or towards the north

ex.en: The wind is coming from the north.
ex.zh: 风从北边来。

ex.en: Towns in the north may need longer heating seasons, which raises the cost of keeping schools warm.
ex.zh: 北方城镇可能需要更长的供暖季，这会提高学校保暖的成本。

tip: in the north of 在范围内部的北部；to the north of 在某地以北。

senses.en: expected, or owed

ex.en: The report is due on Friday.
ex.zh: 报告周五到期。

ex.en: Floods are due in part to drains built for a smaller town than the one that exists now.
ex.zh: 洪水的部分原因是排水系统按比现在更小的城镇修建。

tip: due to 后接名词，表示原因；be due to do 表示预定要做。

senses.en: scientific knowledge used in practical ways

ex.en: The lab has new technology for measuring air.
ex.zh: 实验室有测量空气的新技术。

ex.en: Technology that warns of a storm helps only people who can receive the message.
ex.zh: 风暴预警技术只帮助那些能收到信息的人。

tip: technology 作总称时常不可数。

senses.en: a set of parts working together, or an organised method

ex.en: The school bell system was repaired yesterday.
ex.zh: 学校的铃声系统昨天修好了。

ex.en: A bus system that only serves the centre leaves outer neighbourhoods with long walks to the first stop.
ex.zh: 只服务市中心的公交系统，会让外围社区走到第一站就要很久。

tip: system 是可数名词：a transport system。

senses.en: to go away, or to let something stay

ex.en: We leave school at four on Fridays.
ex.zh: 周五我们四点离校。

ex.en: If young people leave a town, the shops and clinics that depend on them leave too.
ex.zh: 如果年轻人离开城镇，依靠他们的商店和诊所也会离开。

tip: leave 的过去式和过去分词是 left。leave 也可表示“使处于某种状态”：leave the door open。

senses.en: to say sorry

ex.en: You should apologize for being late.
ex.zh: 你应该为迟到道歉。

ex.en: Companies should apologize promptly for service failures and explain what steps they will take to prevent further problems.
ex.zh: 企业应及时为服务失误道歉，并说明将采取哪些措施来防止问题再次发生。

col: apologize for doing something｜为做某事道歉
tip: 向人道歉用to，为事情道歉用for；英式也写apologise。

senses.en: to make an effort, or to test something
an attempt

ex.en: Try the second method if the first one fails.
ex.zh: 如果第一种方法不行，试试第二种。

ex.en: Cities should try small bus changes before they rebuild a whole road.
ex.zh: 城市在重建整条路之前，应该先尝试小的公交调整。

tip: try to do 强调努力要做成；try doing 强调试一试某种做法。

senses.en: a male parent

ex.en: My father picks me up on Fridays.
ex.zh: 我父亲周五来接我。

ex.en: A father who works nights may never see the school play his child is in.
ex.zh: 上夜班的父亲可能永远看不到孩子参加的学校演出。

tip: father 是较正式的说法；dad 更口语。

senses.en: very foolish, or very enthusiastic

ex.en: It is crazy to cycle without a light at night.
ex.zh: 夜里骑车不带灯是很荒唐的。

ex.en: A crazy building boom can fill a town with flats nobody on a local wage can rent.
ex.zh: 疯狂的建设热潮会让城镇充满本地工资租不起的公寓。

tip: crazy 是口语词，正式写作可用 foolish 或 unwise。

senses.en: two people, or a small number

ex.en: A couple of students stayed to tidy up.
ex.zh: 有几个学生留下来收拾。

ex.en: A young couple may leave a town when the only flats cost more than their wages.
ex.zh: 当仅有的公寓贵过工资时，年轻夫妇可能会离开城镇。

tip: a couple of 在口语里常表示“几个”，不一定正好两个。

senses.en: something that is done

ex.en: We need action, not only a poster.
ex.zh: 我们需要行动，而不只是一张海报。

ex.en: Climate action in a city includes buses and buildings, not only speeches on a special day.
ex.zh: 一座城市的气候行动包括公交和建筑，而不只是特殊日子里的演讲。

tip: take action to do 表示采取行动做某事。

senses.en: the one after the first, or a unit of time
a very short time

ex.en: I sat in the second row.
ex.zh: 我坐在第二排。

ex.en: A delay of even a second at a busy junction can add up to long queues in the evening.
ex.zh: 繁忙路口哪怕一秒钟的延误，也会在傍晚累积成长队。

tip: the second 表示顺序；a second 可以表示“又一”。

senses.en: not high

ex.en: The shelf is low enough for everyone to reach.
ex.zh: 架子低得每个人都够得着。

ex.en: Low pay in village schools makes it hard to keep teachers who could work in the city.
ex.zh: 乡村学校的低报酬，让那些可以去城市工作的老师很难留下来。

col: at a low level｜处于低水平
tip: low 的比较级是 lower。人的声音低用 a low voice。

senses.en: to change place, or to cause a feeling
an action

ex.en: Please move your bag off the seat.
ex.zh: 请把包从座位上移开。

ex.en: Families move away when rents rise faster than wages, and schools then lose students.
ex.zh: 当房租涨得比工资快时，家庭会搬走，学校随后失去学生。

tip: move 可作及物或不及物。搬家用 move to a place。

senses.en: what happens because of something

ex.en: The result of the test will come out tomorrow.
ex.zh: 考试结果明天出来。

ex.en: The result of cutting night buses is that workers walk home on dark roads.
ex.zh: 削减夜班公交的结果是，工人走在没有灯的路上回家。

tip: result in 后接后果；result from 后接原因。

senses.en: to cause something to go somewhere

ex.en: Please send the form to the office.
ex.zh: 请把表格送到办公室。

ex.en: Schools that send warnings only by app miss families who have no signal at home.
ex.zh: 只用应用发送警报的学校，会漏掉家里没有信号的家庭。

tip: send 的过去式和过去分词是 sent。

senses.en: a series of names or items

ex.en: Your name is not on the list.
ex.zh: 名单上没有你的名字。

ex.en: A waiting list for a clinic shows demand, but it does not treat the patient.
ex.zh: 诊所的等候名单显示需求，但并不治疗病人。

tip: list 作动词是“列出”。

senses.en: to come together, or to satisfy a need

ex.en: We will meet at the gate at seven.
ex.zh: 我们七点在门口见面。

ex.en: A bus timetable should meet the hour when school ends, not an office hour from another city.
ex.zh: 公交时刻应该配合放学的时间，而不是另一座城市的办公时间。

tip: meet 的过去式和过去分词是 met。初次相识用 meet；重逢也用 meet。

senses.en: to remain in a place or state

ex.en: Please stay in your seat until the bell.
ex.zh: 铃响前请留在座位上。

ex.en: Young workers stay in a town only if housing and jobs appear together.
ex.zh: 只有住房和工作同时出现，年轻工人才会留在城镇。

tip: stay 作连系动词后接形容词：stay calm。

senses.en: feeling pleasure

ex.en: I am happy to help with the posters.
ex.zh: 我乐意帮忙做海报。

ex.en: A happy photo of a new park hides the families who were moved to make space for it.
ex.zh: 新公园的快乐照片，藏起了为腾地方而被搬走的家庭。

tip: happy 后接 to do 或 that 从句。

senses.en: sure of yourself
certain that something is true or will happen

ex.en: Speak in a confident voice.
ex.zh: 用自信的声音说话。

ex.en: Students become more confident when teachers provide constructive feedback and opportunities to practise new skills.
ex.zh: 当教师提供建设性反馈和练习新技能的机会时，学生会变得更自信。

col: confident about the future｜对未来有信心
tip: confident是形容词；confidence是名词。

senses.en: things that people or animals eat

ex.en: The food in the canteen was simple but hot.
ex.zh: 食堂的食物简单但是热的。

ex.en: Wasted food in school kitchens is a loss of money and of the water used to grow it.
ex.zh: 学校厨房里浪费的食物，既是金钱的损失，也是种植它所用水的损失。

tip: food 通常不可数。一种食物可以说 a food，但较少用。

senses.en: sounds arranged in a way people enjoy

ex.en: There is music practice in the hall after school.
ex.zh: 放学后大厅里有音乐排练。

ex.en: Live music in a square can bring a neighbourhood together, but only if the volume lets people talk.
ex.zh: 广场上的现场音乐能把社区聚在一起，但前提是音量仍允许人们交谈。

tip: music 不可数，不说 a music 或 musics。

senses.en: a set of pages on the internet

ex.en: The bus times are on the school website.
ex.zh: 公交时刻在学校网站上。

ex.en: A website that hides who wrote a story makes it harder to trust the facts.
ex.zh: 隐瞒作者的网站，让人更难信任其中的事实。

tip: website 是一个词，也可写成 web site。

senses.en: something you ask
to express doubt about

ex.en: May I ask a question about the homework?
ex.zh: 我可以问一个关于作业的问题吗？

ex.en: The right question about a new road is who will walk it, not only how many cars it will carry.
ex.zh: 关于一条新路，正确的问题是谁会在上面走，而不只是它能载多少车。

tip: out of the question 是“不可能”；out of question 现在很少用。

senses.en: despite the fact that

ex.en: Though the lab is small, the equipment is new.
ex.zh: 虽然实验室小，设备却是新的。

ex.en: Though a city plants trees, the streets stay hot if the trees are too young to give shade.
ex.zh: 尽管一座城市种了树，如果树还小、遮不成荫，街道依然炎热。

tip: though 可放在句首或句末；although 多放在句首，一般不放句末。

senses.en: if, used when there are two possibilities

ex.en: I do not know whether the museum is open.
ex.zh: 我不知道博物馆是否开着。

ex.en: Whether a town keeps its clinic depends on buses as well as on doctors.
ex.zh: 一个城镇能否保住诊所，既取决于医生，也取决于公交。

tip: whether 可接不定式：whether to go。if 一般不接不定式。介词后用 whether，不用 if。

senses.en: new information about events

ex.en: The news about the match spread quickly.
ex.zh: 关于比赛的消息很快传开了。

ex.en: Good news reporting explains what is known and what is still uncertain.
ex.zh: 好的新闻报道会说明哪些是已知的，哪些仍不确定。

col: a piece of news｜一则新闻
tip: news 不可数，不说 a news。一则新闻用 a piece of news。

senses.en: the name of a book or a person's rank

ex.en: Write a clear title for the poster.
ex.zh: 给海报写一个清楚的标题。

ex.en: The title of a report should say what was measured, not only what sounds impressive.
ex.zh: 报告的标题应该说明测量了什么，而不只是听起来动人。

tip: title 作动词是“给……加标题”。

senses.en: a unit of language

ex.en: I wrote the new word in my notebook.
ex.zh: 我把生词写在笔记本里。

ex.en: A single word in a headline can change how readers judge a whole event.
ex.zh: 标题里的一个词就能改变读者对整件事的判断。

tip: have a word with sb 是和某人说句话；have words with 是争吵。

senses.en: ground, or the solid part of the earth
to come down onto the ground

ex.en: The school sits on flat land near the river.
ex.zh: 学校坐落在河边的平地上。

ex.en: Cheap land beside a river looks useful until the first flood shows why it was empty.
ex.zh: 河边的廉价土地看起来有用，直到第一次洪水说明它为什么曾经空着。

tip: land 作动词是“着陆”或“登陆”。

senses.en: probable

ex.en: Rain is likely today.
ex.zh: 今天可能下雨。

meta.pipelineNote: IPA/topic pending; not in Word Atlas overlap

senses.en: hard work
an attempt or organised activity intended to achieve a goal

ex.en: Success needs continuous effort.
ex.zh: 成功需要持续努力。

ex.en: Reducing household waste requires a joint effort from consumers, manufacturers and local authorities to change everyday practices.
ex.zh: 减少家庭垃圾需要消费者、制造商和地方政府共同努力，改变日常做法。

tip: 表示精力时不可数；表示一次尝试时可数。

senses.en: in a short time

ex.en: The meeting will start soon.
ex.zh: 会议很快就要开始。

ex.en: A leaking roof will soon damage books if a school waits for a perfect budget.
ex.zh: 如果学校一直等一份完美的预算，漏雨的屋顶很快会损坏书籍。

tip: as soon as 引导时间从句，主句将来时，从句用一般现在时。

senses.en: a piece of a whole, or a role

ex.en: This chapter is the hardest part of the book.
ex.zh: 这一章是书里最难的部分。

ex.en: Parents are only one part of a child's education; streets, screens, and friends shape habits too.
ex.zh: 父母只是孩子教育的一部分；街道、屏幕和朋友也会塑造习惯。

tip: take part in 表示参加活动，不要漏掉 in。

senses.en: the leader of a country, club, or some universities

ex.en: The club president will speak first.
ex.zh: 社团主席将首先发言。

ex.en: A student president who only repeats teachers ideas will not represent the class.
ex.zh: 只重复老师想法的学生主席，代表不了班级。

tip: president 在不同机构里可以是总统、主席或大学校长。

senses.en: a person's own nature or identity

ex.en: The exercise asks you to describe your self in three words.
ex.zh: 这个练习请你用三个词描述自己。

ex.en: A sense of self grows when students are trusted with real tasks, not only with tests.
ex.zh: 当学生被托付真正的任务而不只是考试时，自我意识会成长。

tip: self 常构成复合词，如 self-study。复数是 selves。

senses.en: on all sides of, or about
in the surrounding area

ex.en: We walked around the lake after lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭后我们绕着湖走了走。

ex.en: Shops around a school gate affect what students buy between classes, from water to sweets.
ex.zh: 校门口的商店影响着学生课间买什么，从水到糖果都是。

tip: around 表示大约时与 about 接近：around 20 students。

senses.en: something accepted as true

ex.en: Strong belief can give people hope.
ex.zh: 坚定的信念能给人希望。

ex.en: The belief that education improves social mobility influences government spending priorities in many countries.
ex.zh: 教育能促进社会流动的这一信念影响着许多国家的政府支出重点。

col: belief in someone｜对某人的信任
a widely held belief｜普遍持有的看法
contrary to popular belief｜与普遍看法相反
tip: belief in表示信任或信仰；belief that后接具体看法。

senses.en: to keep in the hand, to organise, or to contain

ex.en: Please hold the door for the next person.
ex.zh: 请为后面的人扶住门。

ex.en: A hall that cannot hold the whole school should not be the only place for a fire drill.
ex.zh: 容纳不下全校的礼堂，不该是消防演习的唯一地点。

tip: hold 的过去式和过去分词是 held。

senses.en: from another country

ex.en: She is learning a foreign language.
ex.zh: 她在学一门外语。

ex.en: Foreign news is useful only when students also know how to check the source.
ex.zh: 只有当学生也知道如何核对来源时，外国新闻才有用。

tip: foreign 是形容词，不说 foreign country people，说 people from other countries 或 foreigners。

senses.en: the planet, or soil

ex.en: We live on the earth.
ex.zh: 我们生活在地球上。

ex.en: Healthy earth near a river can hold flood water that concrete sends straight into the street.
ex.zh: 河边健康的土壤能蓄住洪水，而混凝土会把水直接送进街道。

tip: the earth 指地球时常加 the。on earth 也可加强疑问语气。

senses.en: the reflexive form of they

ex.en: The students organised the fair themselves.
ex.zh: 学生们自己组织了这次义卖。

ex.en: Communities can protect a river themselves, but they still need the law behind them.
ex.zh: 社区可以自己保护一条河，但他们仍然需要法律在背后支持。

tip: themselves 不能代替 they 作主语。

senses.en: small, or not much
not much

ex.en: There is little time before the bus leaves.
ex.zh: 汽车开走前时间不多了。

ex.en: A little shade on a playground can make summer sports safer for younger children.
ex.zh: 操场上一点点荫凉，就能让年幼的孩子在夏天运动时更安全。

tip: little 偏否定，表示几乎没有；a little 表示有一点。都修饰不可数名词。

senses.en: of Europe

ex.en: We read a European folk story.
ex.zh: 我们读了一个欧洲民间故事。

ex.en: European visitors bring money to a town, but they also raise rents if housing is already short.
ex.zh: 欧洲游客给城镇带来钱，但如果住房已经短缺，他们也会推高房租。

tip: European 和 Europe 都要大写。

senses.en: the early part of the day

ex.en: I review words every morning.
ex.zh: 我每天早晨复习单词。

ex.en: A hot morning in a room without fans makes the first lesson harder than it needs to be.
ex.zh: 没有风扇的房间里炎热的早晨，会让第一节课难上加难。

tip: 泛指上午用 in the morning；具体某一天上午用 on Monday morning。

senses.en: not inside
outdoors or not inside

ex.en: Please wait outside the office.
ex.zh: 请在办公室外面等。

ex.en: Noise from outside a classroom can undo the quiet a teacher is trying to keep.
ex.zh: 教室外面的噪音可以毁掉老师试图保持的安静。

tip: outside 可作介词或副词。

senses.en: of the darkest colour
the colour black

ex.en: The black cat slept on the warm step.
ex.zh: 黑猫睡在温暖的台阶上。

ex.en: Black smoke from old buses is a daily health problem for students waiting at the stop.
ex.zh: 旧公交冒出的黑烟，是等车学生每天面对的健康问题。

tip: black 也可作名词表示黑色。

senses.en: of the kind already mentioned

ex.en: I have never seen such a clear night sky.
ex.zh: 我从没见过这么晴朗的夜空。

ex.en: Such a small tax on plastic bags can change what millions of shoppers carry home.
ex.zh: 对塑料袋征收如此小的一笔费用，就能改变数百万人拎回家的东西。

tip: such a/an + 形容词 + 可数名词单数；so + 形容词。

senses.en: an act of performing, or how well someone does

ex.en: The music performance starts at seven.
ex.zh: 音乐表演七点开始。

ex.en: A student's performance on one test should not decide the whole story of a year.
ex.zh: 学生一次考试的表现，不该决定一整年的全部故事。

tip: performance 可指演出，也可指工作或学习表现。

senses.en: to give information to someone, or to recognise a difference

ex.en: Please tell me when the meeting starts.
ex.zh: 请告诉我会议什么时候开始。

ex.en: A label should tell shoppers where food comes from, not only how attractive the packet looks.
ex.zh: 标签应该告诉购物者食物来自哪里，而不只是包装有多好看。

col: tell sb to do｜叫某人做
tip: tell 后面接人：tell sb sth。say 后面接说的内容，不直接接人。

senses.en: the sound of speaking, or the right to speak

ex.en: She has a clear voice.
ex.zh: 她的声音很清楚。

ex.en: Students need a voice in decisions about the hour their school day starts.
ex.zh: 关于上学时间的决定，学生需要有发言权。

tip: voice 多指人的嗓音；sound 是任何声音。

senses.en: a series of lessons, or the way something develops

ex.en: I chose a history course this term.
ex.zh: 这学期我选了一门历史课。

ex.en: Of course a new course needs books, but it also needs a teacher who has time to mark them.
ex.zh: 新课程当然需要书，但也需要有时间批改的老师。

col: in the course of｜在……过程中
tip: course 表示课程；of course 是固定短语“当然”。

senses.en: a male ruler

ex.en: The story is about a king who listened to farmers.
ex.zh: 故事讲的是一位倾听农民的国王。

ex.en: Even a king in an old tale needed roads and grain, which is still true of any government.
ex.zh: 即使是旧故事里的国王也需要道路和粮食，任何政府今天仍然如此。

tip: king 是可数名词。

senses.en: to make someone believe

ex.en: She tried to convince him to stay.
ex.zh: 她试图说服他留下来。

ex.en: Governments must convince residents that improved public transport offers a practical alternative to private cars.
ex.zh: 政府必须让居民相信，改善后的公共交通能够切实替代私家车出行。

col: convince someone of something｜使某人相信某事
convince someone to do something｜说服某人做某事
tip: convince sb of sth表示使某人相信某事。

senses.en: a married woman

ex.en: His wife teaches at the primary school.
ex.zh: 他的妻子在小学教书。

ex.en: A wife who works nights still needs a safe bus home after the last shift.
ex.zh: 上夜班的妻子在最后一班结束后，仍然需要一趟安全的回家公交。

tip: wife 的复数是 wives。

senses.en: to want something to happen
a feeling of wanting something good

ex.en: I hope to see you at the concert.
ex.zh: 我希望在音乐会上见到你。

ex.en: Families hope the new clinic will open before winter, when travel on icy roads is harder.
ex.zh: 家人希望新诊所在冬天前开业，因为结冰的路更难走。

col: in the hope of｜抱着……的希望
tip: hope 后接 to do 或 that 从句，不说 hope sb to do。

senses.en: to control a vehicle, or to force something forward
a journey in a car

ex.en: My uncle drives to work.
ex.zh: 我叔叔开车上班。

ex.en: High rents drive workers out of the centre, and then the morning roads fill with cars.
ex.zh: 高房租把工人赶出市中心，然后早晨的路就挤满了汽车。

col: drive sb to｜开车送某人去
tip: drive 的过去式是 drove，过去分词是 driven。

senses.en: to ask for firmly
a strong request that someone expects to be obeyed
to insist on receiving something or require something essential

ex.en: Workers demand better pay and safety.
ex.zh: 工人们要求更好的薪酬和安全。

ex.en: Growing demand for affordable housing has encouraged local authorities to convert unused office buildings into residential accommodation.
ex.zh: 对可负担住房不断增长的需求促使地方政府将闲置办公楼改建为住宅。

tip: 要求做某事用demand to do，不用demand sb to do。

senses.en: the front of the head
to deal with a difficult situation

ex.en: She had a smile on her face.
ex.zh: 她脸上带着微笑。

ex.en: A city must face the fact that cheap housing and clean air are both necessary.
ex.zh: 一座城市必须面对这个事实：廉价住房和干净空气都是必需的。

tip: face 作动词表示面对：face a problem，不要说 face to a problem。

senses.en: to say something is true; to allow in
to allow someone to enter or join a place or institution

ex.en: He had to admit that he was wrong.
ex.zh: 他不得不承认自己错了。

ex.en: Governments should admit when policies have failed and use reliable evidence to develop more effective alternatives.
ex.zh: 政府应承认政策失败，并依据可靠证据制定更有效的替代方案。

col: admit doing something｜承认做过某事
be admitted to hospital｜被收治入院
tip: 用admit doing，不用admit to do；过去式双写t。

senses.en: to give something that is needed

ex.en: The school provides lunch for students.
ex.zh: 学校为学生提供午餐。

ex.en: Cities should provide lights on the road home, not only seats in the classroom.
ex.zh: 城市应该在回家的路上提供照明，而不只是教室里的座位。

col: provide sb with sth｜向某人提供
provide sth for sb｜为某人提供
tip: provide 的两种搭配：provide sb with sth 或 provide sth for sb。

senses.en: to make known publicly

ex.en: The teacher will announce the exam date tomorrow.
ex.zh: 老师明天会宣布考试日期。

ex.en: Local authorities should announce major policy changes early so residents have enough time to prepare.
ex.zh: 地方政府应尽早公布重大政策调整，让居民有充足的准备时间。

tip: 用announce sth或announce that，不用announce sb sth。

senses.en: people living together under shared rules

ex.en: Schools are part of society, not separate from it.
ex.zh: 学校是社会的一部分，不是与之分开的。

ex.en: A society that measures success only by test scores will miss students who help their families after class.
ex.zh: 只用考分衡量成功的社会，会忽略那些课后帮助家人的学生。

tip: society 可数。the society 有时指某个社团。

senses.en: a way for vehicles

ex.en: The road to the museum is closed today.
ex.zh: 去博物馆的路今天封闭。

ex.en: A wider road can invite more cars unless buses and bikes are given space too.
ex.zh: 更宽的路会招来更多汽车，除非公交和自行车也有空间。

tip: road 多指车辆道路；street 多指两边有建筑的街道。

senses.en: having a high temperature

ex.en: The classroom was too hot to concentrate.
ex.zh: 教室热得无法集中注意力。

ex.en: Hot nights without fans make it harder for students to sleep before an exam.
ex.zh: 没有风扇的炎热夜晚，让学生更难在考试前入睡。

tip: hot 的比较级是 hotter。

senses.en: to choose, or to take fruit or flowers

ex.en: Pick a question you can explain.
ex.zh: 选一道你能解释的题。

ex.en: Families pick a school they can reach, not only the one with the highest scores.
ex.zh: 家庭会选择他们能够到达的学校，而不只是分数最高的那所。

tip: pick up sb 可以表示开车接人。

senses.en: of the colour of a clear sky
the colour blue

ex.en: She wore a blue coat.
ex.zh: 她穿了一件蓝色外套。

ex.en: Blue signs that nobody can read at night do not make a crossing safer.
ex.zh: 夜里没人看得清的蓝色标志，并不能让过街更安全。

tip: blue 也可作名词表示蓝色。

senses.en: help given to people, or a public system

ex.en: The bus service stops at ten.
ex.zh: 公交服务十点结束。

ex.en: A health service that only works in the city centre leaves villages waiting for basic care.
ex.zh: 只在市中心运转的医疗服务，会让乡村等待基本的照料。

tip: service 表示服务时常不可数；一项具体服务有时用 a service。

senses.en: the worldwide computer network

ex.en: I checked the bus times on the Internet.
ex.zh: 我在网上查了公交时刻。

ex.en: The Internet spreads a correction slowly if the false picture was more exciting.
ex.zh: 如果假图片更刺激，互联网传播更正就会很慢。

tip: Internet 常大写，前面加 the。

senses.en: a set of different things, or the limits of something
to vary between limits

ex.en: The shop sells a wide range of pens.
ex.zh: 这家店卖各种各样的笔。

ex.en: A wide range of bus times helps workers whose shifts do not match a school day.
ex.zh: 多样的公交班次有助于那些班次和上学日对不上的工人。

col: in the range of｜在……范围内
tip: range from A to B 表示范围从 A 到 B。

senses.en: to be unable to find, or to be beaten

ex.en: Do not lose your student card.
ex.zh: 别弄丢学生证。

ex.en: Towns lose young workers when housing, jobs, and buses are all somewhere else.
ex.zh: 当住房、工作和公交都在别处时，城镇会失去年轻工人。

tip: lose 的过去式和过去分词是 lost。

senses.en: a light in the night sky, or a famous performer

ex.en: We could see one bright star above the hill.
ex.zh: 我们能看见山上空一颗明亮的星。

ex.en: A film star visiting a school for one hour does less than a teacher who stays all year.
ex.zh: 在学校停留一小时的电影明星，不如全年留下来的老师做得更多。

tip: star 作动词是“主演”。

senses.en: the end of life

ex.en: The story ends with the death of the old tree.
ex.zh: 故事以那棵老树的死亡结束。

ex.en: Heat-related death is more common in neighbourhoods with little shade and few clinics.
ex.zh: 与高温有关的死亡，在少荫凉、少诊所的社区更常见。

tip: death 是名词；die 是动词；dead 是形容词。

senses.en: the making of beautiful or expressive things

ex.en: There is an art show in the hall.
ex.zh: 大厅里有一场艺术展。

ex.en: Public art on a dull wall can make a walk to school feel shorter and safer.
ex.zh: 单调墙上的公共艺术，能让走路上学感觉更短、更安全。

tip: art 泛指艺术时不可数。the arts 可指多种艺术。

senses.en: to separate into pieces, or to disobey
a short rest

ex.en: Do not break the lab rules.
ex.zh: 不要违反实验室规则。

ex.en: If a pipe breaks under a school, classes stop even when the building looks fine.
ex.zh: 如果学校底下的管子破裂，即使楼看起来没事，课也会停。

tip: break 的过去式是 broke，过去分词是 broken。

senses.en: how good something is

ex.en: The quality of the recording is poor.
ex.zh: 这段录音的质量很差。

ex.en: Air quality outside a school matters as much as the quality of the books inside.
ex.zh: 学校外面的空气质量和里面的书的质量一样重要。

tip: quality 表示质量时常不可数。

senses.en: costing nothing, or not busy, or not controlled

ex.en: Are you free after class today?
ex.zh: 你今天课后有空吗？

ex.en: Free entry to museums matters most to families who would not pay for a ticket.
ex.zh: 博物馆免费入场，对那些本来不会买票的家庭最为重要。

tip: free 表示免费或有空；freely 才是副词“自由地”。

senses.en: something that happens, or a race in a sports meeting

ex.en: The sports event starts at nine.
ex.zh: 体育项目九点开始。

ex.en: A public event in the square should leave a path so people can still reach the clinic.
ex.zh: 广场上的公共活动应该留出一条路，让人们仍能到达诊所。

col: in the event of｜如果发生
tip: event 是可数名词。

senses.en: used to contrast with what was just said

ex.en: The plan is costly. However, it may save water.
ex.zh: 这个计划花费很大。然而，它也许能节水。

ex.en: The museum is free. However, families who live an hour away still pay for the bus.
ex.zh: 博物馆是免费的。然而，住在一小时车程外的家庭仍然要付公交费。

tip: however 是副词，前后常用句号或分号；but 是连词，连接两个分句。

senses.en: here now, or existing at this time
a gift, or the time now
to show or give formally

ex.en: All the students were present.
ex.zh: 所有学生都到了。

ex.en: The present bus timetable ignores the hour when the factory shift ends.
ex.zh: 目前的公交时刻表忽略了工厂换班结束的时间。

tip: present 作名词“礼物”或动词“呈现”时重音在第二音节。

senses.en: a female parent

ex.en: My mother works at the hospital.
ex.zh: 我母亲在医院工作。

ex.en: A mother on a night shift needs the school to understand why her child sometimes arrives tired.
ex.zh: 上夜班的母亲需要学校理解她的孩子为什么有时疲惫地到校。

tip: mother 较正式；mum 或 mom 更口语。

senses.en: to take part in a game, or to perform music
a piece of writing for the theatre, or a game

ex.en: We play basketball after school.
ex.zh: 我们放学后打篮球。

ex.en: Children who play outside learn to judge risk in a way that a screen cannot teach.
ex.zh: 在户外玩耍的孩子会学习判断风险，这是屏幕教不会的。

tip: 球类前不加 the：play football；乐器前加 the：play the violin。

senses.en: to use force, or to try hard to stop something
a struggle

ex.en: We should not fight in the corridor.
ex.zh: 我们不该在走廊里打架。

ex.en: Communities fight flooding with drains and trees, not only with photos after the water has gone.
ex.zh: 社区用排水和树木对抗洪水，而不只是在水退后拍照。

tip: fight 的过去式和过去分词是 fought。

senses.en: to take air in and out

ex.en: It is hard to breathe in heavy smoke.
ex.zh: 浓烟中很难呼吸。

ex.en: People living near busy roads often breathe polluted air, which can increase their risk of respiratory illness.
ex.zh: 住在繁忙道路附近的人经常吸入受污染的空气，这可能增加他们患呼吸系统疾病的风险。

col: breathe fresh air｜呼吸新鲜空气
tip: breathe是动词，末音/ð/；breath是名词，末音/θ/。

senses.en: of the colour of snow
the colour white

ex.en: Write your name on the white card.
ex.zh: 把名字写在白色卡片上。

ex.en: White roofs can reflect summer heat and make classrooms easier to cool.
ex.zh: 白色屋顶能反射夏日热量，让教室更容易降温。

tip: white 也可作名词，表示白色。

senses.en: big in size or amount

ex.en: We need a large table for the maps.
ex.zh: 我们需要一张大桌子放地图。

ex.en: A large school on the edge of town forces many children into long bus rides.
ex.zh: 城边的大学校会迫使许多孩子长时间乘公交。

tip: large 比 big 更正式，常修饰数量和面积。

senses.en: sixty minutes

ex.en: The talk lasted one hour.
ex.zh: 讲座持续了一个小时。

ex.en: An extra hour on the bus each day takes time away from sleep and homework.
ex.zh: 每天在公交上多一个小时，会占去睡眠和作业的时间。

col: an hour's walk｜步行一小时的路程
tip: hour 前的 an 不省：an hour。

senses.en: containing as much as possible, or complete

ex.en: The bus was full, so we waited for the next one.
ex.zh: 公交车满了，所以我们等下一辆。

ex.en: A diary full of small observations can later explain how a neighbourhood changed year by year.
ex.zh: 记满细小观察的日记，日后可以解释一个社区如何逐年变化。

tip: be full of 表示充满；fill 是动词“装满”。

senses.en: to take place

ex.en: What happened after the bell?
ex.zh: 铃响之后发生了什么？

ex.en: Floods happen more often when drains were built for a smaller town.
ex.zh: 当排水系统按更小的城镇修建时，洪水会更常发生。

col: happen to sb｜发生在某人身上
tip: happen 是不及物动词，没有被动语态。某事发生在某人身上用 happen to sb。

senses.en: truthful
Expressing what you really think or feel.

ex.en: Be honest about your mistakes.
ex.zh: 对自己的错误要诚实。

ex.en: Honest communication between teachers and parents can help schools address students' difficulties before they become serious.
ex.zh: 教师与家长之间坦诚的沟通能帮助学校在学生的问题变得严重之前加以解决。

tip: h不发音，因此说an honest person。

senses.en: a good result

ex.en: The book fair was a success.
ex.zh: 书展很成功。

ex.en: Success for a bus line is not a full photo; it is whether workers arrive on time.
ex.zh: 一条公交线的成功不是一张挤满的照片，而是工人是否准时到达。

tip: success 作“成功”时常不可数；一次成功的事可用 a success。

senses.en: a figure, or a quantity

ex.en: Write your seat number in the corner.
ex.zh: 把座位号写在角落里。

ex.en: The number of cars has grown faster than the number of safe places for children to cross.
ex.zh: 汽车数量的增长，快过儿童安全过街地点的增长。

tip: a number of 作主语时谓语常用复数；the number of 作主语时谓语用单数。

senses.en: to take pleasure in

ex.en: I enjoy reading by the window.
ex.zh: 我喜欢靠窗阅读。

ex.en: People enjoy a riverside path more when the water does not smell of waste.
ex.zh: 当水没有废物的气味时，人们更喜欢河边的小路。

tip: enjoy 后接 doing，不接 to do。

senses.en: to harm
Harm something or make it less effective.

ex.en: Floods can damage houses and roads.
ex.zh: 洪水会毁坏房屋和道路。

ex.en: Uncontrolled tourism can damage fragile ecosystems and reduce the quality of life for local residents.
ex.zh: 不受控制的旅游活动可能破坏脆弱的生态系统，并降低当地居民的生活质量。

col: damage someone's reputation｜损害某人的声誉
tip: 损害用不可数damage；damages指法律赔偿金。

senses.en: a length of time, a full stop, or a lesson

ex.en: We have a free period on Wednesday.
ex.zh: 我们周三有一节空课。

ex.en: A dry period of only one month can empty a village tank if nobody measured the water.
ex.zh: 如果没人计量用水，仅仅一个月的干旱也能抽干村里的水箱。

tip: 美式英语里 period 也指句号。

senses.en: thankful

ex.en: I am grateful for your help.
ex.zh: 我感激你的帮助。

ex.en: Many students are grateful for scholarships that allow them to continue their education despite financial difficulties.
ex.zh: 许多学生感谢奖学金让他们即使经济困难也能继续学业。

tip: be grateful to某人 for某事；注意不是greatful。

senses.en: at any time

ex.en: Have you ever visited the city museum?
ex.zh: 你去过市博物馆吗？

ex.en: If a river has ever flooded the same street twice, planners should stop building basements there.
ex.zh: 如果一条河曾两次淹没同一条街，规划者就不该再在那里建地下室。

tip: ever 常用于疑问句和否定句；肯定句里的“曾经”多用 once。

senses.en: a piece of writing, a thing, or a/an/the

ex.en: I read an article about school buses.
ex.zh: 我读了一篇关于校车的文章。

ex.en: An article without a named source is hard to trust, however smooth the sentences are.
ex.zh: 没有署名来源的文章很难信任，无论句子多么流畅。

tip: article 也可指语法里的冠词 a、an、the。

senses.en: to be on one's feet, or to bear

ex.en: Please stand in line.
ex.zh: 请排队站好。

ex.en: A small shop cannot stand a year of road works that stop customers reaching the door.
ex.zh: 一家小店受不了一整年让顾客到不了门口的道路施工。

tip: stand 的过去式和过去分词是 stood。

senses.en: in place of something else

ex.en: We walked instead of taking the bus.
ex.zh: 我们没有坐公交，而是走路。

ex.en: Planting trees instead of only widening roads can cool a street and slow the rain.
ex.zh: 种树而不是只拓宽道路，可以给街道降温，并减缓雨水。

tip: instead 可放句首或句末；instead of 后接名词或 doing。

senses.en: used for obligation or a strong guess

ex.en: You must wear glasses in the lab.
ex.zh: 在实验室里你必须戴眼镜。

ex.en: A public promise must be followed by a date and a person responsible, or it is only a sentence.
ex.zh: 一项公开承诺必须跟上日期和负责人，否则就只是一句话。

tip: must not 表示禁止；不必是 don't have to 或 needn't。

senses.en: short in time or words
To give someone essential information or instructions.
Instructions explaining what a task should achieve.

ex.en: Give a brief summary.
ex.zh: 做个简短总结。

ex.en: Teachers should brief students on safety procedures before allowing them to conduct experiments independently.
ex.zh: 教师应先向学生介绍安全操作规程，再允许他们独立进行实验。

col: brief someone on｜向某人介绍……的情况
a design brief｜设计任务说明
tip: brief指时间短或内容简洁，本身不表示草率。

senses.en: each one in a group, seen as a whole

ex.en: Every student has a chance to speak.
ex.zh: 每个学生都有发言的机会。

ex.en: Every extra degree of summer heat makes it harder to keep classrooms comfortable without more energy.
ex.zh: 夏天每升高一度，都让教室在不增加能耗的情况下更难保持舒适。

tip: every 后接单数名词；every day 是短语，everyday 是形容词“日常的”。

senses.en: to some degree, or completely

ex.en: The room is quite quiet after four.
ex.zh: 四点以后房间相当安静。

ex.en: A cycle lane that is quite short still helps if it crosses the most dangerous junction.
ex.zh: 一段相当短的自行车道，如果穿过最危险的路口，仍然有帮助。

tip: quite a + 形容词 + 名词：quite a long walk。不说 a quite long walk。

senses.en: to put something with something else

ex.en: Add your name at the bottom.
ex.zh: 在底部加上你的名字。

ex.en: Cities that add lanes without adding buses often add cars as well.
ex.zh: 只加车道不加公交的城市，往往也增加了汽车。

tip: add A to B 表示把 A 加到 B 上。

senses.en: something that is known to be true

ex.en: In fact, the library opens at eight.
ex.zh: 事实上，图书馆八点开门。

ex.en: A fact about air pollution should be separated from an opinion about who is to blame.
ex.zh: 关于空气污染的事实，应该和谁该受责备的看法分开。

col: as a matter of fact｜事实上
tip: fact 是可数名词。the fact that 后接从句。

senses.en: pleasant or kind

ex.en: It was nice of you to wait for me.
ex.zh: 你等我，真是太好了。

ex.en: A nice park on a map is not enough if the path to it is dark and unsafe at night.
ex.zh: 地图上一个好看的公园不够，如果去那里的路夜里又黑又不安全。

tip: It is nice of sb to do 表扬某人的善意。

senses.en: complete, or including everything
the whole amount
to add up to

ex.en: The total cost is eighty yuan.
ex.zh: 总费用是八十元。

ex.en: A total ban on cars near schools works only if buses can carry the same children.
ex.zh: 学校附近全面禁车，只有在公交能运送同样的孩子时才行得通。

tip: total 作动词是“合计”。

senses.en: approved by an authority
a person with a public position

ex.en: Wait for the official notice before you change the date.
ex.zh: 改日期之前请等官方通知。

ex.en: An official report that hides bad numbers does not help a town prepare for the next flood.
ex.zh: 隐瞒糟糕数字的官方报告，帮不了一个城镇为下一次洪水做准备。

tip: official 作名词是“官员”。

senses.en: having a big effect or value

ex.en: It is important to write the date on the form.
ex.zh: 在表格上写日期很重要。

ex.en: Clean drinking water is more important to a growing town than another bright shopping sign.
ex.zh: 对一个发展中的城镇来说，干净的饮用水比又一块闪亮的商店招牌更重要。

tip: It is important for sb to do，不要漏掉 for 或 to。

senses.en: to walk with regular steps, often in a group
a walk by a group, or the third month when capitalised

ex.en: The band will march onto the field.
ex.zh: 乐队将列队走上场地。

ex.en: People march when a decision about their street is made without asking them.
ex.zh: 当关于他们街道的决定没有询问他们就做出时，人们会游行。

tip: March 大写是三月；march 小写是行进。不要在句子里混用大小写。

senses.en: to agree with and help, or to provide what is needed
help or approval

ex.en: Our class supports the book-sharing plan.
ex.zh: 我们班支持图书共享计划。

ex.en: Parents cannot support a long school day if the buses stop before the last lesson ends.
ex.zh: 如果公交车在最后一节课结束前就停运，父母就无法支持过长的在校时间。

col: support sb in｜在某方面支持
tip: support 是及物动词，后面直接接宾语，不加 to。

senses.en: a building where people live

ex.en: Their house is next to the post office.
ex.zh: 他们的房子在邮局旁边。

ex.en: A house built on cheap wetland may cost less at first and much more after the first flood.
ex.zh: 建在廉价湿地上的房子，起初可能更便宜，第一次洪水之后却贵得多。

tip: house 是建筑物；home 是家的感觉或所在。

senses.en: to decide after thinking; to end

ex.en: We can conclude that practice helps.
ex.zh: 我们可以得出结论：练习有帮助。

meta.pipelineNote: IPA/topic pending; not in Word Atlas overlap

senses.en: to have an influence on
to cause someone to feel a strong emotion

ex.en: Noise can affect your ability to sleep.
ex.zh: 噪音会影响你的睡眠能力。

ex.en: Rising food prices disproportionately affect poorer households, which spend a larger share of their income on essentials.
ex.zh: 食品价格上涨对较贫困家庭的影响尤为严重，因为必需品支出占其收入的比例更大。

col: deeply affect someone｜深深触动某人
tip: 表示“影响”时affect是动词，effect通常是名词。

senses.en: a place where people buy and sell

ex.en: We buy fruit at the morning market.
ex.zh: 我们在早市买水果。

ex.en: A local market keeps money in the town, while a distant supermarket sends it away.
ex.zh: 本地市场把钱留在镇上，而远处的超市把钱送走。

tip: market 作动词是“推销”。

senses.en: something that helps you
A useful or positive feature of something.

ex.en: Speaking two languages is an advantage.
ex.zh: 会说两种语言是一种优势。

ex.en: One major advantage of public transport is its ability to reduce traffic congestion in urban areas.
ex.zh: 公共交通的一大好处是能够缓解城市地区的交通拥堵。

col: have an advantage over｜比……有优势
tip: take advantage of可指利用机会，也可指占人便宜。

senses.en: after the expected time
after the right time

ex.en: I was late because the bus did not come.
ex.zh: 我迟到了，因为公交没来。

ex.en: Late buses leave students waiting in the dark, which is a safety problem as well as a delay.
ex.zh: 晚点的公交让学生在黑暗中等待，这既是延误，也是安全问题。

tip: late 可作形容词或副词。lately 是“最近”，不是“迟到地”。

senses.en: how old someone is, or a period of history

ex.en: What is the age of the oldest student in the club?
ex.zh: 社团里年龄最大的学生几岁？

ex.en: In an age of cheap photos, it is harder to know which picture shows a real event.
ex.zh: 在照片便宜的时代，更难知道哪张照片展示的是真事。

tip: at the age of 后接数字。同龄用 of the same age。

senses.en: something that can be heard
to seem when heard
in good condition, or sensible

ex.en: I heard a sound in the hall.
ex.zh: 我听见大厅里有声音。

ex.en: The sound of night traffic keeps students awake even when the classroom itself is quiet.
ex.zh: 夜间交通的声音会让学生睡不着，即使教室本身很安静。

tip: sound 作连系动词后接形容词：sound good，不接 well 表示“听起来好”（身体好除外）。

senses.en: a wish to know more, or an advantage
to make someone want to know more

ex.en: She has an interest in local history.
ex.zh: 她对本地历史有兴趣。

ex.en: A company interest in cheap land is not the same as a town interest in clean water.
ex.zh: 公司对廉价土地的利益，不等于城镇对干净水的利益。

tip: interesting 修饰事物；interested 修饰人。

senses.en: to ask for money; to accuse
An amount of money requested for goods or services.
Put electrical energy into a battery or device.

ex.en: Hotels often charge extra for breakfast.
ex.zh: 酒店常对早餐额外收费。

ex.en: Museums that charge admission fees should offer discounts to ensure that students can still access cultural resources.
ex.zh: 收取门票的博物馆应提供优惠，以确保学生仍能享用文化资源。

tip: 向某人收取某项费用：charge someone for something。

senses.en: no longer alive

ex.en: The plant is dead because nobody watered it.
ex.zh: 这棵植物死了，因为没人浇水。

ex.en: A river that looks dead in summer may recover if factories stop pouring waste at night.
ex.zh: 夏天看起来死气沉沉的河，如果工厂停止夜里排污，仍可能恢复。

tip: dead 是形容词；die 是动词；death 是名词。

senses.en: to have a particular meaning, or to intend
not generous, or unkind

ex.en: What does this word mean in the passage?
ex.zh: 这个词在文章里是什么意思？

ex.en: A low score does not mean a student cannot learn; it may mean the test ignored what they can do.
ex.zh: 低分并不意味着学生学不会；它可能意味着考试忽略了他们会做的事。

tip: mean to do 是打算；mean doing 是意味着。

senses.en: to make something not closed, or to start a business
not closed, or public

ex.en: Open the window if the room feels hot.
ex.zh: 如果房间闷，就把窗户打开。

ex.en: Shops that open late help workers who cannot buy food before their shift ends.
ex.zh: 营业到很晚的商店，帮助那些下班前买不到食物的工人。

tip: open 作形容词是“开着的”；be open 表示状态，不要说 be opened 表示日常开着。

senses.en: matching the facts

ex.en: Is it true that the museum is free today?
ex.zh: 博物馆今天免费，这是真的吗？

ex.en: A story can sound true and still leave out the people who were harmed.
ex.zh: 一个故事可以听起来真实，却仍然漏掉受到伤害的人。

tip: come true 的主语是梦想或预言，不用被动。true 强调符合事实。

senses.en: an agreement, or an amount
to handle, or to do business

ex.en: We made a deal to share the cleaning.
ex.zh: 我们说好轮流打扫。

ex.en: A great deal of plastic leaves a school every day if the canteen still uses single-use boxes.
ex.zh: 如果食堂仍用一次性盒子，学校每天都会送出大量塑料。

tip: a great deal of 后接不可数名词。deal with 表示处理。

senses.en: a way of doing something

ex.en: The bus is our only means of getting to the museum.
ex.zh: 公交是我们去博物馆的唯一办法。

ex.en: A means of checking news matters when a false photo can travel faster than a correction.
ex.zh: 当一张假照片比更正传得更快时，核对新闻的方法就很重要。

tip: means 单复数同形。a means 是一种方法，谓语用单数。

senses.en: for everyone, or known to people in general
people in general

ex.en: The public library is open on Sundays.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆周日开放。

ex.en: Public money should be easy to trace, from the tax office to the classroom it is meant to support.
ex.zh: 公共资金应该易于追踪，从税务部门一直到它本应支持的教室。

tip: the public 表示公众，谓语常用单数。

senses.en: studying again, or a report judging something
to study again, or to judge

ex.en: We did a review of last week's words.
ex.zh: 我们复习了上周的单词。

ex.en: A review of a new road should include the people who walk it, not only the engineers.
ex.zh: 对新路的评议应该包括走这条路的人，而不只是工程师。

tip: review 作动词是“复习”或“评论”。

senses.en: a way of thinking or feeling

ex.en: A positive attitude helps in hard times.
ex.zh: 积极态度有助于渡过难关。

ex.en: Schools can encourage a positive attitude towards learning by giving students constructive feedback rather than constant criticism.
ex.zh: 学校可以给予学生建设性的反馈，而非不断批评，以培养积极的学习态度。

tip: 对某事的态度常用attitude to或towards。

senses.en: the act of choosing, or what is chosen

ex.en: You have a choice of two questions.
ex.zh: 你可以在两道题里选。

ex.en: A real choice of school exists only when a family can reach it by bus or on foot.
ex.zh: 只有当家庭能乘公交或步行到达时，择校才是真正的选择。

tip: choice 是名词；choose 是动词。

senses.en: to come back, or to give something back
the act of coming back

ex.en: Please return the book by Friday.
ex.zh: 请在周五前还书。

ex.en: Young people return to a town when there is work, not only when they miss their family.
ex.zh: 年轻人回到城镇是因为有工作，而不只是因为想念家人。

tip: return 本身含“回”，不要说 return back。

senses.en: any person

ex.en: Anyone can borrow books with a library card.
ex.zh: 任何人有借书证都可以借书。

ex.en: Anyone planning a new road should ask the people who will walk beside it every day.
ex.zh: 任何计划修新路的人，都应该问问每天要在路边走的人。

tip: anyone 作主语时谓语用单数。疑问句和否定句比 someone 更常见。

senses.en: very pleasing to see or hear

ex.en: The lake looks beautiful in the morning.
ex.zh: 湖在早晨看起来很美。

ex.en: A beautiful old street can still be unsafe if cars park across the pavement.
ex.zh: 一条美丽的老街，如果汽车停满人行道，仍然可能不安全。

tip: beautiful 可形容人、景色或声音。

senses.en: a situation, a legal matter, or a container

ex.en: In this case, we should ask the teacher.
ex.zh: 在这种情况下，我们应该问老师。

ex.en: In the case of a city flood, the first question is which roads still lead to the hospital.
ex.zh: 如果城市内涝，第一个问题是哪些路仍然通向医院。

tip: in case 后接句子，表示以防万一；in case of 后接名词。

senses.en: the warmest season

ex.en: The sports meet is in early summer.
ex.zh: 运动会在初夏举行。

ex.en: A hotter summer makes classrooms without fans harder places to learn.
ex.zh: 更热的夏天让没有风扇的教室更难学习。

tip: 季节前常用 in，不加 the：in summer。

senses.en: a number of people or things together

ex.en: Our group will present first.
ex.zh: 我们组第一个展示。

ex.en: A small group of volunteers can keep a community library open when the town budget is thin.
ex.zh: 当城镇预算紧张时，一小群志愿者也能维持社区图书馆开放。

tip: a group of 加复数名词时，谓语可随强调整体或成员而变化。

senses.en: a person who belongs to a group

ex.en: She is a member of the science club.
ex.zh: 她是科学社团的成员。

ex.en: Every member of a team should know who will speak if the plan fails.
ex.zh: 团队的每个成员都应该知道，如果计划失败由谁来说明。

tip: member 后常用 of，不用 in。

senses.en: a female child

ex.en: Her daughter studies at this school.
ex.zh: 她的女儿在这所学校上学。

ex.en: A daughter who wants to study engineering should see women doing that work.
ex.zh: 想学工程的女儿，应该看到有女性在做这份工作。

tip: daughter 的复数是 daughters。

senses.en: during the time that, or whereas
a period of time

ex.en: I listened to the recording while I washed the dishes.
ex.zh: 我洗碗时听了录音。

ex.en: Some cities invest in stadiums while their oldest school buildings still leak in the rain.
ex.zh: 一些城市投资体育场，而它们最老的校舍下雨时仍在漏水。

tip: while 可表示对比，相当于“而”；一段时间用 for a while。

senses.en: a place where children are educated

ex.en: Our school has a new science lab.
ex.zh: 我们学校有一间新的科学实验室。

ex.en: A school that stays open in the evening can give working parents a safe place for their children.
ex.zh: 晚上仍然开放的学校，可以为上班的父母提供一个孩子的安全去处。

tip: go to school 泛指上学，school 前通常不加 the。

senses.en: to put, arrange, or establish
a group of things that belong together

ex.en: Please set the chairs in a circle.
ex.zh: 请把椅子摆成一圈。

ex.en: If a school sets homework without time to sleep, the extra pages may lower the next day's attention.
ex.zh: 如果学校布置的作业挤掉了睡眠，多出来的页数可能会降低第二天的注意力。

tip: set 的过去式和过去分词都是 set。a set of 后接复数名词。

senses.en: at all times

ex.en: She always checks her answers twice.
ex.zh: 她总是把答案检查两遍。

ex.en: Towns that always build on the cheapest land may later discover that the ground floods.
ex.zh: 总在最便宜的土地上建设的城镇，日后可能会发现那块地会积水。

tip: always 放在实义动词前、be 动词后。

senses.en: past events, or the study of them

ex.en: We have a history test on Friday.
ex.zh: 我们周五有历史测验。

ex.en: Local history is easier to care about when students can visit the street the textbook describes.
ex.zh: 当学生能去教科书描写的那条街时，本地历史就更容易让人在意。

tip: history 作学科不可数。historical 是“历史的”；historic 常指有历史意义的。

senses.en: a workers' organisation, or a joining together

ex.en: The union asked for safer night buses.
ex.zh: 工会要求更安全的夜班公交。

ex.en: A union of small shops can buy together and keep a market alive.
ex.zh: 小店的联合可以一起进货，并让市场继续活着。

tip: the European Union 是欧洲联盟。

senses.en: whether a person is male or female

ex.en: The form asks for your name and sex.
ex.zh: 表格要填写姓名和性别。

ex.en: A school sports rule based only on sex can be unfair if it ignores what each student can actually do.
ex.zh: 只按性别制定的学校体育规则，如果忽略每个学生实际能做什么，就可能不公平。

tip: sex 在考纲里主要作“性别”，填写表格时用。

senses.en: a result
To bring about a change or result.

ex.en: Sleep has a strong effect on mood.
ex.zh: 睡眠对情绪有强烈影响。

ex.en: Higher parking charges may have little effect on traffic unless reliable public transport is also available.
ex.zh: 如果没有可靠的公共交通，提高停车费对交通状况的影响可能很小。

col: have an effect on｜对……有影响
tip: effect常作名词；affect常作动词，意为影响。

senses.en: a part of a place, or the size of a surface

ex.en: This area of the library is for quiet study.
ex.zh: 图书馆这一区是安静学习用的。

ex.en: Industrial areas beside rivers need stricter rules, because waste travels farther than the factory gate.
ex.zh: 河边的工业区需要更严的规定，因为废物会流到比厂门更远的地方。

tip: area 可指地区或面积，面积不可数时仍说 an area of。

senses.en: to ask formally; to use
To use something practically, or be relevant to a situation
To spread a substance onto a surface

ex.en: She will apply for a scholarship.
ex.zh: 她将申请奖学金。

ex.en: Universities should encourage students from disadvantaged backgrounds to apply for scholarships that cover tuition and living expenses.
ex.zh: 大学应鼓励家庭条件困难的学生申请涵盖学费和生活费的奖学金。

col: apply for a job｜申请工作
apply to a university｜向大学提出申请
tip: apply for接申请事项；apply to接机构或适用对象。

senses.en: happening at once
prepared very quickly, usually by adding hot water
an extremely short period of time

ex.en: She got an instant reply.
ex.zh: 她得到了立即回复。

ex.en: Digital platforms provide instant access to educational resources, although reliable internet connections remain essential.
ex.zh: 数字平台让人们即时获取教育资源，但稳定的网络连接仍然必不可少。

tip: instant作形容词表示即时的；in an instant表示转眼间。

senses.en: a final decision or end
the final part or ending of something

ex.en: The conclusion of the report is clear.
ex.zh: 报告的结论很清楚。

ex.en: Researchers should consider alternative explanations before drawing a conclusion from a relatively small sample.
ex.zh: 研究人员根据较小的样本得出结论之前，应考虑其他可能的解释。

tip: “得出结论”用reach或draw a conclusion，不用make。

senses.en: trade, a company, or a matter to deal with

ex.en: Her aunt runs a small business near the station.
ex.zh: 她阿姨在车站附近做小生意。

ex.en: A business that ignores its waste may save money this year and lose the trust of the town next year.
ex.zh: 忽视废弃物的企业今年也许省了钱，明年却可能失去城镇的信任。

col: none of one's business｜不关某人的事
tip: business 表示生意时可不可数；表示一家企业时可数。

senses.en: the way people or things are connected

ex.en: The relationship between the two clubs is friendly.
ex.zh: 两个社团的关系很友好。

ex.en: The relationship between rent and bus fares decides whether a worker can live near a job.
ex.zh: 房租和公交费之间的关系，决定工人能否住在工作附近。

tip: relationship 比 relation 更常指人与人的关系。

senses.en: what a person or thing is called
to give a name, or to say a name

ex.en: Please write your name in capital letters.
ex.zh: 请用大写字母写你的名字。

ex.en: A place can lose its old name when new maps care more about roads than about the people who named it.
ex.zh: 当新地图更在意道路而不是命名的人时，一个地方可能失去旧名。

tip: name 作动词是“命名”：name the baby。

senses.en: many times

ex.en: I often review new words on the bus.
ex.zh: 我经常在公交上复习生词。

ex.en: Streets that often flood need a better drain, not only a warning after the rain starts.
ex.zh: 经常积水的街道需要更好的排水，而不只是雨开始后的警报。

tip: often 放在实义动词前、be 动词后。

senses.en: a purpose or goal
to intend or try to achieve something
to point something towards a particular target

ex.en: Our aim is to finish on time.
ex.zh: 我们的目标是按时完成。

ex.en: The programme aims to reduce youth unemployment by providing practical training and opportunities to gain workplace experience.
ex.zh: 该项目旨在通过提供实践培训和获取职场经验的机会，降低青年失业率。

col: aim to do something｜力求做某事
with the aim of｜以……为目的
aim at a target｜瞄准目标
tip: aim to do表打算做；aim at doing表力求实现。

senses.en: the people who work for an organisation

ex.en: The staff meeting is at four.
ex.zh: 职员会议在四点。

ex.en: Hospital staff on the night shift need a bus after the regular service has stopped.
ex.zh: 夜班的医院职工需要一趟在常规班次停运之后的公交。

tip: staff 是集体名词，谓语常用复数。

senses.en: a very young child

ex.en: The baby slept through the whole meeting.
ex.zh: 婴儿在整个会议期间都睡着。

ex.en: A baby clinic once a month is not enough for a village that is two hours from the hospital.
ex.zh: 对离医院两小时的村子来说，每月一次的婴儿诊所是不够的。

tip: baby 的复数是 babies。

senses.en: the clear liquid we drink
to pour water on plants

ex.en: Please bring your own water to the sports meet.
ex.zh: 运动会请自带水。

ex.en: When a city wastes water in dry months, farms downstream have less for the next planting season.
ex.zh: 城市在干旱月份浪费水，下游农场下一季可种的水就更少。

tip: water 通常不可数，不说 a water。

senses.en: one of two equal parts
equal to one of two parts

ex.en: Half of the class walks to school.
ex.zh: 班上一半的人步行上学。

ex.en: Cutting a journey by half still leaves some students on the bus for more than an hour.
ex.zh: 把路程缩短一半，仍有一些学生要在公交上坐一个多小时。

tip: half of 加复数名词时谓语常用复数；half an hour 中间有 an。

senses.en: buying and selling, or a kind of work
to buy and sell

ex.en: The town lives by trade with the city.
ex.zh: 这个城镇靠与城市的贸易过活。

ex.en: Fair trade in food means the farmer, not only the shop, receives a living wage.
ex.zh: 公平的食品贸易意味着农民而不只是商店获得足以生活的工资。

tip: trade 作动词是“交易”。

senses.en: the salt water covering much of the earth

ex.en: We could smell the sea from the hill.
ex.zh: 我们在山上能闻到海的气味。

ex.en: Plastic that reaches the sea started as packaging someone dropped in a town.
ex.zh: 进入大海的塑料，起初是有人在城镇里丢掉的包装。

tip: by sea 表示经海路，不加 the。go to the sea 常指去海边。

senses.en: having many parts
A group of buildings used for related activities.

ex.en: The problem is more complex than it looks.
ex.zh: 问题比看上去更复杂。

ex.en: Urban poverty is a complex issue that requires cooperation between governments, businesses and local communities.
ex.zh: 城市贫困是一个复杂问题，需要政府、企业和当地社区共同合作。

tip: 作形容词指复杂；作名词可指综合建筑群。

senses.en: in the space or time separating two things

ex.en: The lab is between the library and the hall.
ex.zh: 实验室在图书馆和大厅之间。

ex.en: The difference between knowing a word and using it shows up when students write under time pressure.
ex.zh: 认识一个词和会用一个词的差别，会在学生限时写作时显现出来。

tip: between 多用于两者；among 用于三者或更多。

senses.en: at or to a great distance
distant

ex.en: The station is not far from our school.
ex.zh: 车站离我们学校不远。

ex.en: Families who live far from a hospital wait longer when a child is suddenly ill.
ex.zh: 住得离医院远的家庭，孩子突然生病时要等更久。

tip: far 的比较级是 farther 或 further；further 还可表示“进一步的”。

senses.en: a well-known statement, or something said

ex.en: There is an old saying about practice.
ex.zh: 有一句关于练习的老话。

ex.en: A saying about saving water means little unless the school itself fixes a leaking tap.
ex.zh: 如果学校自己不修漏水的水龙头，一句关于节水的谚语就没什么意义。

tip: saying 也可是 say 的 -ing 形式。作名词“谚语”是可数的。

senses.en: the main idea, a dot, or a score
to show direction with a finger

ex.en: The point of the story is to check your sources.
ex.zh: 这个故事的要点是要核对来源。

ex.en: There is little point in collecting data if nobody is responsible for acting on it.
ex.zh: 如果没有人负责根据数据采取行动，收集数据就没什么意义。

tip: point 作动词是“指”：point at / point to。There is no point in doing 表示做某事没有意义。

senses.en: a business, or the state of being with someone

ex.en: Her mother works for a bus company.
ex.zh: 她母亲在一家公交公司工作。

ex.en: A company that moves its factory should also say what will happen to the workers who stay behind.
ex.zh: 搬迁工厂的公司，也应该说明留下来的工人会怎样。

tip: company 表示陪伴时不可数：for company。表示公司时可数。

senses.en: to appear to be

ex.en: The question seems easy at first.
ex.zh: 这道题起初似乎很容易。

ex.en: A street can seem safe in daylight and still be dark for the walk home at night.
ex.zh: 一条街在白天可以看起来安全，夜里回家时仍然很黑。

tip: seem 后接形容词、to do 或 that 从句。

senses.en: words that make something clear
a reason given for why something happened

ex.en: Her explanation helped us understand.
ex.zh: 她的解释帮助我们理解。

ex.en: One possible explanation for declining car ownership is the growing availability of reliable public transport.
ex.zh: 汽车拥有率下降的一个可能原因，是可靠的公共交通越来越普及。

tip: explanation of多说明内容，for多解释原因。

senses.en: whole

ex.en: The entire class passed the test.
ex.zh: 整个班级都通过了考试。

meta.pipelineNote: IPA/topic pending; not in Word Atlas overlap

senses.en: to become different, or to replace
a difference, or coins returned

ex.en: We changed the time of the meeting.
ex.zh: 我们改了开会时间。

ex.en: Cities that change bus routes without warning leave workers late and children waiting in the dark.
ex.zh: 不预先通知就更改公交线路的城市，会让工人迟到，让孩子在黑暗中等候。

tip: change 可作及物或不及物动词。

senses.en: to try to win against others
Take part in a sporting event or other contest.

ex.en: Many teams compete for the prize.
ex.zh: 许多队伍竞争这个奖项。

ex.en: Small businesses often struggle to compete with larger companies that can offer lower prices.
ex.zh: 小企业往往难以与能够提供更低价格的大公司竞争。

col: compete in a tournament｜参加锦标赛
tip: compete with/against对手；for奖项；in赛事。

senses.en: prepared

ex.en: Are you ready for the listening test?
ex.zh: 听力测试你准备好了吗？

ex.en: A town is not ready for a flood if the only high road is already full of parked cars.
ex.zh: 如果唯一的高路已经停满车，一个城镇就还没有为洪水做好准备。

col: be ready to do｜准备好做
tip: be ready for 后接名词；be ready to do 后接动词。

senses.en: not needing others' control
not controlled by another person, organisation, or country
not connected with or affected by something else

ex.en: She became more independent at college.
ex.zh: 她上大学后更独立了。

ex.en: Independent research can help governments assess whether new environmental policies are achieving their intended goals.
ex.zh: 独立研究可以帮助政府评估新的环境政策是否正在实现预期目标。

tip: 常搭配of：independent of意为不依赖或不受影响。

senses.en: on

ex.en: The decision depends upon the bus timetable.
ex.zh: 这个决定取决于公交时刻表。

ex.en: Once upon a time is a story opening, but real towns still depend upon roads and water.
ex.zh: Once upon a time 是故事的开头，但真实的城镇仍然依靠道路和水。

tip: upon 比 on 更正式，意思常常相同。

senses.en: a thought or plan

ex.en: That is a good idea for the poster.
ex.zh: 对海报来说那是个好主意。

ex.en: An idea for a new park fails if nobody asks who will water the trees after the opening day.
ex.zh: 如果没人问开放日之后谁来给树浇水，建新公园的想法就会失败。

tip: idea 是可数名词：an idea。

senses.en: one side of a sheet in a book

ex.en: The answer is on page twelve.
ex.zh: 答案在第十二页。

ex.en: A torn page in a shared textbook matters when the school cannot buy a new copy.
ex.zh: 当学校买不起新书时，共用课本上撕掉的一页就很要紧。

tip: page 前用 on：on page 5。

senses.en: to do something, or to perform
something done, or a law

ex.en: We must act before the river rises again.
ex.zh: 我们必须在河水再次上涨前行动。

ex.en: Schools that act on student suggestions show that those suggestions were not only a form to fill.
ex.zh: 根据学生建议采取行动的学校，表明那些建议不只是一张要填的表。

tip: act 强调行动；action 是名词。

senses.en: one of the four parts of the year, or a sports period

ex.en: Autumn is my favourite season.
ex.zh: 秋天是我最喜欢的季节。

ex.en: A long dry season can empty village wells before the next rain arrives.
ex.zh: 漫长的旱季会在下一场雨到来前抽干村里的水井。

tip: 季节前常用 in：in summer。

senses.en: towards a lower place

ex.en: Please sit down and open your books.
ex.zh: 请坐下，把书打开。

ex.en: When a factory closes down, the town has to find new work for the people who stayed.
ex.zh: 当一家工厂倒闭时，城镇必须为留下来的人找到新的工作。

tip: down 可作副词或介词：walk down the street。

senses.en: to give an answer without being sure
an answer given without proof

ex.en: Can you guess the last word?
ex.zh: 你能猜出最后一个词吗？

ex.en: Planners should not guess where floods reach when residents can show them the marks on the wall.
ex.zh: 当居民能指出墙上的水痕时，规划者不该猜测洪水淹到哪里。

tip: guess 后可直接接从句。

senses.en: having the power or skill to do something

ex.en: She is able to explain the diagram clearly.
ex.zh: 她能把这张图讲清楚。

ex.en: Students are more able to concentrate when the classroom is quiet and the air is fresh.
ex.zh: 当教室安静、空气新鲜时，学生更能集中注意力。

tip: can 多指一般能力；be able to 可用于各种时态，并强调做成。

senses.en: the center of attention
the main subject receiving attention or effort
image sharpness, or the point where light rays meet

ex.en: Keep your focus on the task.
ex.zh: 把注意力集中在任务上。

ex.en: Governments should focus on affordable public transport to reduce congestion and improve access to employment.
ex.zh: 政府应重点发展价格合理的公共交通，以缓解拥堵并改善就业机会的可达性。

tip: focus on后接名词或动名词；不要说focus in。

senses.en: of the colour of blood
the colour red

ex.en: The red bag on the chair is mine.
ex.zh: 椅子上的红包是我的。

ex.en: Red warnings on a river app help only if people who live nearby can actually receive them.
ex.zh: 河流应用上的红色警报只有在附近居民真能收到时才有用。

tip: red 也可作名词表示红色。

senses.en: to carry something towards the speaker

ex.en: Please bring your student card tomorrow.
ex.zh: 请明天带学生证。

ex.en: New jobs bring people to a town only if there is also a place for them to live.
ex.zh: 只有同时有地方住，新工作才会把人带到一个城镇。

tip: bring 是带来（朝说话人）；take 是带走。过去式是 brought。

senses.en: of several different kinds

ex.en: The library has various maps of the town.
ex.zh: 图书馆有各种各样的城镇地图。

ex.en: Various reasons, from rent to bus times, push young workers out of a small town.
ex.zh: 从房租到公交时间，各种各样的原因把年轻工人推出小镇。

tip: various 后接复数名词。

senses.en: why something happens

ex.en: The reason for the delay was the rain.
ex.zh: 延误的原因是下雨。

ex.en: The reason a street floods is often an old drain, not only a heavy cloud.
ex.zh: 街道积水的原因常常是旧排水管，而不只是厚云。

tip: the reason 后用 why 或 that，不要再用 because 重复原因。

senses.en: happening often
Visit a particular place regularly

ex.en: frequent rain delayed the flight.
ex.zh: 频繁的降雨延误了航班。

ex.en: Frequent changes in education policy can make it difficult for teachers to plan effective lessons.
ex.zh: 教育政策频繁变化，可能使教师难以规划有效的课堂教学。

tip: 形容词重音在首音节；动词重音在第二音节。

senses.en: the last part of something
to finish

ex.en: Please write your name at the end of the page.
ex.zh: 请把名字写在页尾。

ex.en: The end of a holiday is a good time to ask which local shops actually benefited from the visitors.
ex.zh: 假期结束时，适合问问哪些本地店铺真正从游客那里获益。

tip: in the end 表示最终；at the end of 后面要接具体的时间或事物。

senses.en: to want something that may not be real
a desire

ex.en: I wish you a good journey.
ex.zh: 祝你旅途愉快。

ex.en: Residents wish the clinic were closer, but wishes do not move a building.
ex.zh: 居民希望诊所更近，但愿望搬不走一座楼。

tip: wish 后接虚拟语气，表示与事实相反；hope 后接真实的希望。

senses.en: to begin to be

ex.en: The room will become quiet when the talk starts.
ex.zh: 讲座开始时房间会安静下来。

ex.en: A neighbourhood can become unsafe for walking if shops close and the street lights fail.
ex.zh: 如果商店关门、路灯不亮，一个社区会变得不适合步行。

tip: become 后接形容词或名词，不加 to be。过去分词仍是 become。

senses.en: the earth, or a particular area of activity

ex.en: Students from three countries joined the world map project.
ex.zh: 来自三个国家的学生参加了世界地图项目。

ex.en: The online world gives teenagers a voice, but it also spreads rumours faster than a classroom can correct them.
ex.zh: 网络世界给了青少年发言的机会，但谣言传播的速度也快过课堂能够纠正的速度。

tip: in the world 常与最高级连用，加强语气。

senses.en: to gain knowledge or skill

ex.en: We learn new words by using them.
ex.zh: 我们通过使用来学会生词。

ex.en: Children learn road safety by walking with an adult, not only by reading a poster.
ex.zh: 孩子通过和成年人一起走路来学习交通安全，而不只是读海报。

tip: learn 强调学会；study 强调学习的过程。

senses.en: the direction opposite north
in or towards the south

ex.en: The library is to the south of the stadium.
ex.zh: 图书馆在体育馆南边。

ex.en: Towns in the south may face longer summers, which changes when schools can hold sports outdoors.
ex.zh: 南方的城镇可能面临更长的夏天，这会改变学校何时能在户外运动。

tip: in the south of 表示在某范围的南部；to the south of 表示在某地以南。

senses.en: fairly, or preferably

ex.en: The question is rather difficult.
ex.zh: 这道题相当难。

ex.en: Many students would rather walk than take a bus that arrives after the gate has closed.
ex.zh: 许多学生宁愿走路，也不愿坐一辆校门关上后才到的公交。

tip: would rather do than do 表示宁愿……而不愿。rather than 后常接不带 to 的动词。

senses.en: knowing about something

ex.en: Be aware of the risks.
ex.zh: 要意识到风险。

meta.pipelineNote: IPA/topic pending; not in Word Atlas overlap

senses.en: to join together
A farm machine that harvests grain and separates the seeds.

ex.en: Good teachers combine hard work with creativity.
ex.zh: 好老师把努力与创造力结合起来。

ex.en: Cities can combine improved public transport with safer cycling routes to reduce dependence on private cars.
ex.zh: 城市可以将公共交通改善与更安全的骑行路线建设相结合，减少对私家车的依赖。

col: combine A with B｜把A与B结合
combine theory and practice｜理论与实践相结合
tip: 动词重音在后；收割机名词读/ˈkɒmbaɪn/。

senses.en: an adult male, or humans in general

ex.en: A man from the bookshop helped us find the map.
ex.zh: 书店里的一位男士帮我们找到了那张地图。

ex.en: For most of history, man changed the land slowly; the last century has been different.
ex.zh: 在历史上的大部分时间里，人类改变土地的速度很慢；上一个世纪则不同。

tip: man 泛指人类时较少用于新的正式写作，更常见的是 humans 或 people。

senses.en: the reflexive form of it

ex.en: The door closed by itself.
ex.zh: 门自己关上了。

ex.en: A warning system that fails itself is worse than no system, because people trust it.
ex.zh: 自己失灵的警报系统比没有系统更糟，因为人们信任它。

tip: itself 指事物或动物，不指人。

senses.en: before the usual time
before the expected time

ex.en: I caught the early bus.
ex.zh: 我赶上了早班车。

ex.en: Early support in reading costs less than trying to repair years of failure later.
ex.zh: 早期的阅读帮助，比日后修补多年的失败更省。

tip: early 既可作形容词也可作副词：arrive early。

senses.en: a computer set of instructions, a show, or a plan

ex.en: The program helps students check new words.
ex.zh: 这个程序帮助学生检查生词。

ex.en: A training program for village teachers fails if it requires them to leave their classes for a month.
ex.zh: 如果乡村教师培训计划要求他们离开课堂一个月，这个计划就会失败。

tip: 英式拼写 programme 常指节目或计划；计算机程序英美都常用 program。

senses.en: for each

ex.en: The room costs twenty yuan per hour.
ex.zh: 这间房间每小时二十元。

ex.en: Cities that measure water use per person can see which habits waste the most.
ex.zh: 按每人用水量统计的城市，能看出哪些习惯最浪费。

tip: per 多用于书面；口语里常用 a 或 every，如 twenty yuan an hour。

senses.en: more than usual, or in particular

ex.en: The library is busy, especially before exams.
ex.zh: 图书馆很忙，尤其是考试前。

ex.en: Night buses matter especially for workers who finish after the regular service has stopped.
ex.zh: 夜班公交对那些在常规班次停运后才下班的工人尤其重要。

tip: especially 强调“尤其”；specially 强调“专门地”。

senses.en: the condition of the body or mind

ex.en: Sleep is part of health, not a reward after study.
ex.zh: 睡眠是健康的一部分，不是学完之后的奖赏。

ex.en: Poor air quality is a public health problem, not only a matter of personal choice.
ex.zh: 糟糕的空气质量是公共健康问题，不只是个人选择。

tip: health 不可数。healthy 是形容词。

senses.en: facts about something

ex.en: The website gives information about bus times.
ex.zh: 网站提供公交时刻的信息。

ex.en: Personal information collected by a school app should not be sold to other companies.
ex.zh: 学校应用收集的个人信息，不该卖给其他公司。

col: a piece of information｜一条信息
tip: information 不可数，不说 an information。

senses.en: extremely good

ex.en: We had a super time at the fair.
ex.zh: 我们在义卖上玩得非常开心。

ex.en: A super stadium does not help a town whose school roof still leaks.
ex.zh: 一座超级体育场帮不了校舍屋顶仍在漏雨的城镇。

tip: super 多用于口语。supermarket 是“超市”。

senses.en: to take in; to hold one's attention

ex.en: Plants absorb water through their roots.
ex.zh: 植物通过根部吸收水分。

meta.pipelineNote: IPA/topic pending; not in Word Atlas overlap

senses.en: a social gathering, or a political group

ex.en: Our class will have a party on Friday evening.
ex.zh: 我们班周五晚上有聚会。

ex.en: A political party that never meets voters outside election season soon loses their trust.
ex.zh: 只在选举季见选民的政党，很快会失去他们的信任。

tip: party 表示聚会或党派，看语境区分。

senses.en: how someone looks; the act of showing up
an occasion when someone or something becomes visible or present

ex.en: First appearance can be misleading.
ex.zh: 第一印象可能具有误导性。

ex.en: Employers should assess candidates on their skills and experience rather than judging them by their appearance.
ex.zh: 雇主应根据应聘者的技能和经验进行评估，而不是以貌取人。

col: improve the appearance of｜改善……的外观
tip: 外貌与露面都可用appearance；露面常用make an appearance。

senses.en: the centre
in the centre

ex.en: Stand in the middle of the line.
ex.zh: 站在队伍中间。

ex.en: Shops in the middle of a town keep daily life there when a mall opens on the edge.
ex.zh: 当商场开在城边时，镇中心的商店仍维持着那里的日常生活。

tip: middle 作形容词是“中间的”：middle school。

senses.en: fairly cold, or calm

ex.en: The room is cool in the morning.
ex.zh: 房间早晨很凉快。

ex.en: Cool shade from old trees can matter as much as an air conditioner a school cannot afford.
ex.zh: 老树的凉荫，可以和学校买不起的空调一样重要。

tip: cool 比 cold 程度轻。口语里也可表示“酷”。

senses.en: not difficult

ex.en: The first question is easy.
ex.zh: 第一题很容易。

ex.en: It is easy to blame students for being late when the bus itself never arrives on time.
ex.zh: 当公交本身从不准时，责备学生迟到是容易的。

tip: It is easy for sb to do。

senses.en: an object, fact, or action

ex.en: The first thing I do is open the windows.
ex.zh: 我做的第一件事是开窗。

ex.en: The hardest thing about changing a habit is not the first day but the quiet week that follows.
ex.zh: 改变一个习惯最难的不是第一天，而是之后安静的那一周。

tip: thing 很宽泛；写作里能用更具体的名词时尽量换掉。

senses.en: the main support or reason
The arrangement or frequency according to which something happens.

ex.en: Trust is the basis of friendship.
ex.zh: 信任是友谊的基础。

ex.en: Reliable evidence should provide the basis for government decisions about public health and environmental protection.
ex.zh: 可靠的证据应成为政府作出公共卫生和环境保护决策的依据。

col: form the basis of｜构成……的基础
tip: 复数为bases；on a daily basis意为每天。

senses.en: to spend time learning
the activity of studying

ex.en: I study English for twenty minutes a day.
ex.zh: 我每天学二十分钟英语。

ex.en: Students study better in a room that is quiet than in one filled with traffic noise.
ex.zh: 学生在安静的房间里比在充满交通噪音的房间里学得更好。

tip: study 强调系统学习；learn 强调学会。

senses.en: the money or effort needed
to have a price

ex.en: The cost of the trip is fifty yuan.
ex.zh: 这次出行的费用是五十元。

ex.en: The cost of dirty air does not appear on a shop receipt, but it appears in hospital visits.
ex.zh: 脏空气的代价不会出现在购物小票上，但会出现在医院就诊里。

col: at the cost of｜以……为代价
tip: cost 作动词的过去式仍是 cost。sth costs sb money。

senses.en: any thing at all

ex.en: Is there anything I can do to help?
ex.zh: 有什么我能帮忙的吗？

ex.en: If a report hides anything important, the public cannot judge whether a project deserves support.
ex.zh: 如果一份报告隐瞒了重要内容，公众就无法判断一个项目是否值得支持。

tip: anything 常用于疑问句和否定句；肯定句中的“某事”用 something。

senses.en: how big something is

ex.en: What size are these shoes?
ex.zh: 这双鞋是多大尺码？

ex.en: The size of a class changes what one teacher can notice during a lesson.
ex.zh: 班级的大小会改变一位老师在课上能注意到什么。

tip: size 前常用 what 提问尺码。

senses.en: of whom or of which

ex.en: Whose bag is this?
ex.zh: 这是谁的包？

ex.en: A town whose only clinic closes will send every night emergency onto a dark road.
ex.zh: 唯一诊所关闭的城镇，会把每个夜间急诊都送到一条黑暗的路上。

tip: whose 可指人也可指物，用来表示所属。

senses.en: not large

ex.en: We need a small room for the group discussion.
ex.zh: 小组讨论我们需要一间小房间。

ex.en: A small change in bus times can decide whether a student arrives before the first lesson.
ex.zh: 公交时间的一个小改动，就能决定学生是否赶得上第一节课。

tip: small 强调尺寸不大；little 常带感情色彩。

senses.en: a subject or situation
to be important

ex.en: This is a serious matter.
ex.zh: 这是一件严肃的事。

ex.en: Housing is not a private matter when high rents push workers far from the jobs a city needs.
ex.zh: 当高房租把工人推离城市需要的工作时，住房就不是私事。

col: as a matter of fact｜事实上
tip: matter 作动词是“要紧”：It matters。no matter 后接 who、what、how。

senses.en: to guide, or to cause a result
a leading position, or a soft metal

ex.en: The monitor will lead us to the hall.
ex.zh: 班长会带我们去大厅。

ex.en: Poor bus links can lead families to buy cars they can hardly afford.
ex.zh: 糟糕的公交连接会促使家庭去买他们几乎负担不起的汽车。

tip: lead 的过去式和过去分词是 led，不是 leaded。作名词“铅”或“领先”时读音不同。

senses.en: as much or as many as needed

ex.en: There is enough paper for everyone.
ex.zh: 纸够每个人用。

ex.en: It is not enough to build a cycle lane if it ends at the busiest crossing without a light.
ex.zh: 如果自行车道在最繁忙的路口没有信号灯就中断，仅仅修建它是不够的。

tip: enough 放在形容词和副词后面：old enough；放在名词前面：enough time。

senses.en: a group of students, a lesson, or a social group

ex.en: Our class meets in Room 12.
ex.zh: 我们班在 12 室上课。

ex.en: A class of forty is hard to teach well if one teacher has no assistant.
ex.zh: 如果一位老师没有助手，四十人的班很难教好。

tip: class 表示课堂时 in class 不加 the。

senses.en: a part in a play, or a function

ex.en: She played the role of the teacher in the play.
ex.zh: 她在剧里扮演老师。

ex.en: Buses play a role in school life that a wider road cannot replace.
ex.zh: 公交在学校生活中的作用，是更宽的马路替代不了的。

col: play a role in｜在……中起作用
tip: play a role in 后接名词或 doing。

senses.en: not many

ex.en: Few students finished the last question.
ex.zh: 很少有学生做完最后一题。

ex.en: A few trees on a hot street help, but they cannot replace a park.
ex.zh: 炎热街道上的几棵树有帮助，但替代不了一座公园。

tip: few 偏否定，几乎没有；a few 表示有一些。都用于可数名词。

senses.en: a nation, or land outside towns

ex.en: Students from five countries joined the online class.
ex.zh: 来自五个国家的学生参加了网课。

ex.en: People leave the country for the city when schools and clinics there are too far apart.
ex.zh: 当乡村的学校和诊所彼此离得太远时，人们会离开乡村去城市。

tip: country 表示国家时可数；the country 常指乡村。

senses.en: to know the meaning of something

ex.en: I understand the question now.
ex.zh: 我现在明白这道题了。

ex.en: Planners understand a neighbourhood better when they walk it at the hour children leave school.
ex.zh: 规划者如果在孩子放学的时刻走过一个社区，会理解得更好。

tip: understand 的过去式仍是 understand，不是 understanded。

senses.en: a title used before a man's surname

ex.en: Mr. Li starts the lesson at eight.
ex.zh: 李老师八点开始上课。

ex.en: A letter that begins with the wrong title, such as Mr. for a woman, can undo an otherwise polite request.
ex.zh: 一封信如果称谓用错，比如对女性用 Mr.，再礼貌的请求也会被削弱。

tip: Mr. 后接姓，不接名。书写时通常作 Mr.。

senses.en: safety, or the people who guard a place

ex.en: The school improved security at the gate.
ex.zh: 学校加强了校门的安保。

ex.en: Food security means a town can still eat when one road is closed by a flood.
ex.zh: 粮食安全意味着一条路被洪水封闭时，城镇仍然吃得上饭。

tip: security 通常不可数。

senses.en: shared customs and arts
activities involving art, music, literature and other creative work
cells or microorganisms grown under controlled conditions

ex.en: Food is part of local culture.
ex.zh: 食物是当地文化的一部分。

ex.en: Preserving local culture can strengthen community identity while allowing residents to benefit from international exchange.
ex.zh: 保护本土文化可以增强社区认同，同时让居民受益于国际交流。

tip: 泛指文化通常不可数；不同文化可用cultures。

senses.en: an opinion, or what can be seen
to look at, or to consider

ex.en: What is your view on the new timetable?
ex.zh: 你对新课表有什么看法？

ex.en: A fine view of the river does not show whether the water is safe to drink.
ex.zh: 好看的河景并不能说明水是否可以安全饮用。

tip: view 作动词是“观看”或“视为”。

senses.en: to stop living

ex.en: The flowers die if nobody waters them.
ex.zh: 如果没人浇水，花就会死。

ex.en: Fish die in a river long before the colour of the water warns the town.
ex.zh: 鱼会在水色警告城镇之前很久就死在河里。

tip: die 是不及物动词，不能说 die sb。过去式是 died。

senses.en: a photograph, a kick or throw at a goal, or an injection

ex.en: She took a shot of the old bridge.
ex.zh: 她给那座旧桥拍了一张照片。

ex.en: A last-minute shot can win a match, but a team still needs a plan for the whole game.
ex.zh: 最后一秒的投篮可以赢得比赛，但球队仍需要整场比赛的计划。

tip: shot 也是 shoot 的过去式和过去分词。

senses.en: acceptable

ex.en: Is it okay if I borrow your ruler?
ex.zh: 我借你的尺子可以吗？

ex.en: An okay-looking timetable still fails students if the last bus leaves before school ends.
ex.zh: 看起来没问题的时刻表，如果末班车在放学前离开，仍然会让学生失望。

tip: okay 与 O.K. 同义，正式写作可用 all right。

senses.en: younger or lower in rank
Intended for younger people or involving them
A younger person, or a student below the final year

ex.en: He is a junior member of the team.
ex.zh: 他是队里的初级成员。

ex.en: Companies should provide junior employees with structured training and regular opportunities to learn from experienced colleagues.
ex.zh: 公司应为初级员工提供系统培训，并定期安排他们向经验丰富的同事学习。

tip: 职位或年龄比较用junior to，不用junior than。

senses.en: with each other

ex.en: We cleaned the classroom together.
ex.zh: 我们一起打扫了教室。

ex.en: Neighbours who cook together waste less food than families who each buy too much.
ex.zh: 一起做饭的邻居，比各自买得太多的家庭浪费的食物更少。

tip: together 是副词，不单独作动词。

senses.en: the process of making things, or the amount made

ex.en: Food production fell after the dry month.
ex.zh: 干旱的一个月之后，食品产量下降了。

ex.en: Higher production of plastic does not help if the town has nowhere to put the waste.
ex.zh: 如果城镇没有地方放置废物，更高的塑料产量也没有帮助。

tip: production 通常不可数。

senses.en: a place, a job, or an opinion

ex.en: Write your position in the team on the form.
ex.zh: 在表格上写你在队里的位置。

ex.en: A city's position on housing decides who can live near work and who must travel for hours.
ex.zh: 一座城市在住房上的立场，决定谁能住在工作附近，谁必须赶几小时的路。

tip: in a position to do 表示有条件做某事。

senses.en: to make it easier for someone to do something
the act of helping

ex.en: Could you help me move this desk?
ex.zh: 你能帮我搬这张桌子吗？

ex.en: Older students can help younger ones settle in, which also builds leadership in the older group.
ex.zh: 高年级学生可以帮助新生适应，这也能培养他们的领导能力。

col: help sb with｜在某方面帮助
with the help of｜在……帮助下
tip: help sb (to) do 中的 to 可以省略。

senses.en: tall, or great in amount or level

ex.en: The shelf is too high for me to reach.
ex.zh: 架子太高，我够不着。

ex.en: High housing costs near good schools can shut out the families those schools were meant to serve.
ex.zh: 好学校附近的高房价，可能把学校本应服务的家庭挡在外面。

tip: 人的个子用 tall；山、价格、水平用 high。

senses.en: the usual level or mean
A value calculated by dividing a total by the item count.
Have a particular amount as the usual or calculated middle value.

ex.en: His scores are above the average.
ex.zh: 他的分数高于平均水平。

ex.en: Average household spending on energy may fall as better insulation reduces the need for heating.
ex.zh: 随着更好的隔热措施减少供暖需求，家庭能源支出的平均水平可能下降。

tip: on average表示“平均而言”，不用in average。

senses.en: a film

ex.en: We saw a movie about a small town.
ex.zh: 我们看了一部关于小镇的电影。

ex.en: A movie can show a problem, but the town still has to decide what to do on Monday.
ex.zh: 电影可以展示一个问题，但城镇仍要决定星期一做什么。

col: go to the movies｜去看电影
tip: movie 是美式常用词；英式更常说 film。

senses.en: happening often, or shared

ex.en: Colds are common in winter.
ex.zh: 冬天感冒很常见。

ex.en: A common timetable for buses and schools would stop students waiting in the dark.
ex.zh: 公交和学校共用的时刻表，能避免学生在黑暗中等候。

tip: common 强调经常发生或共有；ordinary 强调平凡、不特别。

senses.en: to think that something is true

ex.en: I believe we can finish the project tonight.
ex.zh: 我相信我们今晚能做完这个项目。

ex.en: Students should not believe a chart until they know who collected the numbers and why.
ex.zh: 学生在弄清数字是谁收集的、为什么收集之前，不该轻信一张图表。

col: believe it or not｜信不信由你
tip: believe 后接 that 从句或 sb；believe in 表示信任或信仰。

senses.en: thin material for writing, or a newspaper

ex.en: Write your name on the paper.
ex.zh: 把名字写在纸上。

ex.en: A paper exam in a hot room measures heat as well as knowledge.
ex.zh: 炎热房间里的纸笔考试，测量的不只是知识，还有热。

tip: paper 表示纸张时不可数。a paper 可以是一份报纸或一篇论文。

senses.en: large in size or importance

ex.en: We need a bigger table for the group work.
ex.zh: 小组活动我们需要一张更大的桌子。

ex.en: A big sports event can fill hotels while leaving ordinary residents with higher rents.
ex.zh: 一场大型体育赛事可以住满酒店，同时让普通居民面对更高的房租。

tip: big 多用于口语；large 更中性，great 强调程度或情感。

senses.en: the part of the body at the end of the arm
to pass something to someone

ex.en: Please raise your hand before you speak.
ex.zh: 发言前请举手。

ex.en: A helping hand from an older student can matter more than another printed worksheet.
ex.zh: 高年级学生伸来的一只援手，可能比又一张打印的练习纸更重要。

tip: hand in 是上交。hand 作动词是“递”。

senses.en: to have one's home, or to be alive
happening now, or alive

ex.en: We live near the old market.
ex.zh: 我们住在旧市场附近。

ex.en: People who live beside a busy road pay a health cost that does not appear on the rent receipt.
ex.zh: 住在繁忙道路旁的人承担着健康代价，而这不会出现在房租收据上。

tip: live 作动词读 /lɪv/；作形容词“现场的”读 /laɪv/。

senses.en: a planned piece of work

ex.en: Our project is about the river behind the school.
ex.zh: 我们的课题是关于学校后面的河。

ex.en: A project that never asks local people can solve the wrong problem.
ex.zh: 从不询问当地人的项目，可能会解决一个错误的问题。

tip: project 作名词重音常在前；作动词“投射、预计”时重音常在后。

senses.en: liked by many people

ex.en: The reading club is popular this term.
ex.zh: 读书社团这学期很受欢迎。

ex.en: A popular beach can damage the very coast people come to see.
ex.zh: 受欢迎的海滩可能破坏人们前来观看的那片海岸。

tip: popular 后接 with 表示受某类人欢迎。

senses.en: from one side to the other
from one side to the other

ex.en: There is a bookshop across the street.
ex.zh: 街对面有一家书店。

ex.en: A bridge across the river can cut a student's journey from an hour to ten minutes.
ex.zh: 河上的一座桥可以把学生的路程从一小时缩短到十分钟。

tip: across 强调从表面一边到另一边；through 强调从内部穿过。

senses.en: mail, a job, or a pole
to send by mail, or to put up a notice

ex.en: I will send the form by post.
ex.zh: 我会把表格寄出。

ex.en: A post in a village school is hard to fill if the teacher must travel two hours each way.
ex.zh: 如果老师每天要单程走两小时，乡村学校的岗位就很难有人来。

tip: post 作动词是“邮寄”或“张贴”。美式邮件多用 mail。

senses.en: to think about carefully
to have a particular opinion about someone or something
to take someone or something into account

ex.en: Please consider my advice before deciding.
ex.zh: 做决定前请考虑我的建议。

ex.en: Governments should consider the long-term environmental costs before approving major construction projects in sensitive coastal areas.
ex.zh: 政府在批准生态敏感沿海地区的大型建设项目之前，应考虑其长期环境成本。

col: consider all options｜考虑所有选择
be considered essential｜被认为必不可少
tip: “考虑做”用consider doing，不用consider to do。

senses.en: usual weather of a place
The general attitudes and conditions within a society or organisation.

ex.en: The climate here is warm and wet.
ex.zh: 这里的气候温暖潮湿。

ex.en: A changing climate may force farmers to grow different crops and adopt more efficient irrigation methods.
ex.zh: 气候变化可能迫使农民改种其他作物，并采用更高效的灌溉方法。

tip: climate指长期气候，weather指具体天气。

senses.en: a location, or a position

ex.en: This is a good place to wait for the bus.
ex.zh: 这是等公交的好地方。

ex.en: Every child needs a place to study that is safe, even if that place is a shared table.
ex.zh: 每个孩子都需要一个安全的学习地方，哪怕那只是一张共用的桌子。

tip: take place 表示发生，没有被动语态。

senses.en: a road vehicle with an engine

ex.en: My uncle drives a small car to work.
ex.zh: 我叔叔开一辆小汽车上班。

ex.en: Fewer car trips to school would clear the air on the narrow street outside the gate.
ex.zh: 减少开车上学的次数，能改善校门外窄街上的空气。

tip: by car 不加冠词。

senses.en: a flat piece of wood, or a group that directs an organisation

ex.en: The teacher wrote the date on the board.
ex.zh: 老师把日期写在黑板上。

ex.en: A school board that never visits classrooms may not see why a class of forty is hard to teach.
ex.zh: 从不进教室的校董会，可能看不到四十人的班为什么难教。

tip: board 作动词是“上船、上车”。

senses.en: a plan of action by a government or organisation

ex.en: The new policy limits cars near the school.
ex.zh: 新政策限制学校附近的汽车。

ex.en: A housing policy that ignores bus routes pushes workers farther from their jobs.
ex.zh: 忽视公交线路的住房政策，会把工人推得离工作更远。

tip: policy 是可数名词：a policy。politics 是“政治”。

senses.en: to feel deep affection, or to like very much
a strong feeling of affection

ex.en: I love the smell of the library in the morning.
ex.zh: 我喜欢早晨图书馆的气味。

ex.en: People who love a place are often the first to notice when its river or dialect is disappearing.
ex.zh: 热爱一个地方的人，往往最先注意到它的河流或方言正在消失。

tip: love 后可接 doing 或 to do，口语里 doing 更常见。

senses.en: to let someone see, or to prove
a public performance or display

ex.en: Show me your ticket, please.
ex.zh: 请出示你的票。
