ex.en: The data show that night markets bring noise as well as income to the streets around them.
ex.zh: 数据表明，夜市给周围街道带来收入的同时，也带来噪音。

tip: show sb sth 双宾语；过去分词是 shown。

senses.en: higher than, or more than
in a higher place

ex.en: The clock is above the door.
ex.zh: 钟在门的上方。

ex.en: Temperatures above forty degrees make outdoor sports unsafe for younger students.
ex.zh: 超过四十度的气温会让低龄学生的户外运动不安全。

tip: above 强调位置更高，不一定垂直；over 常有“正上方”或“越过”的意思。

senses.en: to get something by paying money

ex.en: I will buy a notebook after class.
ex.zh: 课后我去买一本笔记本。

ex.en: Families buy less fresh food when the nearest market is an hour away by bus.
ex.zh: 当最近的市场要坐一小时公交时，家庭会少买新鲜食物。

tip: buy 的过去式和过去分词是 bought。

senses.en: not long, or not tall

ex.en: It is a short walk from here to the gate.
ex.zh: 从这里到门口走路不远。

ex.en: Short breaks between lessons help attention more than one long break at the end of the day.
ex.zh: 课间的短休息比一天结束时一次长休息更有助于注意力。

tip: short 可指时间、长度或身材。shortly 是“不久”，不是“短地”。

senses.en: a spoken or written account
to give an account of

ex.en: Please hand in the lab report tomorrow.
ex.zh: 请明天交实验报告。

ex.en: A news report should show what is certain and what is still only a claim.
ex.zh: 新闻报道应该标明哪些是确定的，哪些仍只是说法。

tip: report 作动词是“报告”或“举报”：report sth to sb。

senses.en: to put over, include, or report
the outside of a book, or a lid

ex.en: The map covers the whole town.
ex.zh: 这张地图覆盖整个城镇。

ex.en: News that covers only the city centre misses the villages where the flood starts.
ex.zh: 只报道市中心的新闻，会漏掉洪水开始的那些村子。

tip: cover 作名词是“封面”或“覆盖物”。

senses.en: bravery

ex.en: It takes courage to speak in public.
ex.zh: 公开演讲需要勇气。

ex.en: Young people need courage to challenge unfair practices, especially when their opinions differ from those of others.
ex.zh: 年轻人需要勇气来质疑不公平的做法，尤其是在自己的观点与他人不同时。

col: have the courage to do something｜有勇气做某事
tip: 通常不可数；做某事的勇气用courage to do。

senses.en: to protect from attack
to give reasons supporting someone or something being criticised
to prevent opponents from scoring in a sport

ex.en: Soldiers defend the city from danger.
ex.zh: 士兵们保卫城市免受危险。

ex.en: Governments should defend citizens' rights while ensuring that public safety measures remain fair and proportionate.
ex.zh: 政府应捍卫公民权利，同时确保公共安全措施公平且适度。

col: defend a decision｜为某项决定辩护
tip: defend ... against/from ...表示保护……免受……。

senses.en: people watching or listening
People who read or receive particular content

ex.en: The audience clapped after the show.
ex.zh: 演出结束后观众鼓掌。

ex.en: Online platforms enable museums to reach a wider audience, including people who cannot visit their collections in person.
ex.zh: 网络平台使博物馆能够接触更广泛的受众，包括无法亲自参观馆藏的人。

col: reach a wider audience｜触达更广泛的受众
tip: 观众多用large audience，不用many audiences。

senses.en: every person

ex.en: Everyone in our class has a reading partner.
ex.zh: 我们班每个人都有阅读伙伴。

ex.en: A park that looks open to everyone may still be hard to reach for people who use wheelchairs.
ex.zh: 一座看起来对所有人开放的公园，对使用轮椅的人仍可能很难到达。

tip: everyone 作主语时谓语用单数。

senses.en: not correct

ex.en: I put the wrong date on the form.
ex.zh: 我在表格上写错了日期。

ex.en: It is wrong to judge a school only by one test if many students arrive already behind.
ex.zh: 如果许多学生入学时已经落后，只用一次考试评价学校是不对的。

tip: wrong 作副词较少；做错事常用 do wrong 或副词 wrongly。

senses.en: acceptable

ex.en: Is it O.K. if I leave my bag here?
ex.zh: 我把包放在这里可以吗？

ex.en: A plan that looks O.K. on paper can still fail if the last bus leaves too early.
ex.zh: 纸上看起来没问题的计划，如果末班车太早，仍然会失败。

tip: O.K. 和 okay 都常见。正式写作里可以换成 all right。

senses.en: something difficult that needs to be dealt with

ex.en: The main problem is the noise from the road.
ex.zh: 主要问题是路上的噪音。

ex.en: A traffic problem will not disappear if a city only widens the same road again.
ex.zh: 如果一座城市只是再次拓宽同一条路，交通问题不会消失。

tip: problem 是可数名词。question 是提出的问题；problem 是需要解决的困难。

senses.en: a thick liquid used for fuel or cooking

ex.en: The bus uses less oil after the new route.
ex.zh: 新线路之后这辆公交更省油。

ex.en: Dependence on oil makes a town's bus fares rise whenever the world price jumps.
ex.zh: 对石油的依赖会让城镇的公交票价在世界油价跳跃时上涨。

tip: oil 通常不可数。

senses.en: a metal piece for a lock, or the most important thing
most important

ex.en: I left my key in the classroom.
ex.zh: 我把钥匙落在教室了。

ex.en: The key to a later school start is a bus timetable that changes with it.
ex.zh: 推迟上学时间的关键，是一份随之改变的公交时刻表。

tip: the key to 后接名词或 doing，介词是 to。

senses.en: a violent act, or a sudden illness
to try to hurt or criticise

ex.en: The article is an attack on the new plan, not a description of it.
ex.zh: 这篇文章是对新计划的抨击，不是对它的描述。

ex.en: A heart attack far from a clinic is more dangerous than the same illness near one.
ex.zh: 远离诊所的心脏病发作，比在诊所附近更危险。

tip: attack 作动词直接接宾语，不加 to。

senses.en: to look at and understand written words

ex.en: I read the notice twice to be sure.
ex.zh: 我把通知读了两遍以确认。

ex.en: Children who read with an adult at home often arrive at school ready to enjoy longer books.
ex.zh: 在家有成年人和他们一起阅读的孩子，上学时往往已经准备好享受更长的书。

tip: read 的过去式和过去分词与原形拼写相同，但读作 /red/。

senses.en: very likely

ex.en: She will probably arrive before eight.
ex.zh: 她大概会在八点前到。

ex.en: A town will probably lose young workers if the only jobs are in a city two hours away.
ex.zh: 如果仅有的工作在两小时外的城市，城镇很可能会失去年轻工人。

tip: probably 是副词；形容词是 probable。

senses.en: to work out a number

ex.en: Can you calculate the total cost?
ex.zh: 你能算出总费用吗？

meta.pipelineNote: IPA/topic pending; not in Word Atlas overlap

senses.en: an exam, or a trial
to check something

ex.en: We have a short test on Friday.
ex.zh: 我们周五有一次小测。

ex.en: A listening test taken in a noisy hall does not measure what students can hear in a quiet room.
ex.zh: 在嘈杂大厅里进行的听力测试，测不出学生在安静房间里能听见什么。

tip: test 作动词是“测试”。

senses.en: a condition, or a country or region
to say or write something clearly

ex.en: The classroom was in a tidy state after the meeting.
ex.zh: 会后教室很整洁。

ex.en: A state that invests in rural schools narrows the gap between villages and big cities.
ex.zh: 投资乡村学校的国家，会缩小乡村与大城市之间的差距。

col: in a state of｜处于……状态
tip: the United States 中的 state 是州；泛指国家时也可作 state。

senses.en: one more time

ex.en: Please read the sentence again, more slowly.
ex.zh: 请再读一遍这个句子，慢一点。

ex.en: If the same street floods again, the town should stop calling it bad luck and fix the drains.
ex.zh: 如果同一条街再次积水，城镇就不该再称之为运气不好，而应修排水系统。

tip: again 不与 repeat 叠用；repeat 本身已有“再做一次”的意思。

senses.en: to use or have something with others
a part of something

ex.en: We share one microscope in the lab.
ex.zh: 实验室里我们共用一台显微镜。

ex.en: Neighbours who share tools spend less and throw fewer things away.
ex.zh: 共用工具的邻居花得更少，扔掉的东西也更少。

col: share sth with sb｜与某人分享
tip: share 可作及物动词，后面直接接宾语。

senses.en: related to medicine or treatment

ex.en: She hopes to do medical work in a village.
ex.zh: 她希望在乡村做医疗工作。

ex.en: Medical care that exists only in the city leaves village families travelling for hours.
ex.zh: 只存在于城市的医疗，会让乡村家庭赶几小时的路。

tip: medical 是形容词；medicine 是名词“药”或“医学”。

senses.en: a sudden serious event causing harm
Something that goes extremely badly or fails completely.

ex.en: An earthquake is a natural disaster.
ex.zh: 地震是一种自然灾害。

ex.en: Effective early warning systems can reduce the damage caused by natural disasters and help communities recover more quickly.
ex.zh: 有效的预警系统可以减少自然灾害造成的损失，并帮助社区更快恢复。

tip: 也可夸张形容失败：The party was a disaster。

senses.en: a period in a process, or a platform for performers

ex.en: We are at the first stage of the project.
ex.zh: 我们处在项目的第一阶段。

ex.en: The stage of a plan that nobody checks is often the one that fails in the rain.
ex.zh: 计划中没人检查的那个阶段，往往是在雨里失败的阶段。

tip: stage 作动词是“上演”。

senses.en: towards the front

ex.en: Please step forward when your name is called.
ex.zh: 叫到你的名字时请向前走。

ex.en: Looking forward without asking residents can put a new road through the only playground.
ex.zh: 不询问居民就向前规划，可能会让新路穿过唯一的操场。

tip: look forward to 后接名词或 doing。

senses.en: a small container for drinks, or a prize

ex.en: There is a cup of tea on the desk.
ex.zh: 桌上有一杯茶。

ex.en: Winning a cup brings a town one happy evening, not a clinic or a bus.
ex.zh: 赢得奖杯给城镇带来一个快乐的晚上，而不是诊所或公交。

tip: a cup of 后接不可数名词。

senses.en: a moving picture, or thin material for cameras
to record moving pictures

ex.en: We watched a short film about the town.
ex.zh: 我们看了一部关于这个城镇的短片。

ex.en: A film about a flood can move people, but it does not repair the broken drain.
ex.zh: 一部关于洪水的电影可以打动人，但修不好破损的排水管。

tip: 英式常用 film，美式常用 movie。

senses.en: a standard, height, or rank

ex.en: Her reading level has improved this term.
ex.zh: 她的阅读水平这学期提高了。

ex.en: Noise levels beside a main road can be high enough to disturb an open classroom window.
ex.zh: 主干道旁的噪音水平可以高到打扰开着窗的教室。

col: at a high level｜在高水平
tip: level 作形容词是“平坦的”。

senses.en: the United States, or the American continents

ex.en: She hopes to visit America after university.
ex.zh: 她希望大学毕业后去美国看看。

ex.en: News from America reaches a classroom in minutes, but students still need to ask who wrote it.
ex.zh: 来自美国的新闻几分钟就能进课堂，但学生仍要问是谁写的。

tip: 国家名 America 前通常不加 the；the United States 要加 the。

senses.en: in addition, or different

ex.en: Would anyone else like to speak?
ex.zh: 还有别人想发言吗？

ex.en: If the bus is full, students have little else to do but wait in the rain.
ex.zh: 如果公交满了，学生几乎只能在雨里等。

tip: else 放在疑问词或不定代词后面：what else、someone else。

senses.en: the highest part or rank
highest in position or degree

ex.en: My name is at the top of the list.
ex.zh: 我的名字在名单最上面。

ex.en: Standing at the top of a test list does not show whether a student can work with other people.
ex.zh: 站在成绩榜顶端，并不能说明一个学生能否与他人合作。

tip: top 作形容词表示“顶级的”：top speed。

senses.en: almost the same

ex.en: The two maps are similar, but not the same.
ex.zh: 两张地图相似，但并不相同。

ex.en: Similar test scores can hide very different chances to study at home.
ex.zh: 相似的考分可能掩盖在家学习机会的巨大差别。

tip: similar to 后接比较对象，不用 with。

senses.en: all of something

ex.en: I spent the whole morning in the lab.
ex.zh: 我整个上午都在实验室。

ex.en: Protecting a whole river means caring for farms and factories, not only the city section.
ex.zh: 保护整条河意味着要管农场和工厂，而不只是城区那一段。

tip: whole 前面通常有 the 或物主代词：the whole day。

senses.en: an idea or the act of thinking
past form of think

ex.en: That is a thoughtful question.
ex.zh: 那是一个有想法的问题。

ex.en: A single thoughtless comment online can follow a student longer than the mistake that caused it.
ex.zh: 网上一句欠考虑的话，可能比引发它的那个错误跟随学生更久。

tip: thought 也是 think 的过去式和过去分词。

senses.en: to respect or look up to someone
To look at something with pleasure because it is attractive

ex.en: I admire her courage in difficult times.
ex.zh: 我钦佩她在困难时期的勇气。

ex.en: People often admire successful athletes for their determination, but consistent training is equally important.
ex.zh: 人们常因成功运动员的毅力而钦佩他们，但坚持训练同样重要。

col: admire someone for something｜因某事钦佩某人
tip: admire sb for sth：因某事钦佩某人。

senses.en: a state or requirement
A requirement, or circumstances affecting life or activity
A medical problem affecting someone's health

ex.en: The road is in poor condition.
ex.zh: 这条路状况很差。

ex.en: Improving working conditions can increase employee satisfaction and reduce the number of people leaving their jobs.
ex.zh: 改善工作条件可以提高员工满意度，并减少离职人数。

tip: 表状态通常不可数；表工作、生活环境常用复数。

senses.en: to move around, or to become
a chance to do something, or a change of direction

ex.en: Turn left at the bookshop.
ex.zh: 在书店处向左转。

ex.en: Parks can turn a hot street into a place where people are willing to walk.
ex.zh: 公园能把一条炎热的街道变成人们愿意步行的地方。

tip: turn 加形容词表示变化：turn green。开灯用 turn on，不是 open the light。

senses.en: allowed by law
Allowed by the law

ex.en: Is this action legal?
ex.zh: 这个行为合法吗？

ex.en: Access to affordable legal services is essential for ensuring that disadvantaged citizens can defend their rights.
ex.zh: 让人们获得负担得起的法律服务，对保障弱势公民维护自身权利至关重要。

tip: legal可指“法律相关的”，不一定指“合法的”。

senses.en: most important

ex.en: The main entrance is on the left.
ex.zh: 正门在左边。

ex.en: The main reason for late arrivals is the bus, not a lack of interest in the first lesson.
ex.zh: 迟到的主要原因是公交，不是对第一节课缺乏兴趣。

tip: main 没有比较级。mainly 是副词“主要地”。

senses.en: more than two but not many

ex.en: Several students stayed to tidy the lab.
ex.zh: 几个学生留下来收拾实验室。

ex.en: Several small parks can serve a neighbourhood better than one large park that is hard to reach.
ex.zh: 几个小公园服务一个社区，可能好过一座很难到达的大公园。

tip: several 后接可数名词复数。

senses.en: up to a particular time
up to the time when

ex.en: The shop is open until nine.
ex.zh: 商店营业到九点。

ex.en: A library that stays open until the last bus can serve students who cannot study at home.
ex.zh: 开到末班车的图书馆，可以服务那些无法在家学习的学生。

tip: until 可作介词或连词。not...until 表示直到……才。

senses.en: every one separately

ex.en: Each student has a different seat number.
ex.zh: 每个学生的座位号都不一样。

ex.en: Each small shop that closes on a high street takes away a place where neighbours used to talk.
ex.zh: 商业街上每关掉一家小店，就少了一个邻居们曾经聊天的地方。

tip: each of 加复数名词时，谓语常用单数。

senses.en: an emotion or a physical sense

ex.en: I had a feeling that the answer was wrong.
ex.zh: 我有一种感觉，这个答案是错的。

ex.en: A feeling of safety on the walk home depends on lights, not only on a low crime number.
ex.zh: 回家路上的安全感取决于灯光，而不只是一个很低的犯罪数字。

tip: feeling 是可数名词。

senses.en: in opposition to, or touching

ex.en: Our team will play against Class Three.
ex.zh: 我们队将和三班比赛。

ex.en: Laws against litter only work when bins are near and people see that the rules apply to everyone.
ex.zh: 禁止乱扔垃圾的法律，只有在附近有垃圾桶、而且人人都受约束时才有效。

tip: against 是介词，后面接名词、代词或 doing。

senses.en: a very short time

ex.en: Wait a moment, please.
ex.zh: 请稍等。

ex.en: The moment a rumour is shared, it is harder to replace it with a correction.
ex.zh: 谣言一经转发，就更难用更正来替换它。

tip: the moment 可引导时间从句，相当于 as soon as。

senses.en: strength, control, or electricity
to supply energy to a machine

ex.en: The storm cut the power for two hours.
ex.zh: 暴风雨导致停电两小时。

ex.en: The power to change a bus route should sit with people who actually ride it, not only with planners.
ex.zh: 更改公交线路的权力，应该掌握在真正乘坐它的人手里，而不只是规划者。

tip: power 表示电力时不可数。作动词是“驱动”或“供电”。

senses.en: a person with special skill
Having or showing great knowledge or skill.

ex.en: Ask an expert for advice.
ex.zh: 向专家征求建议。

ex.en: Schools should seek expert advice before introducing new technology into classrooms to support student learning.
ex.zh: 学校在将新技术引入课堂以辅助学生学习之前，应征求专家意见。

col: an expert on｜某方面的专家
tip: expert on/in表示某领域的专家。

senses.en: one more, or a different one

ex.en: May I ask another question?
ex.zh: 我可以再问一个问题吗？

ex.en: Another heatwave will test whether the city's new shelters are more than a promise on paper.
ex.zh: 又一轮热浪将检验这座城市的新避暑点是否不只是纸上的承诺。

tip: another 后接单数名词；“另外两个”可以说 another two days。

senses.en: a structure with a roof and walls

ex.en: The new building has a lift.
ex.zh: 新楼有电梯。

ex.en: An empty building in the town centre is a wasted chance to house a clinic or a library.
ex.zh: 镇中心的空楼是浪费，本可以用来做诊所或图书馆。

tip: building 是名词；build 是动词，过去式 built。

senses.en: possibly

ex.en: Perhaps we can finish before lunch.
ex.zh: 也许我们能在午饭前做完。

ex.en: Perhaps a later school start would help, but only if the buses change too.
ex.zh: 也许推迟上学时间会有帮助，但只有公交也改才行。

tip: perhaps 比 maybe 稍正式，意思接近。

senses.en: knowledge from careful study and experiment

ex.en: Science class is in the lab today.
ex.zh: 今天的科学课在实验室。

ex.en: Science can measure dirty air, but a city still has to decide what to do about it.
ex.zh: 科学可以测量脏空气，但城市仍要决定对此做什么。

tip: science 作学科通常不可数。

senses.en: to fail to remember

ex.en: Do not forget to write the date.
ex.zh: 别忘了写日期。

ex.en: Towns forget a flood until the same street fills again.
ex.zh: 城镇会忘记洪水，直到同一条街再次积水。

tip: forget to do 是忘了要做；forget doing 是忘了做过。

senses.en: the smallest amount or degree
the smallest in amount

ex.en: This is the least difficult of the three questions.
ex.zh: 这是三道题里最不难的。

ex.en: The least expensive food is not always the one that keeps students awake through the afternoon.
ex.zh: 最便宜的食物不一定能让学生整个下午保持清醒。

tip: at least 表示至少；not in the least 表示一点也不。

senses.en: belonging to a whole country

ex.en: The national museum is free on Wednesdays.
ex.zh: 国家博物馆周三免费。

ex.en: A national exam should not ignore students whose schools lack labs and libraries.
ex.zh: 一场全国性考试不该忽略那些学校缺少实验室和图书馆的学生。

tip: national 是形容词；国家用 nation 或 country。

senses.en: not ordinary

ex.en: Today is a special day for our school.
ex.zh: 今天对我们学校是特别的一天。

ex.en: A special bus for students works only if it arrives before the first lesson, not after.
ex.zh: 学生专车只有在第一节课前到达才有用，而不是课后。

tip: specially 强调专门地；especially 强调尤其。

senses.en: to invite someone to compete or try hard
Question whether something is true, fair, or acceptable.
Invite someone to compete or test their abilities.

ex.en: This puzzle will challenge your mind.
ex.zh: 这道谜题会挑战你的思维。

ex.en: Providing affordable housing remains a major challenge for cities experiencing rapid population growth and rising land prices.
ex.zh: 对于人口快速增长、地价不断上涨的城市而言，提供可负担住房仍是一项重大挑战。

col: meet a challenge｜成功应对挑战
challenge someone to a contest｜向某人发起比赛挑战
tip: challenge作动词可直接接观点，表示质疑。

senses.en: newspapers, television, and the internet as a group

ex.en: Social media spread the news within an hour.
ex.zh: 社交媒体在一小时内传播了这条消息。

ex.en: The media can help a town prepare for a flood, or they can only arrive to film the damage.
ex.zh: 媒体可以帮助一个城镇为洪水做准备，也可以只在事后前来拍摄损失。

tip: media 是 medium 的复数，谓语常用复数。

senses.en: the threads that grow on the head

ex.en: Tie your hair back in the lab.
ex.zh: 在实验室里把头发扎起来。

ex.en: Hair colour tells you nothing about whether a student can solve the problem.
ex.zh: 头发的颜色说明不了一个学生能否解出这道题。

tip: hair 通常不可数。一根头发用 a hair。

senses.en: of the colour of grass
the colour green

ex.en: The green bike is mine.
ex.zh: 那辆绿色自行车是我的。

ex.en: Green space near a school gives children somewhere to play that is not a car park.
ex.zh: 学校附近的绿地给孩子一个玩耍的地方，而不是停车场。

tip: green 也可表示环保的：green energy。

senses.en: to name, phone, or shout to someone
a phone conversation or a shout

ex.en: We call our teacher Mr. Chen.
ex.zh: 我们称呼老师为陈老师。

ex.en: Parents who call the school only after a problem appears miss the chance to help earlier.
ex.zh: 只在问题出现后才给学校打电话的家长，错过了更早帮忙的机会。

col: give sb a call｜给某人打电话
tip: call sb sth 表示把某人称作……，中间不加 as。

senses.en: measuring a great length or time
to want something very much

ex.en: It was a long walk from the station.
ex.zh: 从车站走过来要很久。

ex.en: A long commute can take away the evening hours that students need for sleep and reading.
ex.zh: 漫长的通勤会占去学生需要用于睡觉和阅读的晚上时间。

tip: how long 询问时间或长度。long 作动词是“渴望”。

senses.en: a movement of the foot, or one stage of a process
to move the foot

ex.en: The first step is to read the question.
ex.zh: 第一步是读题。

ex.en: The next step after a flood warning is a lit path to higher ground, not only a message.
ex.zh: 洪水警报之后的下一步是一条有灯的通往高地的路，而不只是一条信息。

tip: step 作动词是“迈步”。

senses.en: an occasion when people come together

ex.en: The meeting starts at two.
ex.zh: 会议两点开始。

ex.en: A public meeting about a new road should happen before the machines arrive.
ex.zh: 关于新路的公开会议应该在机器到来之前举行。

tip: meeting 是可数名词。

senses.en: a place for money, or the side of a river

ex.en: The bank is next to the post office.
ex.zh: 银行在邮局旁边。

ex.en: Houses on the bank of a river are cheap until the water reaches the door.
ex.zh: 河边的房子在水漫到门口之前显得便宜。

tip: bank 的两个常见义是银行和岸，要看搭配。

senses.en: from one side to the other, or by means of

ex.en: We walked through the market on the way home.
ex.zh: 我们回家时穿过了市场。

ex.en: Students learn more through explaining an idea than through reading the same note again.
ex.zh: 学生通过讲解一个想法学到的，往往多于把同一条笔记再读一遍。

tip: through 强调从内部穿过；across 强调从表面一边到另一边。

senses.en: the activity of using one's mind

ex.en: Critical thinking is part of the history course.
ex.zh: 批判性思考是历史课的一部分。

ex.en: Quick thinking on social media is not the same as careful thinking about a source.
ex.zh: 社交媒体上的快速思考，不等于对来源的仔细思考。

tip: thinking 是 think 的 -ing，也可作名词。

senses.en: an idea for what to do
to decide what to do

ex.en: Our plan is to finish the poster today.
ex.zh: 我们的计划是今天完成海报。

ex.en: A flood plan that exists only on paper will fail the first night the river rises.
ex.zh: 只存在于纸上的防汛计划，会在河水上涨的第一个夜里失败。

tip: plan 作动词后接 to do，不接 doing。

senses.en: a problem
A problem that makes progress or success harder.

ex.en: She overcame great difficulty to succeed.
ex.zh: 她克服巨大困难获得成功。

ex.en: Students with limited internet access may have difficulty completing assignments that require extensive online research.
ex.zh: 网络使用受限的学生可能难以完成需要大量网上研究的作业。

col: have difficulty doing something｜做某事有困难
tip: 用have difficulty doing，不用difficulty to do。

senses.en: not in danger

ex.en: Is the bridge safe after the rain?
ex.zh: 雨后这座桥安全吗？

ex.en: A street is not safe for children if cars park on the only pavement.
ex.zh: 如果汽车停在唯一的人行道上，这条街对孩子就不安全。

tip: safe 是形容词；safety 是名词。

senses.en: to give money for something
money received for work

ex.en: I paid for the tickets online.
ex.zh: 我在网上付了票钱。

ex.en: Families who pay a large share of their income for rent have less left for books and clinics.
ex.zh: 把收入的很大一部分用来付房租的家庭，留给书和看病的钱就更少。

tip: pay 的过去式和过去分词是 paid。人作主语：sb pays for sth。

senses.en: having lived long, or not new

ex.en: This is an old map, but the river is the same.
ex.zh: 这是一张旧地图，但那条河还是一样的。

ex.en: Old buildings can teach a city what to keep when everything else is being rebuilt.
ex.zh: 当其他一切都在重建时，老建筑可以告诉一座城市该保留什么。

tip: 表示年龄用数字加 years old。兄姐用 elder 或 older 都可以。

senses.en: a period of seven days

ex.en: We have a test next week.
ex.zh: 我们下周有一次测验。

ex.en: A four-day school week may cut costs, but it can also lengthen each remaining day beyond what children can manage.
ex.zh: 每周上四天课也许能省钱，但也可能把剩下的每天拉长到孩子承受不了。

tip: next week 前不加 the。

senses.en: to have inside
to prevent something from spreading or becoming stronger

ex.en: This box may contain old letters.
ex.zh: 这个盒子里可能装有旧信。

ex.en: Processed foods often contain large amounts of salt, which can contribute to serious health problems.
ex.zh: 加工食品往往含有大量盐分，可能导致严重的健康问题。

tip: 及物动词，直接接宾语；表示“含有”时通常不用进行时。

senses.en: before noon

ex.en: The reading room opens at 7 a.m.
ex.zh: 阅览室早上七点开门。

ex.en: Starting lessons at 7 a.m. may suit adults, but many teenagers are still at their sleepiest then.
ex.zh: 早上七点上课也许适合成年人，但许多青少年那时仍处于最困的时候。

tip: a.m. 表示午夜到中午；书写时数字与 a.m. 之间留空格。

senses.en: the red liquid in the body

ex.en: The nurse stopped the blood with a clean cloth.
ex.zh: 护士用干净的布止住了血。

ex.en: Loss of blood is one reason a village clinic must be close, not an hour away.
ex.zh: 失血是乡村诊所必须在近处、而不是一小时之外的原因之一。

tip: blood 不可数。

senses.en: a series of actions
to treat or deal with something in stages

ex.en: Learning a word is a slow process.
ex.zh: 学会一个词是一个缓慢的过程。

ex.en: The process of cleaning a river includes factories upstream, not only the park in the city.
ex.zh: 清理一条河的过程包括上游的工厂，而不只是城里的公园。

col: in the process of｜在……过程中
tip: process 作动词是“加工、处理”，名词重音常在前，动词重音可在后。

senses.en: parents and children, or relatives

ex.en: My family has dinner together on Sundays.
ex.zh: 我们家周日一起吃晚饭。

ex.en: When housing is too expensive, a family may spend so much on rent that little remains for books or clinics.
ex.zh: 当住房太贵时，一个家庭可能把太多钱花在房租上，书籍和看病就所剩无几。

tip: family 作整体时谓语用单数；强调家庭成员时有时用复数。

senses.en: to take to a place; to give a speech
to give a speech, lecture, or presentation
to produce the results or benefits that were promised

ex.en: The post office will deliver the package.
ex.zh: 邮局会递送这个包裹。

ex.en: Public transport projects must deliver clear benefits to local residents if they are to justify substantial investment.
ex.zh: 公共交通项目必须为当地居民带来明确的益处，才能证明大规模投资是合理的。

col: deliver on a promise｜兑现承诺
tip: 递送用deliver sth to sb；兑现承诺可用deliver on。

senses.en: to dislike very strongly
a strong dislike

ex.en: I hate waiting in the rain.
ex.zh: 我讨厌在雨里等。

ex.en: People hate a rule they do not understand more than a rule that is strict but clear.
ex.zh: 人们对不理解的规则的反感，超过对严格但清楚的规则。

tip: hate 后接 doing 或 to do。

senses.en: to tell someone you are grateful

ex.en: I want to thank you for your help.
ex.zh: 我想谢谢你的帮助。

ex.en: Cities should thank the workers who collect rubbish before dawn, not only the people who design the posters.
ex.zh: 城市应该感谢黎明前收垃圾的工人，而不只是设计海报的人。

tip: thank 是动词，后面接人；名词用 thanks。

senses.en: most important
a leader

ex.en: The chief reason for the delay was the rain.
ex.zh: 延误的主要原因是下雨。

ex.en: The chief cost of a new road may be the playground it replaces, not the stone it uses.
ex.zh: 一条新路的主要代价，可能是它取代的操场，而不是它用的石头。

tip: chief 作名词是“首领”。

senses.en: to drop down
a drop, or autumn in American English

ex.en: Leaves fall from the tree in autumn.
ex.zh: 秋天树叶落下。

ex.en: If wages fall while rents rise, families move farther from the schools they wanted.
ex.zh: 如果工资下降而房租上升，家庭会搬得离他们想去的学校更远。

tip: fall 的过去式是 fell，过去分词是 fallen。秋天是 autumn，美式常用 fall。

senses.en: having a value that makes something sensible

ex.en: The museum is worth a visit.
ex.zh: 这座博物馆值得一看。

ex.en: A long meeting is worth the time if it stops a road being built in the wrong place.
ex.zh: 如果一次长会能避免路修在错误的地方，它就值得花时间。

tip: be worth doing 用主动形式表示被动含义，不说 worth to be done。

senses.en: a rule made by a government, or a scientific rule

ex.en: The new law limits plastic bags in shops.
ex.zh: 新法律限制商店使用塑料袋。

ex.en: A law that nobody can understand is hard to follow, even when its aim is fair.
ex.zh: 一部没人读得懂的法律很难被遵守，即使它的目的是公平的。

tip: law 表示法律时可不可数；一条法律用 a law。

senses.en: a form of something that is slightly different

ex.en: This is the latest version of the form.
ex.zh: 这是表格的最新版本。

ex.en: An online version of a warning helps only people who can open it.
ex.zh: 警报的网络版本只帮助打得开它的人。

tip: version 是可数名词。

senses.en: a list of money owed, or a proposed law

ex.en: The electricity bill was higher this month.
ex.zh: 这个月的电费账单更高。

ex.en: A bill that limits plastic bags needs shops that will actually follow it.
ex.zh: 限制塑料袋的法案需要真正会执行的商店。

tip: 美式英语里 bill 也可指纸币。

senses.en: as good as possible
to make something as good as it can be

ex.en: Nobody expects a perfect first draft.
ex.zh: 没人指望第一稿就完美。

ex.en: A perfect score on one test does not show whether a student can work with other people.
ex.zh: 一次考试的满分并不能说明学生能否与他人合作。

tip: perfect 作动词是“使完善”，重音常在第二音节。

senses.en: to be the best or to get a prize

ex.en: Our team wants to win the basketball match.
ex.zh: 我们队想赢得篮球赛。

ex.en: A city does not win public trust by announcing a plan it never carries out.
ex.zh: 一座城市不会因为宣布一个从不执行的计划就赢得公众信任。

tip: win 的宾语是比赛、奖品或胜利，不是对手。打败某人用 beat sb。

senses.en: to cause death

ex.en: The late frost can kill young plants.
ex.zh: 晚霜会冻死幼苗。

ex.en: Dirty water can kill fish long before people notice a change in the colour.
ex.zh: 脏水可以在人们注意到颜色变化之前很久就杀死鱼。

tip: kill 是及物动词，后面直接接宾语。

senses.en: enjoyment

ex.en: The game was fun, and we also learned the words.
ex.zh: 游戏很有趣，我们还学了单词。

ex.en: Fun at a festival should not depend on so much plastic that the square is buried in waste the next day.
ex.zh: 节日的乐趣不该依赖那么多塑料，以至于第二天广场被垃圾淹没。

tip: fun 是不可数名词，一般不说 a fun。funny 是“滑稽的”，不等于 fun。

senses.en: the fact of losing something

ex.en: The loss of the old tree changed the street.
ex.zh: 那棵老树的失去改变了这条街。

ex.en: The loss of a night bus is also a loss of safe journeys home.
ex.zh: 夜班公交的取消，也是安全回家路程的损失。

tip: loss 是名词；lose 是动词。

senses.en: coins and notes used to buy things

ex.en: I do not have enough money for two tickets.
ex.zh: 我的钱不够买两张票。

ex.en: Money spent on early reading support can reduce the cost of failure later in secondary school.
ex.zh: 花在早期阅读辅导上的钱，可以减少中学阶段失败带来的后续成本。

tip: money 不可数，不说 moneys 或 a money。

senses.en: something successfully done
The successful completion of a goal through effort.

ex.en: Winning the prize was a great achievement.
ex.zh: 获奖是一项巨大成就。

ex.en: Schools should recognise creative achievements alongside examination results to encourage a wider range of student abilities.
ex.zh: 学校应在重视考试成绩的同时认可创造性成果，以鼓励学生发展多方面的能力。

col: the achievement of goals｜目标的实现
tip: 具体成就可数；表示目标的实现时通常不可数。

senses.en: actually existing, or genuine

ex.en: Is this a real diamond or a glass one?
ex.zh: 这是真钻石还是玻璃的？

ex.en: Real progress on air quality is measured in hospital visits, not only in official announcements.
ex.zh: 空气质量的真正进步要用就诊人数来衡量，而不只是官方通报。

tip: real 强调实际存在；true 强调与事实相符。

senses.en: a bank record, or a description of events

ex.en: She opened a bank account for her savings.
ex.zh: 她开了一个银行账户存钱。

ex.en: An honest account of a flood includes the families who lost homes, not only the official numbers.
ex.zh: 对洪水的诚实叙述包括失去家园的家庭，而不只是官方数字。

tip: account for 表示解释原因，或占一定比例。

senses.en: a person who is not named

ex.en: Someone left a notebook on the piano.
ex.zh: 有人把笔记本落在钢琴上了。

ex.en: Someone has to decide which bus routes stay open when a city cannot fund them all.
ex.zh: 当一座城市无法资助所有公交线路时，必须有人决定哪些线路继续开。

tip: someone 后面的形容词要后置：someone important。

senses.en: to receive sound, or to be told

ex.en: I can hear the bell from the playground.
ex.zh: 我在操场上能听见铃声。

ex.en: People hear about a flood on their phones long before they see the water in their own street.
ex.zh: 人们在自己街上看到水之前很久，就从手机上听说了洪水。

tip: hear 是听见的结果；listen 是听的动作。过去式是 heard。

senses.en: used to make a request polite
to make someone happy

ex.en: Please close the window before you leave.
ex.zh: 离开前请把窗户关上。

ex.en: Signs that say please are not enough if the bins are too far from where people finish their food.
ex.zh: 如果垃圾桶离人们吃完东西的地方太远，写着“请”的标牌是不够的。

tip: please 可放在句首或句末。pleased 表示人感到高兴。

senses.en: difficult, solid, or needing effort
with a lot of effort

ex.en: This question is hard, but not impossible.
ex.zh: 这道题难，但不是做不出。

ex.en: Hard plastic that cannot be repaired becomes waste faster than a simple tool made of wood.
ex.zh: 无法修理的硬塑料，会比一件简单的木制工具更快变成垃圾。

tip: hard 可以是“努力地”；hardly 是否定副词“几乎不”，二者完全不同。

senses.en: arrangement, a command, or a request for goods
to command, or to ask for goods

ex.en: Put the books back in the right order.
ex.zh: 把书按正确顺序放回去。

ex.en: An order to close street markets at dusk can cut noise and also cut the income of small sellers.
ex.zh: 黄昏关闭街头市场的命令能减少噪音，也会减少小贩的收入。

tip: in order to do 表示目的；in order that 后接句子。

senses.en: to experience a feeling or opinion

ex.en: I feel nervous before I speak in class.
ex.zh: 我在课堂上发言前感到紧张。

ex.en: Residents feel the effect of a new airport long before the official noise report is published.
ex.zh: 居民在官方噪音报告公布之前很久，就能感到新机场的影响。

tip: feel 作连系动词，后面接形容词：feel tired，不接 tiredly。

senses.en: to push something firmly
a push, or newspapers and journalists

ex.en: Press the button to open the door.
ex.zh: 按按钮开门。

ex.en: If editors press reporters to publish before they check, false stories spread faster.
ex.zh: 如果编辑催记者在核对之前发表，假消息会传得更快。

tip: the press 表示新闻界。

senses.en: the surface of the earth, or an area for sport

ex.en: The bag fell to the ground.
ex.zh: 包掉到了地上。

ex.en: A sports ground that floods every spring is a sign the drains need work.
ex.zh: 每年春天都积水的运动场，说明排水需要整修。

tip: ground 作“地面”时常不可数。grounds 可指场地或理由。

senses.en: an activity with rules, often for fun or sport

ex.en: Our class won the basketball game.
ex.zh: 我们班赢了篮球赛。

ex.en: A game that rewards only speed may discourage students who think carefully but slowly.
ex.zh: 只奖励速度的游戏，可能会让思考仔细但较慢的学生失去信心。

tip: game 可指一场比赛；match 更常用于正式体育赛事。

senses.en: only one, or not married

ex.en: A single mistake in the date can spoil the form.
ex.zh: 日期上的一个错误就能让表格作废。

ex.en: A single tree cannot cool a playground, but a row of them can.
ex.zh: 一棵树凉不了一座操场，但一排树可以。

tip: single 强调仅一个；only 强调限制范围。

senses.en: a public garden in a town
to leave a vehicle somewhere

ex.en: The park is a short walk from school.
ex.zh: 公园离学校走路不远。

ex.en: A park on the edge of town helps little if children cannot cross the road to reach it.
ex.zh: 如果孩子过不了马路，城边的公园就帮不上什么忙。

tip: park 作动词是“停放车辆”。

senses.en: a male child

ex.en: The boy by the door is new.
ex.zh: 门边的男孩是新来的。

ex.en: A boy who wants to study nursing should see men doing that work, not only hear that it is allowed.
ex.zh: 想学护理的男孩应该看到有男性在做这份工作，而不只是听说这是允许的。

tip: boy 的复数是 boys。

senses.en: a type or shape, or a printed document
to make or shape

ex.en: Please fill in the form in pen.
ex.zh: 请用钢笔填表。

ex.en: Friendship can take the form of sharing notes, not only of sitting together at lunch.
ex.zh: 友谊可以表现为分享笔记，而不只是午饭坐在一起。

col: in the form of｜以……的形式
tip: form 作动词是“形成”或“组成”。

senses.en: an account of events, true or imagined

ex.en: The teacher told a short story before class ended.
ex.zh: 老师在下课前讲了一个短故事。

ex.en: A news story should name its sources, or readers cannot judge whether it is fair.
ex.zh: 一篇新闻报道应该写明来源，否则读者无法判断它是否公正。

tip: story 的复数是 stories。美式里 story 也可表示楼层。

senses.en: careful listening or looking

ex.en: Pay attention to the last sentence.
ex.zh: 注意最后一句。

ex.en: Public attention lasts a day after a flood, but the damaged road lasts for months.
ex.zh: 洪水之后公众的注意只持续一天，但损坏的路会持续数月。

tip: attention 不可数。pay attention to 后接名词或 doing。

senses.en: a kind or sort
to write with a keyboard

ex.en: This type of question appears every year.
ex.zh: 这类题每年都出现。

ex.en: The type of housing a city builds decides who can live near work and school.
ex.zh: 一座城市建造的住房类型，决定谁能住在工作和学校附近。

tip: type 作动词是“打字”。

senses.en: to make sure something is true
To make an arrangement certain or give it official approval.

ex.en: Please confirm your email address.
ex.zh: 请确认你的电子邮箱地址。

ex.en: Further research is needed to confirm whether smaller classes consistently improve learning outcomes in primary schools.
ex.zh: 还需要进一步研究，以证实小学小班教学是否能持续改善学习效果。

tip: 可接名词或that从句；不要用confirm to do。

senses.en: the gas around the earth

ex.en: Open a window and let in some fresh air.
ex.zh: 开窗透透新鲜空气。

ex.en: Dirty air around a school is not a small local problem when thousands of children breathe it daily.
ex.zh: 当数千名孩子每天呼吸学校周围的脏空气时，这就不是一件小事。

tip: air 通常不可数。by air 表示乘飞机。

senses.en: a formal request; a use
the practical use of knowledge, skills, or methods
a computer program designed to perform particular tasks

ex.en: Send your application before Friday.
ex.zh: 周五前递交你的申请。

ex.en: Simplifying the application process could encourage more students from disadvantaged backgrounds to apply for university scholarships.
ex.zh: 简化申请流程可能鼓励更多来自弱势家庭的学生申请大学奖学金。

tip: 申请某物用application for，向机构申请用to。

senses.en: a group working or playing together

ex.en: Our team practises on Wednesday evenings.
ex.zh: 我们队周三晚上训练。

ex.en: A rescue team is only as fast as the roads and phone signals that connect it to a village.
ex.zh: 救援队的速度，取决于连接它和村庄的道路与手机信号。

tip: team 作整体时谓语可用单数；强调成员时可用复数。

senses.en: a human being

ex.en: She is the right person to ask about the map.
ex.zh: 问地图的事，她是合适的人。

ex.en: A person who cannot afford the bus may never see the museum the city is proud of.
ex.zh: 付不起公交费的人，可能永远看不到这座城市引以为傲的博物馆。

tip: person 的复数通常是 people，不常说 persons。

senses.en: a road in a town with buildings

ex.en: Our school is on a quiet street.
ex.zh: 我们学校在一条安静的街上。

ex.en: A street without a pavement pushes children into the same space as cars.
ex.zh: 没有人行道的街道，把孩子推进和汽车相同的空间。

tip: in the street 和 on the street 都可以，英式更常用 in。

senses.en: to have something as a part

ex.en: The price includes lunch.
ex.zh: 价格里包括午餐。

ex.en: A transport plan should include the walk from the last bus stop to the school gate.
ex.zh: 交通计划应该包括从末班车站走到校门的那段路。

tip: including 是介词，后面接名词。

senses.en: the part of a person that thinks
to be annoyed by, or to be careful

ex.en: I changed my mind after I read the article.
ex.zh: 读完那篇文章后我改变了主意。

ex.en: A tired mind makes careless mistakes, which is why sleep belongs in any study plan.
ex.zh: 疲惫的头脑会犯粗心的错误，所以任何学习计划都该包括睡眠。

col: make up one's mind｜下定决心
tip: mind 作动词是“介意”：Would you mind doing...?

senses.en: to examine to see if something is correct
an examination, or an American bank form

ex.en: Check your name before you hand in the paper.
ex.zh: 交卷前核对你的名字。

ex.en: Cities should check air quality outside schools, not only in the parks that look good in photos.
ex.zh: 城市应该检查学校外面的空气质量，而不只是照片里好看的公园。

tip: check 直接接宾语。支票是 cheque（英）或 check（美）。

senses.en: coming at the end

ex.en: This is the final day to hand in the form.
ex.zh: 今天是交表的最后一天。

ex.en: A final decision on a new road should wait until residents have seen the plan.
ex.zh: 关于新路的最终决定，应该等到居民看过方案之后。

tip: final 强调不可再改的最后；last 强调顺序上的最后一个。

senses.en: all things

ex.en: Everything is ready for the open day.
ex.zh: 开放日的一切都准备好了。

ex.en: A school cannot control everything a child sees online, so it should teach how to pause and check.
ex.zh: 学校无法控制孩子在网上看到的一切，所以应该教他们如何停下来核对。

tip: everything 作主语时谓语用单数。

senses.en: the direction where the sun goes down
in or towards the west

ex.en: The sun sets in the west.
ex.zh: 太阳在西边落下。

ex.en: Towns in the west of the region share one hospital, so the road between them matters.
ex.zh: 该地区西部的城镇共用一家医院，所以它们之间的路很重要。

tip: western 是形容词。the West 有时特指西方国家。

senses.en: a boy or man with the same parents

ex.en: My brother walks to school with me.
ex.zh: 我哥哥和我一起走路上学。

ex.en: A brother who leaves for the city may send money home, but the family loses his daily help.
ex.zh: 去城市的兄弟也许会寄钱回家，但家里失去了他日常的帮忙。

tip: brother 的复数是 brothers。

senses.en: lack of success
a situation in which a machine or organ stops working
not doing something that is expected or required

ex.en: failure can teach useful lessons.
ex.zh: 失败能教会有用的功课。

ex.en: Schools should treat failure as an opportunity for learning rather than as evidence of a student's limited ability.
ex.zh: 学校应将失败视为学习的机会，而不是学生能力有限的证明。

tip: 泛指失败通常不可数；a failure可指失败的事物。

senses.en: of people
a person

ex.en: Clean water is a basic human need.
ex.zh: 干净的水是人的基本需要。

ex.en: Human activity along a river, from farms to factories, decides whether the water stays drinkable.
ex.zh: 河边的人类活动，从农场到工厂，决定水是否还能饮用。

tip: human 可作形容词或名词；一个人更常说 a person 或 a human being。

senses.en: to strike, or to reach a level
a blow, or something very popular

ex.en: The ball hit the window but did not break it.
ex.zh: 球打到窗户，但没有打破。

ex.en: When summer temperatures hit a new high, schools without fans struggle to keep lessons going.
ex.zh: 当夏天气温创下新高时，没有风扇的学校很难把课继续下去。

col: hit sb on the head｜打某人的头
tip: hit 的过去式和过去分词都是 hit。打在某人某个部位用 hit sb on the + 部位。

senses.en: the time after now

ex.en: We talked about our future plans.
ex.zh: 我们谈了未来的计划。

ex.en: The future of a riverside town depends on whether the water stays clean enough to drink.
ex.zh: 河边城镇的未来，取决于水是否仍然干净到可以饮用。

tip: in the future 指将来；in future 常表示“今后”，带有从现在改起的意味。

senses.en: anything, or no matter what

ex.en: Take whatever you need from the box.
ex.zh: 盒子里你需要什么就拿什么。

ex.en: Whatever a poster promises, the bus still has to arrive before the first lesson.
ex.zh: 无论海报承诺什么，公交仍必须在第一节课前到达。

tip: whatever 可引导让步状语从句，相当于 no matter what。

senses.en: to move towards the speaker or a place

ex.en: Come to the hall when you hear the bell.
ex.zh: 听到铃声就到大厅来。

ex.en: New businesses come to a town only when roads, power, and schools are already reliable.
ex.zh: 只有当道路、电力和学校已经可靠时，新的商家才会来到一个城镇。

tip: come 的过去式是 came，过去分词是 come。

senses.en: to take food into the body

ex.en: We eat lunch in the classroom on rainy days.
ex.zh: 下雨天我们在教室吃午饭。

ex.en: Students eat more packaged food when the school canteen closes before the last lesson.
ex.zh: 当食堂在最后一节课前关闭时，学生会吃更多包装食品。

tip: eat 的过去式是 ate，过去分词是 eaten。

senses.en: close to
not far
at a short distance

ex.en: There is a bus stop near the gate.
ex.zh: 门口附近有一个公交站。

ex.en: Clinics near schools make it easier for a sick child to be seen and then return home.
ex.zh: 学校附近的诊所，让生病的孩子更容易看病然后回家。

tip: near 可作介词、形容词或副词。nearly 是“几乎”，不是“附近”。

senses.en: a place of higher or further education

ex.en: He hopes to study art at college.
ex.zh: 他希望在大学学艺术。

ex.en: A college far from cheap housing leaves students working nights just to pay the rent.
ex.zh: 远离廉价住房的大学，会让学生为了付房租而上夜班。

tip: 在美式英语里 college 常泛指大学。

senses.en: to shut
near, or intimate
near

ex.en: Please close the door quietly.
ex.zh: 请轻轻关门。

ex.en: Shops that close early leave night-shift workers with nowhere nearby to buy food.
ex.zh: 早关门的商店，让夜班工人附近没有地方买食物。

tip: close 作形容词读 /kləʊs/，表示“近的”；作动词读 /kləʊz/。

senses.en: to stay until something happens

ex.en: Please wait for me at the gate.
ex.zh: 请在门口等我。

ex.en: Children who wait for a bus in the dark need a light and a shelter, not only a timetable.
ex.zh: 在黑暗中等公交的孩子需要灯和候车亭，而不只是时刻表。

tip: wait 是不及物动词，必须加 for 再接等待的对象。

senses.en: below, or less than

ex.en: The cat is sleeping under the desk.
ex.zh: 猫在书桌下睡觉。

ex.en: Children under six need shorter lessons and more time to move than a standard timetable allows.
ex.zh: 六岁以下的孩子需要比标准课表更短的课和更多活动时间。

tip: under 可表示在下方，也可表示少于某个年龄或数量。

senses.en: belonging to one person

ex.en: Please do not read my personal notes.
ex.zh: 请不要看我的私人笔记。

ex.en: Personal data from a school app should stay with the school, not be sold.
ex.zh: 学校应用里的个人数据应该留在学校，不该被卖掉。

tip: personal 强调属于个人；personnel 是“全体人员”，不要拼混。

senses.en: able to happen or be done

ex.en: Is it possible to finish today?
ex.zh: 今天做完可能吗？

ex.en: It is possible to cut traffic if buses are frequent enough that people leave their cars at home.
ex.zh: 如果公交足够频繁、人们把车留在家里，减少车流是可能的。

tip: It is possible for sb to do。possible 的主语通常是事物或 it，不是人。

senses.en: something you aim at, or a point scored

ex.en: Our goal is to finish the poster today.
ex.zh: 我们的目标是今天完成海报。

ex.en: A goal of cleaner air needs buses and trees, not only a sentence in a report.
ex.zh: 更干净空气的目标需要公交和树，而不只是报告里的一句话。

tip: goal 既可指球类进球，也可指目标。

senses.en: to speak words

ex.en: What did the coach say after the match?
ex.zh: 比赛后教练说了什么？

ex.en: Experts say that planting trees without caring for them later wastes both money and land.
ex.zh: 专家说，种了树却不后续养护，会同时浪费金钱和土地。

col: that is to say｜也就是说
tip: say 强调说的内容；tell 后面常接人：tell sb sth。

senses.en: the time before now
later than, or from one side to the other
gone by in time

ex.en: The photo shows the school in the past.
ex.zh: 照片展示了过去的学校。

ex.en: A city that forgets its past may knock down the only building that tells that story.
ex.zh: 忘记过去的城市，可能会拆掉唯一讲述那段故事的建筑。

tip: past 作介词是“经过”：walk past the gate。half past six 是六点半。

senses.en: a large amount, or a piece of land

ex.en: A lot of students take the early bus.
ex.zh: 很多学生乘早班车。

ex.en: A parking lot on a former playground shows what a school gives up when space becomes expensive.
ex.zh: 原来的操场变成停车场，说明当空间变贵时，学校放弃了什么。

tip: a lot of 既可接可数也可接不可数；too much 只接不可数。

senses.en: to draw interest
Pull something closer through a physical force

ex.en: Bright colors attract many insects.
ex.zh: 鲜艳的颜色吸引许多昆虫。

ex.en: Cities that invest in reliable public transport are more likely to attract businesses and skilled workers.
ex.zh: 投资建设可靠公共交通的城市更有可能吸引企业和技术人才。

tip: attract是及物动词，直接接人或事物作宾语。

senses.en: feeling regret or sympathy

ex.en: I am sorry for being late.
ex.zh: 对不起，我迟到了。

ex.en: Saying sorry does not repair a leaked pipe, but refusing to say it makes neighbours angrier.
ex.zh: 说对不起修不好漏水的管子，但拒绝说会让邻居更生气。

tip: sorry 后接 to do 或 that 从句都可以。

senses.en: to annoy or trouble
to make the effort to do something
trouble or effort that causes inconvenience

ex.en: Sorry to bother you so late.
ex.zh: 很抱歉这么晚打扰你。

ex.en: Constant notifications can bother students during lessons and reduce their ability to concentrate on complex tasks.
ex.zh: 持续不断的通知会在课堂上干扰学生，降低他们专注于复杂任务的能力。

col: bother someone with something｜拿某事打扰某人
bother to do something｜费心做某事
a lot of bother｜很多麻烦
tip: bother to do常用于否定或疑问，表示费心做。

senses.en: a competition of speed, or a group of people
to compete in a race

ex.en: She won the race by two seconds.
ex.zh: 她以两秒的优势赢了赛跑。

ex.en: A race to build the cheapest housing can ignore the drains a street will need later.
ex.zh: 竞相建造最便宜住房的竞赛，可能忽略一条街日后需要的排水。

col: a race against time｜争分夺秒
tip: race 作动词是“赛跑”。表示种族时要慎重，避免把人简化成类别。

senses.en: in spite of the fact that

ex.en: Although it was late, the library was still open.
ex.zh: 虽然晚了，图书馆还开着。

ex.en: Although a city builds more roads, traffic can grow if more people then choose to drive.
ex.zh: 尽管一座城市修建更多道路，如果更多人因此选择开车，交通仍可能增加。

tip: although 引导的从句不能再加 but。可以加 yet 或 still。

senses.en: to discover something, often after looking

ex.en: I cannot find my student card.
ex.zh: 我找不到学生卡了。

ex.en: Scientists sometimes find that a cheap local method works better than an imported machine.
ex.zh: 科学家有时发现，便宜的本地方法比进口机器更有效。

tip: find 的过去式和过去分词是 found，不是 finded。

senses.en: to move on foot

ex.en: We walk to school when the weather is fine.
ex.zh: 天气好时我们步行上学。

ex.en: People walk more when the pavement is wide and the crossing has a light.
ex.zh: 当人行道宽、过街处有灯时，人们会更多地步行。

tip: walk 可作动词或名词：a ten-minute walk。

senses.en: to move quickly, manage, or operate
an act of running, or a period

ex.en: I run around the playground every morning.
ex.zh: 我每天早上绕操场跑。

ex.en: Volunteers who run a community library need a budget, not only good intentions.
ex.zh: 经营社区图书馆的志愿者需要预算，而不只是好意。

col: in the long run｜从长远看
tip: run 的过去式是 ran，过去分词是 run。

senses.en: to be unlike
To have a different opinion from another person.

ex.en: Opinions may differ among friends.
ex.zh: 朋友之间意见可能不同。

ex.en: Educational priorities differ between countries because economic conditions and cultural expectations shape national policies.
ex.zh: 各国的教育重点有所不同，因为经济条件和文化期待会影响国家政策。

col: differ with someone｜与某人意见不同
tip: from引出比较对象，in引出差异方面。

senses.en: brightness, or a lamp
not heavy, or bright, or pale
to start something burning

ex.en: Please turn off the light when you leave.
ex.zh: 离开时请关灯。

ex.en: Street light makes the walk home safer, but too much light can also hide the night sky.
ex.zh: 路灯让回家的路更安全，但过多的光也会遮住夜空。

tip: light 作形容词是“轻的”或“浅色的”，比较级 lighter。作动词“点燃”的过去式可以是 lit。

senses.en: not detailed; overall
describing main points rather than particular details
an officer with a very high rank in the army

ex.en: In general, people prefer weekends.
ex.zh: 一般来说，人们更喜欢周末。

ex.en: Although the general standard of education has improved, significant differences remain between urban and rural schools.
ex.zh: 尽管教育总体水平已有提高，城乡学校之间仍存在显著差异。

tip: in general意为“一般来说”，常用于概括。

senses.en: to say someone is responsible for a fault
Responsibility for something bad that has happened.

ex.en: Don't blame others for your mistakes.
ex.zh: 不要把自己的错误归咎于别人。

ex.en: It is unfair to blame individuals alone for environmental problems caused partly by industrial activity.
ex.zh: 环境问题部分由工业活动造成，仅归咎于个人并不公平。

col: blame someone for something｜因某事责怪某人
blame something on someone｜把某事归咎于某人
tip: 人作宾语用blame sb for；事作宾语用blame sth on。

senses.en: to direct one's eyes, or to seem

ex.en: Look at the diagram before you answer.
ex.zh: 回答之前先看图。

ex.en: Streets that look beautiful in photos may still be unsafe if there is nowhere to cross.
ex.zh: 在照片里好看的街道，如果没有地方过马路，仍然可能不安全。

tip: look forward to 后面接名词或 doing。look 是看的动作，see 是看见。

senses.en: a system of words used by a group

ex.en: English is not her first language.
ex.zh: 英语不是她的第一语言。

ex.en: A local language disappears faster when children never hear it outside the home.
ex.zh: 当孩子在家门外再也听不到一种本地语言时，它会消失得更快。

tip: language 可数。the English language 要加 the。

senses.en: doing something repeatedly to improve

ex.en: Piano practice is at four.
ex.zh: 钢琴练习在四点。

ex.en: Practice on a real street teaches road safety better than a worksheet.
ex.zh: 在真实的街道上练习，比一张练习纸更能教会交通安全。

tip: 英式里 practice 是名词，practise 是动词；美式动词也拼作 practice。

senses.en: a member of a country
A person who lives in a particular town or city.

ex.en: Every citizen has rights and duties.
ex.zh: 每个公民都有权利与义务。

ex.en: Every citizen should have access to reliable public services, regardless of income or place of residence.
ex.zh: 每位公民都应享有可靠的公共服务，不论收入多少或居住在哪里。

col: a responsible citizen｜负责任的公民
tip: citizen强调公民身份；resident强调居住。

senses.en: relating to a central government of states

ex.en: The federal museum lent the town an old map.
ex.zh: 联邦博物馆借给这个城镇一张旧地图。

ex.en: Federal money for rural buses matters when a state budget cannot cover the long routes.
ex.zh: 当州预算覆盖不了长线路时，用于乡村公交的联邦资金就很重要。

tip: federal 多用于美国等联邦制国家的中央政府。

senses.en: a common animal kept at home

ex.en: The dog waited outside the classroom.
ex.zh: 狗在教室外面等着。

ex.en: A dog on a loose lead near a school gate can frighten children who are trying to cross.
ex.zh: 校门口松着绳子的狗，会吓到正要过马路的孩子。

tip: dog 是可数名词。

senses.en: to speak with someone
a conversation or a speech

ex.en: We talked about the class trip at lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭时我们谈了班级出游。

ex.en: Teachers who talk with students about sleep learn more than they do from a questionnaire alone.
ex.zh: 和学生谈睡眠的老师，比只看问卷了解得更多。

tip: talk 强调交谈；say 强调说出的内容。

senses.en: a mother

ex.en: My mom works at the hospital.
ex.zh: 我妈妈在医院工作。

ex.en: A mom on a night shift may never see the school play her child is in.
ex.zh: 上夜班的妈妈可能永远看不到孩子参加的学校演出。

tip: mom 是美式口语；英式常用 mum。正式写作可用 mother。

senses.en: a polite title for a man

ex.en: Yes, sir, I will bring the form tomorrow.
ex.zh: 是的，先生，我明天把表格带来。

ex.en: A letter that begins with Sir still fails if the request itself is unclear.
ex.zh: 以 Sir 开头的信，如果请求本身不清楚，仍然会失败。

tip: sir 单独称呼时不大写也可，但在书信 Dear Sir 中要大写。

senses.en: a room where people do written work

ex.en: The teacher is in the office now.
ex.zh: 老师现在在办公室。

ex.en: An office that stays lit all night wastes power and tells the street that nobody switched it off.
ex.zh: 整夜亮灯的办公室既费电，也向街道表明没人去关灯。

tip: in the office 表示在办公室里。

senses.en: a person you know and like

ex.en: My friend lent me her notes.
ex.zh: 朋友把笔记借给了我。

ex.en: A friend who checks a rumour before sharing it protects the whole class from a false story.
ex.zh: 先核对谣言再转发的朋友，能保护全班不受假消息影响。

col: a friend of mine｜我的一个朋友
tip: make friends with sb 表示与某人交朋友。

senses.en: certain, or reliable

ex.en: Are you sure this is your bag?
ex.zh: 你确定这是你的包吗？

ex.en: Leaders should not be sure a policy works until they have asked the people who live with it.
ex.zh: 领导者在询问真正生活在政策之下的人之前，不应确信政策有效。

tip: be sure to do 提醒某人一定要做；make sure 后面常接 that 从句。

senses.en: a set of printed pages
to arrange to have something later

ex.en: I borrowed a book from the school library.
ex.zh: 我从学校图书馆借了一本书。

ex.en: A town that closes its bookshop loses a place where people discover titles a screen did not suggest.
ex.zh: 关掉书店的城镇，失去了一个人们发现屏幕不曾推荐的书的地方。

tip: book 作动词是“预订”：book a ticket。

senses.en: not public

ex.en: This is a private letter.
ex.zh: 这是一封私人信件。

ex.en: Private buses may fill a gap, but they often skip the stops that make the least money.
ex.zh: 私人公交也许能补上缺口，但它们常常跳过最不赚钱的站点。

tip: private 与 public 相对。

senses.en: the place where one lives

ex.en: I left my keys at home.
ex.zh: 我把钥匙落在家里了。

ex.en: A city that offers only expensive flats cannot call itself a home for the nurses and drivers it needs.
ex.zh: 一座只提供昂贵公寓的城市，无法成为它所需的护士和司机的家。

tip: home 前通常不加 to：go home，不是 go to home。

senses.en: money paid to a government

ex.en: The town uses tax money to repair the bridge.
ex.zh: 城镇用税款修桥。

ex.en: A small tax on plastic bags can change what people carry home from the market.
ex.zh: 对塑料袋征收一小笔税，可以改变人们从市场拎回家的东西。

tip: tax 作动词是“征税”。

senses.en: a day of the month, or a planned meeting
to write the day on something

ex.en: Write the date at the top of the page.
ex.zh: 把日期写在页首。

ex.en: The date on a food label matters when a family cannot afford to throw good food away.
ex.zh: 当一个家庭扔不起还好的食物时，食品标签上的日期就很重要。

tip: date 作动词是“注明日期”或“约会”。

senses.en: a group of people who meet for an activity

ex.en: I joined the reading club this term.
ex.zh: 这学期我加入了读书社团。

ex.en: A school club that costs money to join leaves out students who cannot pay.
ex.zh: 需要交钱才能加入的学校社团，会把付不起钱的学生排除在外。

tip: club 也可指棍棒，考纲里更常见的是社团。

senses.en: a feeling, a meaning, or a way of noticing

ex.en: There is a sense of quiet in the library.
ex.zh: 图书馆里有一种安静的感觉。

ex.en: A sense of fairness grows when students see that rules apply to everyone.
ex.zh: 当学生看到规则适用于所有人时，公平感会增长。

col: in a sense｜在某种意义上
tip: make sense 表示说得通，主语是事物。

senses.en: the reflexive form of I

ex.en: I made the poster myself.
ex.zh: 海报是我自己做的。

ex.en: I asked myself whether a shorter shower would matter if the whole building still wasted water.
ex.zh: 我问自己，如果整栋楼仍在浪费水，缩短淋浴是否还有意义。

tip: myself 作宾语或同位语，不能替代 I 作主语。

senses.en: before now, or sooner than expected

ex.en: I have already handed in the form.
ex.zh: 我已经交了表格。

ex.en: By the time a warning is issued, the river may already have risen over the path to school.
ex.zh: 等到警报发出时，河水可能已经漫过上学的小路。

tip: already 多用于肯定句；否定和疑问里表示“尚未”常用 yet。

senses.en: a piece of music with words

ex.en: We learned a new song in music class.
ex.zh: 音乐课上我们学了一首新歌。

ex.en: A local song can keep a dialect alive when children no longer hear it at home.
ex.zh: 当孩子在家里不再听到一种方言时，一首本地歌曲能让它继续活着。

tip: song 是可数名词。

senses.en: a section of a school, shop, or government

ex.en: She works in the English department.
ex.zh: 她在英语系工作。

ex.en: A health department that shares data with schools can warn them before a heatwave arrives.
ex.zh: 与学校共享数据的卫生部门，可以在热浪到来前发出警告。

tip: department 是组织里的部门或大学的系。

senses.en: to feel that something is important
attention or looking after someone

ex.en: She cares about every student in the class.
ex.zh: 她关心班上的每一个学生。

ex.en: People care more about a park when they helped plant the trees than when they only walk past it.
ex.zh: 人们如果参与种过树，会比只是路过时更在意一座公园。

tip: care for 可以是照顾，也可以是“喜欢”，要看语境。

senses.en: an adult female person

ex.en: A woman from the clinic spoke to our class.
ex.zh: 诊所的一位女士给我们班讲了话。

ex.en: A woman who works a night shift still needs a safe way home when the last bus has gone.
ex.zh: 上夜班的妇女在末班车走后，仍然需要一条安全的回家路。

tip: woman 的复数是 women，读音也变。

senses.en: coming immediately after

ex.en: The next bus leaves in ten minutes.
ex.zh: 下一班车十分钟后开。

ex.en: The next step after collecting data is to ask whether the sample left anyone out.
ex.zh: 收集数据之后的下一步，是追问样本是否漏掉了什么人。

tip: next week 前不加 the；the next week 常指过去某个时间之后的一周。

senses.en: the organisation that keeps public order

ex.en: The police helped the children cross the road.
ex.zh: 警察帮助孩子们过马路。

ex.en: Police cannot be the only answer to a dark street; lights and pavements matter too.
ex.zh: 警察不能是黑暗街道的唯一答案；灯和人行道也很重要。

tip: police 是集体名词，谓语常用复数。一个警察用 a police officer。

senses.en: not old

ex.en: The young trees need water every evening.
ex.zh: 这些小树每天晚上需要浇水。

ex.en: Young workers leave a town when the only jobs are far away and poorly paid.
ex.zh: 当仅有的工作又远又报酬低时，年轻工人会离开城镇。

tip: the young 表示年轻人这一类，谓语用复数。

senses.en: the facts of a particular time

ex.en: The situation is better than last week.
ex.zh: 情况比上周好。

ex.en: The situation on a flooded street is not the same as the situation on a dry planning map.
ex.zh: 积水街道上的情况，和干燥的规划地图上的情况不一样。

col: in a situation｜处于某种情况
tip: situation 是可数名词。

senses.en: to keep doing something

ex.en: Please continue reading after the break.
ex.zh: 休息后请继续阅读。

ex.en: If factories continue to pour waste at night, daytime clean-ups will not save the river.
ex.zh: 如果工厂继续在夜里排污，白天的清理也救不了这条河。

tip: continue 后接 to do 或 doing 都可以。

senses.en: a sports game, or a small stick for making fire
to fit or be equal to

ex.en: The football match is on Saturday.
ex.zh: 足球赛在周六。

ex.en: A cup match brings visitors, but the town still needs bins and buses after the final whistle.
ex.zh: 杯赛带来观众，但终场哨响后城镇仍需要垃圾桶和公交。

col: a box of matches｜一盒火柴
tip: match 作动词是“匹配”。win a match，不说 win sb。

senses.en: the organ that pumps blood, or the centre

ex.en: Regular walks are good for the heart.
ex.zh: 经常走路对心脏有好处。

ex.en: A market in the heart of a town keeps daily life there; a mall on the edge can empty the centre.
ex.zh: 镇中心的市场维持着那里的日常生活；边缘的商场可能掏空中心。

tip: by heart 表示靠记忆，不是“靠心脏”。

senses.en: before now

ex.en: The museum closed two years ago.
ex.zh: 博物馆两年前关门了。

ex.en: A factory that shut ten years ago can still leave chemicals in the soil beside a school.
ex.zh: 十年前关闭的工厂，仍可能把化学物质留在学校旁边的土壤里。

tip: ago 用于过去时，放在时间段后面：three days ago。不与现在完成时连用。

senses.en: shaped like a circle
around
one stage of an event

ex.en: They sat at a round table.
ex.zh: 他们坐在圆桌旁。

ex.en: A round of talks about the river should include the farms upstream, not only the city.
ex.zh: 关于这条河的一轮会谈应该包括上游的农场，而不只是城市。

col: all the year round｜一年到头
tip: 英式里 round 常作介词“围绕”；美式多用 around。

senses.en: a male child

ex.en: Her son walks to school with a neighbour.
ex.zh: 她儿子和邻居一起走路上学。

ex.en: A son who leaves for the city may still send money home, but the village loses his daily help.
ex.zh: 去城市的儿子也许仍会寄钱回家，但村子失去了他日常的帮忙。

tip: son 的复数是 sons。

senses.en: personality; a person in a story
a person represented in a story, play, or film
a written or printed symbol, such as a letter

ex.en: Honesty is part of his character.
ex.zh: 诚实是他性格的一部分。

ex.en: Preserving historic buildings helps cities retain their distinctive character while adapting to modern economic demands.
ex.zh: 保护历史建筑有助于城市在适应现代经济需求的同时，保留自身的独特风貌。

tip: 作“人物、字符”可数；作整体品质常不可数。

senses.en: perhaps

ex.en: Maybe we can meet after the club.
ex.zh: 也许我们可以在社团活动后见面。

ex.en: Maybe a later school start would help, but only if buses change their times too.
ex.zh: 也许推迟上学时间会有帮助，但只有公交也改时间才行。

tip: maybe 是一个副词；may be 是情态动词加动词，要分开写。

senses.en: the worth or importance of something
to think something is important

ex.en: The old map still has value for the history class.
ex.zh: 这张旧地图对历史课仍有价值。

ex.en: The value of a library is not only the books, but the quiet hour it gives after school.
ex.zh: 图书馆的价值不只是书，还有它在放学后提供的安静一小时。

tip: value 作动词是“重视”或“估价”。

senses.en: to or at a distance

ex.en: She put the phone away during dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭时她把手机收起来了。

ex.en: Moving factories away from rivers can protect drinking water for the towns downstream.
ex.zh: 把工厂迁离河流，可以保护下游城镇的饮用水。

tip: away 是副词，不单独接宾语；表示离开某地用 away from。

senses.en: inside a limit of time, distance, or area

ex.en: Please reply within three days.
ex.zh: 请在三天内回复。

ex.en: A clinic within walking distance saves families the cost of a long bus ride.
ex.zh: 步行能到的诊所，能为家庭省下长途公交的费用。

col: within reach｜在够得着的范围内
tip: within 强调不超过某个范围；in 更一般。

senses.en: a device for speaking to someone at a distance

ex.en: I left my phone in the classroom.
ex.zh: 我把电话落在教室了。

ex.en: A phone warning about a storm helps only the people who still have power and a signal.
ex.zh: 关于风暴的手机警报，只帮助那些还有电和信号的人。

tip: phone 作动词是“打电话”：phone sb。

senses.en: to fail to catch, or to feel sad someone is away

ex.en: I missed the early bus this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上我错过了早班车。

ex.en: Students miss more than a lesson when a flood closes the only road to school.
ex.zh: 当洪水封了唯一的上学路，学生错过的不只是一节课。

tip: Miss 大写是对未婚女性的称呼，和动词 miss 不同。

senses.en: to come after, or to obey

ex.en: Follow the signs to the hall.
ex.zh: 按指示牌去大厅。

ex.en: Students follow a timetable, but the buses they need may follow a different one.
ex.zh: 学生遵守课表，但他们需要的公交可能遵守另一份时刻表。

tip: follow 是及物动词，后面直接接宾语，通常不加 to。

senses.en: a number; an important person
a person, their outline, or the shape of their body
to think or decide something after considering it

ex.en: The figure on the board is wrong.
ex.zh: 黑板上的数字错了。

ex.en: Recent employment figures suggest that investment in public transport can create substantial opportunities for local workers.
ex.zh: 近期就业数据显示，投资公共交通能为当地劳动者创造大量机会。

tip: 数据常用复数figures；figure out意为弄懂。

senses.en: to succeed in doing something

ex.en: He worked hard to achieve his goals.
ex.zh: 他努力工作以实现目标。

ex.en: Governments can achieve significant reductions in air pollution by investing in clean energy and improving public transport.
ex.zh: 政府可以通过投资清洁能源和改善公共交通，大幅减少空气污染。

tip: 直接接目标或成果，不说achieve to do。

senses.en: a usual practice
made to meet a particular customer's needs
the business customers give to a shop or company

ex.en: Shaking hands is a common custom.
ex.zh: 握手是一种常见习俗。

ex.en: Schools can introduce children to local customs while encouraging respect for traditions from other cultures.
ex.zh: 学校可以向孩子们介绍当地风俗，同时鼓励他们尊重其他文化的传统。

tip: custom指风俗或惯例；customs还可指海关。

senses.en: to become or make larger

ex.en: The number of bikes increased this term.
ex.zh: 这学期自行车的数量增加了。

ex.en: If rents increase faster than wages, workers move farther from the jobs a city needs.
ex.zh: 如果房租涨得比工资快，工人会搬得离城市需要的工作更远。

tip: increase 作名词时重音常在前，作动词时重音常在后。

senses.en: very nearly

ex.en: I almost missed the early bus.
ex.zh: 我差点错过早班车。

ex.en: A plan that is almost finished still fails if the last step, such as a safe crossing, is missing.
ex.zh: 一个几乎完成的计划，如果缺了最后一步，比如安全的过街处，仍然会失败。

tip: almost 可修饰 all、every、no；nearly 一般不修饰 no 和 never 的否定极限，习惯上用 almost no。

senses.en: a place of higher education

ex.en: She hopes to study biology at university.
ex.zh: 她希望在大学学生物。

ex.en: A university that ignores the town around it will not see the housing problems its students face.
ex.zh: 忽视周围城镇的大学，看不到自己学生面对的住房问题。

tip: go to university 泛指上大学，常不加 the。

senses.en: one or the other of two

ex.en: You may take either seat.
ex.zh: 两个座位你坐哪个都行。

ex.en: Either the bus comes on time or students start arriving late, and then the first lesson suffers.
ex.zh: 要么公交准时，要么学生开始迟到，然后第一节课受影响。

tip: either...or 连接主语时，谓语与靠近的主语一致。否定句末的“也”用 either，不用 too。

senses.en: to hand something to someone, or to provide

ex.en: Please give the form to your class teacher.
ex.zh: 请把表格交给班主任。

ex.en: Cities that give buses their own lanes often move more people than cities that only widen roads.
ex.zh: 给公交车专用车道的城市，往往比只拓宽马路的城市运送更多人。

tip: give sb sth 或 give sth to sb，两种语序都可以。

senses.en: strength, or a group organised to use power
to make someone do something

ex.en: The wind had enough force to shut the door.
ex.zh: 风力大得把门关上了。

ex.en: A city should not use force as the first answer to a peaceful student march.
ex.zh: 一座城市不该把武力当作对学生和平游行的第一反应。

tip: force sb to do 表示强迫某人做。

senses.en: used to agree or accept

ex.en: Yes, I can stay after class to help.
ex.zh: 是的，我可以课后留下来帮忙。

ex.en: A quick yes from a committee means little if nobody records who will do the work.
ex.zh: 委员会随口答应没什么用，如果没人记下谁来干活。

tip: yes 用来肯定；对否定疑问句回答要按事实，而不是顺着问句。

senses.en: at the back of
at the back

ex.en: The lab is behind the library.
ex.zh: 实验室在图书馆后面。

ex.en: The reasons behind a high absence rate may be buses and jobs, not only a lack of interest.
ex.zh: 高缺勤率背后的原因可能是公交和工作，而不只是缺乏兴趣。

tip: behind 是介词或副词。落后用 fall behind。

senses.en: very good, important, or large

ex.en: We had a great time at the school fair.
ex.zh: 我们在校园义卖上玩得很开心。

ex.en: A great increase in visitors can damage the very places people travel to see.
ex.zh: 游客的大量增加，可能破坏人们专程去看的那些地方。

tip: a great many 后接可数名词复数。

senses.en: the reflexive form of he

ex.en: He fixed the bike himself.
ex.zh: 他自己修好了自行车。

ex.en: A mayor who walks the flooded street himself learns more than one who only reads a report.
ex.zh: 亲自走过积水街道的市长，比只读报告的市长了解得更多。

tip: himself 不能代替 he 作主语。

senses.en: belonging to the person mentioned
to possess

ex.en: I wrote the speech in my own words.
ex.zh: 我用自己的话写了这篇演讲。

ex.en: A town that grows its own vegetables is less shaken when outside supplies are delayed.
ex.zh: 自己种菜的城镇，在外部供应延误时受到的冲击更小。

tip: own 前要有物主代词：my own，不能单独说 own book。

senses.en: the two together

ex.en: Both answers are possible.
ex.zh: 两个答案都有可能。

ex.en: A city needs both affordable housing and good schools if it wants families to stay.
ex.zh: 如果一座城市希望家庭留下来，就既需要付得起的住房，也需要好学校。

tip: both...and... 连接并列成分，谓语用复数。

senses.en: to believe someone is honest or reliable
belief that someone is reliable

ex.en: I trust her to lock the lab.
ex.zh: 我信任她会锁好实验室。

ex.en: People trust a clinic more when the same nurse is there every week.
ex.zh: 当同一位护士每周都在时，人们更信任一家诊所。

col: trust sb to do｜相信某人会做
tip: trust 后可接 sb to do。

senses.en: in the inner part of
in the inner part

ex.en: Please wait inside the hall.
ex.zh: 请在大厅里面等。

ex.en: Noise from inside a factory can be lower than the noise of trucks waiting outside it.
ex.zh: 工厂内部的噪音，可能低于在外面等候的卡车的噪音。

tip: inside 可作介词或副词。

senses.en: to choose officially
a choice made in an election

ex.en: The class will vote for a monitor.
ex.zh: 班级将投票选班长。

ex.en: People vote more calmly when the polling place is near and the rules are posted in plain words.
ex.zh: 当投票点很近、规则用浅显的话贴出来时，人们投票会更从容。

tip: vote 作名词是“选票”或“投票”。

senses.en: willing to give
larger or more plentiful than usual or expected

ex.en: She is generous with her time.
ex.zh: 她在时间上很大方。

ex.en: Generous donations from local businesses can help community centres provide affordable activities for children and older residents.
ex.zh: 当地企业的慷慨捐助可以帮助社区中心为儿童和老年居民提供价格实惠的活动。

col: generous with your time｜不吝惜时间
tip: be generous with sth表示在某方面慷慨。

senses.en: a piece of furniture for sleeping

ex.en: I went to bed at ten.
ex.zh: 我十点上床睡觉。

ex.en: A student who goes to bed after midnight will feel the cost in the first lesson.
ex.zh: 午夜后才上床的学生，会在第一节课感受到代价。

tip: go to bed 指去睡觉；sleep 是睡觉这个动作。

senses.en: television

ex.en: We watched the news on TV.
ex.zh: 我们在电视上看了新闻。

ex.en: TV can warn a town about a storm, but only if people still have electricity.
ex.zh: 电视可以警告城镇有风暴，但前提是人们还有电。

tip: TV 是 television 的缩写，前面常用 on。

senses.en: not different

ex.en: We took the same bus home.
ex.zh: 我们乘了同一班车回家。

ex.en: Two schools can follow the same timetable and still offer very different support to struggling students.
ex.zh: 两所学校可以执行同样的课表，但对学习吃力的学生提供的帮助仍然很不一样。

tip: same 前面通常加 the。

senses.en: the feeling of a place; air around Earth
the mixture of gases surrounding a planet

ex.en: The classroom had a friendly atmosphere.
ex.zh: 教室里气氛友好。

ex.en: A supportive classroom atmosphere encourages students to ask questions and participate more actively in discussions.
ex.zh: 相互支持的课堂氛围鼓励学生提问，并更加积极地参与讨论。

tip: 表示某种氛围常用an atmosphere；地球大气用the atmosphere。

senses.en: a recording of moving pictures

ex.en: We watched a short video about the river.
ex.zh: 我们看了一段关于这条河的短视频。

ex.en: A video can spread a false claim widely before anyone has time to check the pictures.
ex.zh: 一段视频可以在任何人来得及核对画面之前，把一个虚假说法传得很广。

tip: video 可数。看视频用 watch a video。

senses.en: throughout a period of time

ex.en: Please do not talk during the exam.
ex.zh: 考试期间请不要说话。

ex.en: During a drought, schools can show families how small daily changes save a surprising amount of water.
ex.zh: 干旱期间，学校可以向家庭展示，日常的小改变能省下惊人的水量。

tip: during 后接名词，不接句子；接句子用 while 或 when。

senses.en: not boastful; not large
not large in size, amount, or cost
wearing clothes that do not reveal much of the body

ex.en: She is modest about her success.
ex.zh: 她对自己的成功很谦虚。

ex.en: Even a modest increase in public transport funding could improve services in rural communities.
ex.zh: 即使公共交通拨款只小幅增加，也可能改善农村社区的服务。

col: modest about one's achievements｜对自己的成就谦虚
tip: 形容人常指谦虚；形容数量常指不大。

senses.en: facts that prove something
To show clearly that something exists or is true.

ex.en: There is no evidence of cheating.
ex.zh: 没有作弊的证据。

ex.en: Governments should consider scientific evidence before introducing policies intended to improve public health outcomes.
ex.zh: 政府在推出旨在改善公共健康状况的政策前，应考虑科学证据。

tip: 作名词通常不可数：一项证据用a piece of evidence。

senses.en: a way of dealing with something
To move nearer to someone or something.
To begin dealing with something or contact someone about it.

ex.en: A new approach may solve the problem.
ex.zh: 新方法可能解决这个问题。

ex.en: A balanced approach to urban planning should consider both economic growth and the protection of green spaces.
ex.zh: 均衡的城市规划方法应兼顾经济增长和绿地保护。

col: an approach to learning｜学习方法
adopt an approach｜采用一种方法
approach a problem｜着手处理问题
approach someone for advice｜找某人征求建议
tip: 名词“方法”后用to加名词或动名词；动词后直接接宾语。

senses.en: about right and wrong
a lesson about right and wrong learned from a story

ex.en: The story has a moral lesson.
ex.zh: 这个故事有道德寓意。

ex.en: Companies have a moral responsibility to ensure that their suppliers provide safe working conditions.
ex.zh: 企业在道义上有责任确保其供应商提供安全的工作环境。

col: the moral of the story｜故事的寓意
tip: moral指道德；morale指士气，注意拼写区别。

senses.en: to carry out; to lead
to allow heat or electricity to pass through
the way a person behaves, especially towards others

ex.en: Scientists conduct experiments in the lab.
ex.zh: 科学家在实验室进行实验。

ex.en: Researchers should conduct thorough trials before recommending new treatments for widespread use in public hospitals.
ex.zh: 研究人员在建议公立医院广泛采用新疗法之前，应开展充分的试验。

tip: 动词重音在后；名词重音在前，英音/ˈkɒndʌkt/。

senses.en: to discuss opposing views
To discuss a subject by considering different views.
To think carefully about options before making a decision.

ex.en: Students will debate the topic in class.
ex.zh: 学生们将在课堂上辩论这个话题。

ex.en: The debate over free public transport centres on its environmental benefits and the cost to taxpayers.
ex.zh: 关于免费公共交通的争论集中在其环境效益和纳税人需要承担的费用上。

col: debate an issue｜讨论一个问题
tip: 动词可直接接议题；debate whether to表示权衡。

senses.en: helpful

ex.en: Walking is beneficial to health.
ex.zh: 散步有益健康。

ex.en: Access to green spaces is particularly beneficial to urban residents who have limited opportunities for outdoor exercise.
ex.zh: 对于户外锻炼机会有限的城市居民来说，能够使用绿地尤其有益。

tip: 常接to或for，说明对谁或哪方面有益。

senses.en: a line that marks a limit
A limit defining acceptable behaviour or the scope of something

ex.en: Respect personal boundary at work.
ex.zh: 在工作中尊重个人界限。

ex.en: Clear boundaries between work and personal life can protect employees' mental health and reduce long-term stress.
ex.zh: 明确工作与个人生活的界限，可以保护员工的心理健康并减轻长期压力。

tip: boundary 强调分界；border 常用于国家或地区边界。

senses.en: to try
To try to do something, especially something difficult.

ex.en: She will attempt to climb the mountain.
ex.zh: 她将尝试爬山。

ex.en: Many cities are attempting to reduce air pollution by improving public transport and expanding cycling networks.
ex.zh: 许多城市正通过改善公共交通和扩展自行车道网络来尝试减少空气污染。

col: attempt to do something｜尝试做某事
in an attempt to｜为了尝试
tip: 动词后接to do；名词常用an attempt at doing。

senses.en: worried; eager
Very eager to do something or for something to happen.

ex.en: She felt anxious before the test.
ex.zh: 考试前她感到焦虑。

ex.en: Students may become anxious about their future when career guidance is unavailable at school.
ex.zh: 学校不提供职业指导时，学生可能会对未来感到焦虑。

tip: anxious about表担忧；anxious to do常表急切。

senses.en: to give time or energy to

ex.en: She will devote more time to study.
ex.zh: 她将把更多时间用于学习。

ex.en: Governments should devote more resources to preventive healthcare rather than relying entirely on expensive medical treatments.
ex.zh: 政府应将更多资源投入预防性医疗，而不是完全依赖昂贵的医学治疗。

tip: devote…to中的to是介词，后接名词或动名词。

senses.en: to change to fit a new situation
to change something for a different use or audience

ex.en: Animals must adapt to climate change.
ex.zh: 动物必须适应气候变化。

ex.en: Schools must adapt their teaching methods to meet the needs of students from diverse cultural backgrounds.
ex.zh: 学校必须调整教学方法，以满足不同文化背景学生的需求。

col: adapt teaching methods｜调整教学方法
adapt a novel for television｜把小说改编成电视剧
tip: adapt to后接名词或动名词；勿混adopt（采用）。

senses.en: previous
being the first of two people or things just mentioned

ex.en: He is a former student of this school.
ex.zh: 他是这所学校以前的学生。

ex.en: Former industrial sites can be transformed into public parks, improving urban environments and creating shared spaces.
ex.zh: 昔日的工业用地可以改建为公园，从而改善城市环境并创造共享空间。

col: former industrial site｜昔日工业用地
tip: the former 指两者中的前者，the latter 指后者。

senses.en: easy to see or understand

ex.en: It is evident that she studied hard.
ex.zh: 很明显她学习很努力。

ex.en: The benefits of improved public transport are evident in cities where traffic congestion has decreased.
ex.zh: 在交通拥堵有所缓解的城市，改善公共交通的益处显而易见。

tip: 常用It is evident that...表示显然……。

senses.en: enough

ex.en: Food supply is adequate.
ex.zh: 食物供应是足够的。

ex.en: Schools need adequate funding to maintain safe buildings and provide effective support for students with additional needs.
ex.zh: 学校需要充足的资金来保障校舍安全，并为有额外需求的学生提供有效支持。

col: adequate for the task｜足以胜任任务
tip: 表示达到所需标准，不等于优秀；常接for或to。

senses.en: real

ex.en: The actual cost was higher.
ex.zh: 实际费用更高。

ex.en: Governments should measure the actual impact of transport policies rather than relying solely on predicted benefits.
ex.zh: 政府应衡量交通政策的实际影响，而不是仅仅依赖预期收益。

tip: actual指实际的，不等于表示目前的current。

senses.en: easy to see; seeming
Seeming to be true, though possibly not actually true.

ex.en: It was apparent that he was tired.
ex.zh: 很明显他累了。

ex.en: Despite the apparent benefits of remote learning, some students struggle without direct support from teachers.
ex.zh: 尽管远程学习看似有诸多好处，一些学生在缺乏教师直接帮助时仍感到吃力。

col: for no apparent reason｜无明显原因
tip: 可指“明显的”，也可指“看似的”，须看语境。

senses.en: happening slowly
Rising or falling gently rather than steeply

ex.en: Progress is often gradual.
ex.zh: 进步往往是逐渐的。

ex.en: A gradual transition to renewable energy can help communities adapt without causing sudden job losses.
ex.zh: 逐步转向可再生能源有助于社区适应变化，避免就业岗位骤减。

tip: 强调变化缓慢、分阶段；副词形式为gradually。

senses.en: to suppose; to take on
To take on a duty, responsibility, or position.
To begin to have a particular appearance or quality.

ex.en: Don't assume that everyone knows the rules.
ex.zh: 不要假定人人都知道规则。

ex.en: Policymakers should not assume that all households have reliable internet access or adequate digital skills.
ex.zh: 政策制定者不应假定所有家庭都有稳定的网络连接或足够的数字技能。

tip: assume常接that从句，强调未经证实便认为。

senses.en: to take up; to take as one's own
To legally take someone else's child into your family.
To formally approve a proposal, policy, or rule.

ex.en: The school will adopt a new teaching method.
ex.zh: 学校将采用一种新的教学方法。

ex.en: Governments should adopt long-term strategies that improve public transport rather than simply building more roads.
ex.zh: 政府应采取改善公共交通的长期策略，而不是一味增建道路。

col: adopt an approach｜采用一种方法
adopt a policy｜采纳一项政策
tip: adopt是采用或收养；adapt是适应或改编。

senses.en: power to make decisions
an official body responsible for a particular area or service
a person with extensive knowledge of a particular subject

ex.en: The school authority made a new rule.
ex.zh: 学校当局制定了新规则。

ex.en: Local authorities should consult residents before introducing policies that significantly affect access to public services.
ex.zh: 地方当局在推出显著影响公共服务获取的政策前，应征求居民意见。

col: have authority to do something｜有权做某事
an authority on｜某方面的权威
tip: 表权力通常不可数；the authorities常指当局。

senses.en: something given to help
Money or goods given to support a person or cause.
A piece of writing supplied for a publication.

ex.en: His contribution to science was huge.
ex.zh: 他对科学的贡献巨大。

ex.en: Public libraries make a valuable contribution to lifelong learning by providing free access to information.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆通过免费提供信息资源，为终身学习作出了宝贵贡献。

col: make a contribution to｜为…作出贡献
tip: 常用make a contribution to；to后接名词或动名词。

senses.en: to value or be thankful for
Recognise and enjoy the value or quality of something.
Understand the importance or difficulty of a situation.

ex.en: I really appreciate your help.
ex.zh: 我真心感激你的帮助。

ex.en: Policymakers need to appreciate the difficulties rural communities face when accessing healthcare and other essential services.
ex.zh: 政策制定者需要理解农村社区在获取医疗及其他基本服务时面临的困难。

col: appreciate your help｜感谢你的帮助
appreciate the importance of｜认识到……的重要性
tip: 可接名词或动名词，不接to do；感谢帮助用appreciate your help。

senses.en: correct and exact
able to hit or reach the intended target

ex.en: Give an accurate answer, please.
ex.zh: 请给出准确答案。

ex.en: Accurate information about air quality enables residents to make informed decisions about outdoor exercise.
ex.zh: 准确的空气质量信息能帮助居民在充分知情的情况下决定是否进行户外锻炼。

tip: accurate强调准确无误；precise更强调细节精确。

senses.en: the right to act freely
The state of not experiencing something unpleasant.

ex.en: Speech freedom is valued in many places.
ex.zh: 许多地方重视言论自由。

ex.en: Universities should protect academic freedom while encouraging researchers to consider the social consequences of their work.
ex.zh: 大学应保护学术自由，同时鼓励研究人员考虑其工作的社会影响。

tip: freedom to do表示做某事的自由；from表示免受。

senses.en: basic and important
A basic principle or skill, usually considered with others.

ex.en: Honesty is a fundamental value.
ex.zh: 诚实是基本价值观。

ex.en: Access to clean drinking water is a fundamental requirement for improving public health in disadvantaged communities.
ex.zh: 获得清洁饮用水是改善弱势社区公共卫生的基本条件。

tip: 名词通常用复数 fundamentals，表示基本原理。

senses.en: a matter or event
a romantic relationship involving someone committed to another partner

ex.en: Public affair need careful attention.
ex.zh: 公共事务需要认真关注。

ex.en: Schools can encourage young people to take an interest in current affairs through regular discussions of global events.
ex.zh: 学校可以通过定期讨论全球事件，鼓励年轻人关注时事。

tip: 表公共事务常用复数affairs，如current affairs。

senses.en: first
The first letter of a person's name
To mark a document with the first letters of your names

ex.en: My initial plan was wrong.
ex.zh: 我最初的计划是错的。

ex.en: Although the initial cost of solar panels is high, households may save money over the longer term.
ex.zh: 虽然太阳能电池板的初期费用较高，但从长远看，家庭可能节省开支。

tip: 形容词通常放在名词前；姓名首字母常用initials。

senses.en: to state officially
to officially report goods, income or other required information

ex.en: The mayor will declare the festival open.
ex.zh: 市长将宣布节日开幕。

ex.en: Local authorities may declare a public holiday to encourage participation in an important community celebration.
ex.zh: 地方政府可能宣布放假一天，以鼓励民众参加重要的社区庆典。

col: declare an emergency｜宣布进入紧急状态
tip: declare强调公开或正式宣布；海关申报也用此词。

senses.en: facts and figures

ex.en: Scientists collect data from tests.
ex.zh: 科学家从实验中收集数据。

ex.en: Reliable data allows policymakers to assess whether environmental regulations are reducing pollution in urban areas.
ex.zh: 可靠的数据能让政策制定者评估环境法规是否正在减少城市污染。

tip: 日常常作不可数名词；学术语境也用复数谓语。

senses.en: a condition around an event
the conditions of someone's life, especially their financial situation

ex.en: Under no circumstance should you lie.
ex.zh: 在任何情况下你都不该说谎。

ex.en: Schools should consider each student's personal circumstances when developing policies on attendance and access to learning resources.
ex.zh: 学校制定出勤和学习资源获取政策时，应考虑每位学生的个人情况。

col: under the circumstances｜在这种情况下
tip: 常用复数；under no circumstances置句首须倒装。

senses.en: fine; easily broken
Requiring careful handling to avoid problems or offence.
Fine, subtle, or gentle in appearance, flavour, or smell.

ex.en: Handle the glass with delicate care.
ex.zh: 轻拿轻放这些玻璃。

ex.en: Tourism in coastal regions must be carefully managed to protect delicate ecosystems from lasting damage.
ex.zh: 沿海地区的旅游业必须得到妥善管理，以保护脆弱的生态系统免遭长期破坏。

col: delicate negotiations｜需谨慎进行的谈判
tip: 既可形容易损物品，也可形容需谨慎处理的问题。

senses.en: to tell apart
to make someone or something different from others
to see or hear something clearly enough to recognize it

ex.en: Babies learn to distinguish colors early.
ex.zh: 婴儿很早就能学会辨别颜色。

ex.en: Students should learn to distinguish reliable evidence from personal opinion when evaluating information online.
ex.zh: 学生在评估网络信息时，应学会区分可靠证据与个人观点。

col: distinguish A from B｜把A与B区分开
tip: 常用distinguish A from B或between A and B。

senses.en: able to change easily
able to bend easily without breaking

ex.en: Keep a flexible schedule.
ex.zh: 保持灵活的时间安排。

ex.en: Flexible working arrangements can help employees balance professional responsibilities with their family commitments.
ex.zh: 灵活的工作安排能帮助员工兼顾工作职责与家庭责任。

col: flexible working hours｜弹性工作时间
tip: 既可形容安排灵活，也可形容材料易弯曲。

senses.en: a feeling of worry

ex.en: Exam anxiety is common among students.
ex.zh: 考试焦虑在学生中很常见。

ex.en: Regular physical activity can reduce anxiety among students facing demanding examinations and uncertain career prospects.
ex.zh: 经常锻炼可以减轻学生面对高难度考试和不确定就业前景时的焦虑。

tip: anxiety about后接担忧的事情；形容词是anxious。

senses.en: a serious disagreement
A situation where different needs or ideas cannot agree.
To disagree with or be incompatible with something.

ex.en: Talking can reduce family conflict.
ex.zh: 沟通可以减少家庭冲突。

ex.en: Economic growth can conflict with environmental protection when industries rely heavily on fossil fuels.
ex.zh: 当工业高度依赖化石燃料时，经济增长可能与环境保护相冲突。

col: a conflict of interest｜利益冲突
tip: 名词重音在首音节，动词重音在第二音节。

senses.en: to send out by radio or TV
A programme transmitted through radio, television, or the internet.

ex.en: The match will broadcast live tonight.
ex.zh: 比赛今晚将直播。

ex.en: Public television should broadcast educational programmes that help children understand science and develop an interest in learning.
ex.zh: 公共电视台应播出教育节目，帮助儿童理解科学并培养学习兴趣。

tip: 过去式和过去分词通常都为broadcast。

senses.en: the purpose of something
To work or operate in the intended way.
A mathematical relationship assigning each input exactly one output.

ex.en: What is the function of this button?
ex.zh: 这个按钮的功能是什么？

ex.en: Urban parks serve an important function by providing space for exercise, relaxation, and social interaction.
ex.zh: 城市公园提供运动、休闲和社交的空间，发挥着重要作用。

tip: function as后接名词，表示起……作用。

senses.en: a worry or interest

senses.zh: 令人担忧的事；关注事项
